voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: My name, uh, I can't remember. Oh, right, "24," that's what they call me... No! Stop! Don't come out! You can't, not now...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Shh... Please don't let "them" discover that I'm getting stronger.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: "They" all said... Thank you.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Uh... What is this?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: This feels so strange... Am I dying? No, save me! Help! No!!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Huh? I'm still alive... You... You really won't steal my organs or use me for experiments?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: {Male=Sir,Female=Madam}, you are truly kind. Sadly, I have nothing to repay you with, worthless as I am...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: ...Just a little further, and I'll be completely separated from "them"?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I am feeling it... The Source of Uncleanliness... One step closer to Our true form... Ahhh, I shall tear this world apart!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: We're...ready. Please give the order, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: I feel fantastic right now. What? You say my mind has been taken over by something else? N-no way... uh...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Heh, that woman is so scared of me coming out that she doesn't even dare to sleep at night. Relax, I wouldn't kill you—not while you're giving me gifts. Who am I? Of course, I'm "24," hahaha!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Please don't worry. We'll all share a steak and a bed, and never cause you any trouble.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: I used to work until midnight every day—spinning, washing, cleaning, babysitting, even scavenging... I would do anything to earn money. Back then, living was merely surviving. Now, we have fresh food, warm bed, and a kind master like you... It's beyond my wildest dreams.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: There are many "me" inside. Happy, sad, angry... They love sponge cake, hate Londinium's rainy days. They all go by "24," and they all adore you.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Oh... Would you like a hug?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Myself
voiceLines.content: Arms, those pesky arms! They always grab onto my hair. I can't even control my own hands—what a useless woman I am... Maybe I should...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after clearing Main Story Chapter 2
voiceLines.content: Excuse me... Have you seen my sister, Jenkin? She's a girl who carries a mouse and can be quite fierce... I couldn't possibly mistake her.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Herbert
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after clearing Main Story Chapter 2
voiceLines.content: Although Herbert is a terrifying person, his cats are very gentle... No, to be precise, there are two cats, right?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: That... is the black viscous liquid surging through my veins, the ultimate power that silences all screams of pain! "I" was born from this, born to destroy! HAHAHA!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Why, why lock me up here? Haha... you're not getting what you want. I'll tear these restraints, this prison, into fragments!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: "The Lady's Wardrobe" and "The Working Woman's Guide" are both excellent reads... Though I can't afford those beautiful dresses, simply admiring them is fun.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: It's raining. The rain washes away everything: spoiled food, stubborn filth, and people like me... the dispensable.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Don't worry, all of us are quite useful. I can sew and clean, another me excels at fighting, and the others...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Although I am a pacifist, "they" clearly think otherwise...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Slice, slice, tear apart. Just like they did to me... Hehe... HAHAHA!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: A gathering of weak souls... What good can we do except produce noise? Sigh...

voiceLines.title: Strike: Mania
voiceLines.content: Hahaha!

voiceLines.title: Strike: Depression
voiceLines.content: Hmm...

voiceLines.title: Defense: Mania
voiceLines.content: Scram!

voiceLines.title: Defense: Depression
voiceLines.content: Don't...

voiceLines.title: Hit: Hysteria: I
voiceLines.content: How could this be?!

voiceLines.title: Hit: Depression: I
voiceLines.content: Ugh...

voiceLines.title: Hit: Depression: II
voiceLines.content: It hurts...

voiceLines.title: Hit: Depression: III
voiceLines.content: Ah!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I: Mania
voiceLines.content: Let me out!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I: Depression
voiceLines.content: Don't do this...

voiceLines.title: Skill: II: Mania
voiceLines.content: Chop!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II: Depression
voiceLines.content: Sorry... I didn't want this to happen...

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Unclean, filthy, chaotic—this is our power.

voiceLines.title: Exalt: Mania
voiceLines.content: Welcome—to our grand feast!

voiceLines.title: Exalt: Depression
voiceLines.content: This is the Source of Uncleanliness...

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Don't hinder me!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: It's Agrippa. I have nothing to say to you—unless you dare to volunteer as my gladiator.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Heh. You're slightly smarter than I thought.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: As my slave, paying tribute to your master is only natural.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: You look quite amusing when you try to please me.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: It tickles! Just like when the maid uses a feather to tickle the soles of my feet. You didn't do that on purpose, did you?!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Hmph... Not bad. Give me more. I need to feed these little spiderlings.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: I have a very strong urge to watch a duel... It would be even better if it was in a maze!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Contract... Yes, I want to sign a contract with you; an everlasting master-servant contract...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I hear someone calling my name: Agrippa, Agrippa, Agrippina...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I saw... It climbing up from the darkness of the well; countless eyes appearing on its flesh egg. They stared at me, calling me... Maze God!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Unbelievable. My home has perished like this... That was the great Rome! You must have heard of it!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: I was an hour late for this meeting—and I blame those insipid do-gooders who abolished slavery! Now there's no one to comb my hair for me!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: If I were you, I'd lock all the Awakeners in cages! Once mad dogs break free, they always bite their master first!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Don't ask me that again! I was careless, let the gladiator escape, and got my entire family killed! We were reduced to ashes, like the Roman Empire!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Keep your pity to yourself! I despise it, and I absolutely don't need anyone's sympathy! If you keep looking at me like that, I simply won't be able to resist tormenting you. You don't want things to spiral out of control, do you? So, be a good slave, listen, and obediently become my gladiator...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Shit! What are you doing?! Believe it or not, I'll chop your hand off!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Maze
voiceLines.content: If you're bored, why not come "keep me company" in the maze? After all, your hopeless life is no different from this endless labyrinth!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Uvhash
voiceLines.content: Uvhash... he's special. Did you think my family's prosperity came easily? It's all thanks to him killing like a mad dog in the arena. He was our biggest cash cow.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Wanda
voiceLines.content: I quite like that woman. We have a... a... right, a common language!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution...? Of course, I know! It just means the slave's leash is broken. What's so hard about that?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: What's wrong with playing bridge in the classroom? There's a table, people are here, and I've brought the cards! That means it's "Game On!"

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: The bathhouse is a great place to pass the time! The food is delicious, and they offer muscle relaxation services! Are you tempted? Then build one at this school right away!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Tips, of course, tips! Look at those utterly clueless waiters in the school cafeteria! They don't even bother to prepare the lounge chairs in advance, yet they still expect extra pay? Dream on!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Weak muscles, a haggard face—only those dead-like eyes hold some value. They're perfect for feeding spiders!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Is this a provocation? I'm ready at any time!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: What should we do with these failures?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Damn it! Next time, I'll throw their corpses to the spiders for dinner!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: How dare you look elsewhere!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Focus!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Tsk, annoying!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Disgusting!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Cry of pain)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Ouch! Ouch!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Grunt of pain)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Annoyed grunt)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Do not come near me!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Torture them slowly.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Come on, take a deep breath—

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: This is a blessing from the Great One!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: The God of the Underground Maze pronounces judgment upon all of you!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: H-Hello... Nice to meet you. My name is Aigis... P-Please don't mind me! Just pretend I don't exist...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: T-Thank you... for everything you've done. I will do my absolute best... to not let you down!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: A treasure that glitters like candy wrappers... I will cherish it dearly.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: I have grown stronger... I'll use these eyes to paralyze the enemy!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: What can I help you with...?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: P-please don't look into my eyes... I don't want to hurt you... I'm a monster, after all...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: I-I feel so uneasy... being looked at like this... Are you not afraid of my curse?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: I am very anxious... unsure if I can ever meet your expectations...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Your gaze is burning me... Have I caused you any trouble?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I... I understand your intention. Though I'm still clumsy, I will fight for you with all I have!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Sorry, if I'm causing you any trouble, I'll leave immediately!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Can I stay here a little longer? I will remain quiet, make no sound, and try my best not to disturb you...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Thank you for allowing me to stay here. If there's any way I can repay you, please let Aigis know. Would you like some tea?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: It's so warm that I don't want to leave. When I'm alone, it's truly dark, cold, and frightening...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Aigis... Can I really return to the crowd? I'm not ready yet, but you've already accepted me... In that case, please continue to look after me... Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Aigis... Did I do something wrong?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Friends
voiceLines.content: Jenkin, Diana, Mac, T'yog, Brown... Woahh! Sorry, I was just talking to myself! You ask why I'm reciting these names? Because I don't want to forget them...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
voiceLines.content: Ah, it's Brown! I... I should probably back away a bit... I wanted to be her friend, but instead, I ended up becoming her nightmare... She probably doesn't want to see me anyway...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Murphy
voiceLines.content: Is... Is it really okay for her to treat others like that? Ms. Sarah said kids shouldn't throw tantrums...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: If only Aigis could bear this black liquid for everyone... After all, Aigis never existed, which might be a good thing for this world, right?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: I'm really scared. No, I'm not scared of you, but... I'm worried I might bring fear and sorrow to you again.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Everything. I love everything. Whether it's everyone gathered around the table for a meal and prayer, or the anticipation when the Keeper is out on a mission, waiting for your triumphant return... The air is always filled with happiness... Do I truly deserve such joy?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: What I... hate? Can I say it? I hate myself for being so useless... But if I say that, Jenkin will get really angry...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You are the kind person providing me with a place to stay. I will do as you say. If only I could be a bit more useful...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: I... I can do it!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Whew... Did I cause you any trouble?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: It's all my fault... Everything is my fault...

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Be careful!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Don't come any closer!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Ouch!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Please stop!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: Ouch...

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (A stifled groan of endurance)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Stop!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: ...I... I see it now!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: I will endure it.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Ah... Sorry, p-please don't move!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Don't move! Don't move! No!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Need me to accompany you as a guard? If your pursuit is just, I will assist you.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: I am more agile now.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Training must not be neglected!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: The blade has not lost its edge yet.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Is this some kind of new technology? My prosthetic limb feels much lighter.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: The honor of being a warrior is being restored.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Can you believe it? I can feel my broken leg bone healing.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: One day, I will return to the battlefield as the leader at the vanguard.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The day is fast approaching for another expedition, and my blood is boiling with purpose.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Thank you sincerely for your trust in training me to this level. You must also be someone who pursues justice; thus, I will continue to bring glory to our cause here.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content:
My title? Are you truly that interested in my personal affairs? You just want to chat... Very well.
In the army, we don't differentiate between comrades based on gender—that includes strength, speed, and naturally, hairstyles and titles. Over time, I've grown accustomed to this way of expression.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content:
This injured leg? I didn't expect you'd care. I got it on the battlefield before I became an Awakener.
Don't worry, it doesn't interfere with my combat ability anymore, now that I'm an Awakener.
Does it hurt, you ask? No. I haven't thought about it.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Sylvia asked about my mental state. You sent her, did you not? I admit the phantom pain flares up occasionally. But don't worry about it. I am your sword, your blade. As long as I can fight for justice, minor pain won't matter.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content:
I got your schedule from Sylvia, and it's too demanding for newcomers. I understand you're doing the right thing, but overburdening rookies might cause unnecessary trouble for the team.
You say you're not a rookie? No, I can tell by the look in your eyes; there are many things you haven't experienced yet.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: After glimpsing the real world beyond the front lines, I once questioned the value of "heroes." But luckily, I met you—honest, brave, and pure. Under your command, I will fight tirelessly for peace and stability. This time, I will secure my redemption.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Show some respect, junior. In the army, seniority is absolute, and orders are followed without exception. Such improper behavior will be punished.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About @2
voiceLines.content: I encountered some unsettling individuals in the corridor. You may need to cooperate with them due to the circumstances, but remain vigilant! The human heart is crueler than war, and the worst betrayals often come from within.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Nautila
voiceLines.content: Every so often, the girl on the motorcycle helps me maintain my prosthetic limb. However, recently, hasn't the frequency of maintenance checks been excessively high?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Sorel
voiceLines.content: Keeper, I must speak with you. Before we achieve final victory, some individuals should not be so extravagant. Remember, I am not fighting for the luxurious lives of such people!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: War always brings pain, and enduring suffering is a warrior's duty. Even if I lose my hands, my feet, and everything else, I will still fight for you and for justice.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Mythag University is no different from the military. Each of us stands on the front line, polishing our weapons and preparing for battle.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Justice, loyalty, resilience, discipline. These have long been engraved in my heart.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I oppose all acts of injustice; betrayal is the worst. In the army, if you cannot or dare not trust your comrades to guard your back, the entire unit will fall apart.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: As long as you can uphold this justice, I will always shoulder the duty of the blade.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: It's time to head to the battlefield!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Not bad; this is a warrior's glory!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Don't fret; scars are a warrior's badge of honor!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: As you command!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Be careful!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Don't worry!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Useless!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Scornful Endurance)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Endure)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Sound the horn!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: For peace!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Fight to the end!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: The light of justice is lit here!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: In the abyss... there will be a light of justice.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Hehe... Hi! It's me, Aurita! One, two, three... Woah! Welcome, welcome! New friends have joined us! Huh? I'm your new friend this time? Well, I guess that works too!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Can we go further this time? Let's head to the beach!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Friends~ More Friends~

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Wow—thank you, dear friend~

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Ehe!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Mealtime? Or activity time?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Everyone disappeared after starting hide-and-seek. This time, I'm determined to find everyone!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: It's my turn to be the ghost this time! You only have 5 seconds to hide! 5, 4—

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Ms. Sylvia said I should say "thank you" when I receive something... Thank you, thank you, thank you!!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Haha! Now Aurita's Friends won't disappear again!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: I've traveled! I wasn't carried away by the waves, I actually sat in a caravan!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Lighthouse jellyfish, crown jellyfish, peach blossom jellyfish—they all move in groups. Of course, Aurita does too! I want to be with everyone!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Past events? Hard to recall... But I remember working at an aquarium! I got paid 2 Pensh a day!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Let me tell you a secret: I'm actually from Atlan...tis... um, basically, I'm a sea person! As long as I behave, eat veggies, and make more friends, That Atlan-whatever place will welcome me!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: My home, my aquarium friends, my favorite jellyfish—they're all gone... Will you disappear, too? Can't you stay with me forever?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hehe—so ticklish! Don't run! I've got to scratch you back!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About "Awakeners
voiceLines.content: Awakener? Hmm... Yes, 7 AM is the best time to wake up! Let's collect shells at the beach tomorrow morning at 7!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Casiah
voiceLines.content: Casiah is incredible! She can make a bunny appear in the blink of an eye!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Agrippa
voiceLines.content: Hmm... Agrippa has many Friends, but they all seem to be afraid of her. Could it be that she steals their food?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution? Hmm... Yes! Ice cream melts! But if we share it, we can eat it before it completely turns into cream!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Oh no! I've been found! As a penalty for losing, you can make one request of me—just please don't make me go to class, pretty please!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Aurita loves playing with everyone! Will you join? This one is Jelly, that one is Hela, and over there is Jelly, too... huh?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Aurita dislikes friends leaving suddenly... But, if they return, I will forgive them!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Big friend! Partner! Hoo-hoo, let's be best friends forever, okay?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Play here today?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Yahoo—I'm so tired, can I go play now!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: If only there were more Friends...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Look this way!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Don't drown!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Ouch!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Cheater!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: More friends!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Come on! Join Aurita!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: How can I help you?

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Let's make this our clamorous sea of happiness!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Everyone, let's attack together!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Ah... I remember everything! I was... I was trapped by that filthy human blood and failed to transform! How could this be? Where are my gills? Why aren't they moving?! Why!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Can worldly trials truly awaken the potential of my bloodline? That, I did not anticipate.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Don't think this will earn my gratitude. My noble lineage simply wouldn't allow it.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: The weapon feels handier now.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Only a seaborne body can bear such supreme power. You must envy me, huh? It's not your fault for being a frail human; just come to terms with it.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I remember this feeling—that glorious moment is coming...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: That voice is calling me again... that ethereal sound from the deep abyss!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Why? Why haven't I grown gills after the ritual? Did the transformation fail again?! Damn it! Damn it! Damn it!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: You've invested so much in me... you are indeed more patient than other humans. Do you truly... not despise me?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I still haven't grown my gills, but I no longer feel anxious about it. Keeper, I'll be your shield, and protect you with my fins.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: This half-human shell really... disgusts me. I finally got rid of the past, and now I have to recall it again...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: To think the heir of the great bloodline would stoop to serving a human... Hmph. Don't think you can command me at will.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Hmph, you frail human do have some talent in command... and I would show you my true power if not for this inferior shell.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: One day, Uncle Ornn will bring me back to my underwater home. Until then, I can reluctantly be your friend.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: "Our family carries a great bloodline; the chosen one will enjoy eternal peace in the deep sea." I never expected to feel this peace after leaving the sea and coming to the academy. You are different from those who bully me, so I won't allow others to bully you either.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Envious? These tough scales are proof of a noble lineage.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aequor
voiceLines.content: In my dreams, I often hear the sound of the tide, growing fainter and fainter. I know I might stay here forever, Human.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Bloodline
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after acquiring any one of Awakeners: "Tulu," "Murphy," "Miryam," or "Goliath".
voiceLines.content: Is that what they call a Genesis Form...? No, it's a bit different from what I imagined. But if I could become like that, it would be great.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dusk
voiceLines.content: The sunset on the small hill often reminds me of my days in Cleveland... Cleveland. I can't believe I still remember that name, the place that gave me these scars.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Having transcended inferior races, I do not fear such influence. Even if the host body is shattered, the noble bloodline will not perish.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: A school where all is treated equal... I wonder what foolish dreams you harbor. Even if you haven't committed any wrongs, they will still trample you underfoot. I know that feeling.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Favorite things? Seaweed, fish schools, colonnades, mazes... Of course I've seen them! They're all in Uncle Ornn's book!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Without a doubt, humans. Are there any creatures filthier than humans?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Before I return to our palace at the bottom of the sea, I will lend you, a mere human, some of the power of Aequor, but only this once.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: The power of my bloodline is surging.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Victory came effortlessly, even before my bloodline's full awakening.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Darn it! You—you still look down on me, don't you?!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Try this!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Watch this!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Just a mere scratch...

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Blast it!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Never look down on me!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: It's time!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Come!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Yes... I know you're within me!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: All who have insulted me shall pay the price!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Ready? Casiah's magic show is about to begin! Don't look away, you don't want to miss the highlights. It's showtime!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: I've learned a new technique!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Ah, this familiar sense of emptiness!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: My wand wants to dance!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: If you want to watch my performance, sit properly in the audience!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Oh no, my hat is crooked... Hmm, is this better? It is! Perfect!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Mirror, mirror, who is the greatest magician in the world? Me? That is correct!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: More memories, more emotions, more dreams—

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The order of the universe shifts here; the future of destruction is the magician's core belief!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Hehe, do you want to see a universe being destroyed? Oh, it's too late to back out now!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content:
You, you will be Casiah's magic assistant! Don't be scared~ Just climb into my magic box for a moment!
Are you hiding well? I'm about to insert the sword~ Oh, I assure you there are no traps inside~

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Here, put on this top hat! Then, tell me the gift you desire most. Ah, I see! Now, reach into the hat—

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: How troubling. Those kids come to every show, and my stock is running low... Hmm, a magician mustn't perform the same tricks for the same audience. Create new magic? Sorry, I lack that particular talent; I'm only good at imitations!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content:
Oh no~ You caught me~ 
It's fine, Awakeners have such abundant spirit power. I need to steal at least 365 times before they become mindless puppets~ Can't do it? Alright, I'll be more careful next time! Just a tiny bit of "fear" during the sawing, will you?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Hey, you already know the secrets of Casiah's magic, don't you? Hmm, to ensure you don't spill the secrets, you'll have to follow me wherever I go on tour~ Haha, you think I'm collecting your emotions? Indeed, nothing escapes your notice!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Be careful! If you reach into another dimensional space, you might not get your hand back!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Faint
voiceLines.content: I know that child. She sometimes stands far away, watching my performance. It's good that she doesn't come closer, otherwise my little audience will be mentally and physically exhausted!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Children
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after acquiring any one of Awakeners "Aigis," "Jenkin," "Lily," "Murphy," "Karen," or "Aurita"
voiceLines.content: You guys, don't you ever get tired of watching the magic show? Sit still, alright? If you run onto the stage again, I'll toss you into another dimension!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Daffodil
voiceLines.content: Don't let that woman in the wide-brimmed purple hat near the stage! No questions asked—just keep her away if you don't want gooey gray matter spilling out of my hat!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: A hollow? I often create similar stuff during telekinesis. The ones I make link to another dimension; would the Dissolution ones do the same?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Ah, this is the best stage! The people at Mythag University all understand that my performance is true magic! This must be what they call a magician's best audience, yes?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Tea party, tea party! Let's have a tea party! I got plenty of tea leaves and snacks from Sylvia! Yep, I performed Futterwacken Dance in exchange!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I detest people with fake smiles! You can't steal any emotions from them!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: I know, you're a special audience. I can't just zap you into another dimension; that would cause big trouble. Hey, have you ever done that to someone else? You mustn't ask, it is my secret!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: My hat can't wait any longer!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: We won. Are you happy? What does "happy" feel like?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: The pigeons haven't returned...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Here you go! Fly!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Boom—

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: You can't see me!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Don't blink!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Magic time!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: My magic's ready!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Welcome to the wonderland!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Here comes the opening tribute!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Greetings. I am Castor... Was there more I should say? Forgive me—words don't come easily. If you need anything, just ask.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: These dark feathers grow heavier each day.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Will these cursed wings ever find the strength to take flight again...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Thank you... for the key to my freedom. For letting me grasp my own fate.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: When we were children, the rules weren't this strict. Sometimes, Pollux would go off and say something, and magically get a handful of candies. That sweetness... it feels like this moment now.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Theology lessons under Albino and the Light Watch filled our days. I dreamed of shorter scriptures—fewer verses to stumble over, fewer reprimands.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The High Priestess... Juliette. She was gentle with us then. Her warm smiles made disobedience unthinkable. A pat on the head silenced all protests. We didn't want to let her down. Yeah, don't worry, I don't feel that way anymore... You may pat my head instead.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Even before that book, we wondered about the world beyond the lake's island, the scarlet walls. Yet when Pollux suffered, I didn't resist. I lack his courage. Unlike Pollux, I am much more cowardly and clumsy.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: So much unseen... so much undone. Those desolate deep green lakes and the thick fog that lingers on will no longer hold us back. Oceans, cities, farms from the book's pages... I'll see them. With Pollux. With you.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: These wings are fully grown now. So sturdy, so powerful. Now I can carry both Pollux and you. Call for me when you wish to fly.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Your generosity unsettles me. The expensive books, the meteorite crystals you gave me... is there a price? Sorry, please forgive my suspicion. I shouldn't doubt you like this.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: We weren't allowed to talk to other people since childhood. "Friend" was a foreign concept to me... until recently. Pollux and I were everything to each other: brothers, friends, fellow prisoners, each other's only solace. Now... perhaps I should make some new friends.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: How should friends get along? Pollux likes ordering me around when he could do those things himself. And I'm willing to help him with those tasks, it's our way of hanging out together. If you want, I'll do something for you too.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Do I... sound stupid? Sorry, please forgive my ignorance. My knowledge begins and ends with the Lantern's doctrines. Teach me your likes and dislikes—I'll commit them to memory.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: When you hear the leaves rustling in the trees, you'll know I'm by your side.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Would you like to touch my feathers? Sure, go ahead. Should I extend them further?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: I was immersed in that black, sticky ooze for a long, long time—so long that I forgot about time itself, so long that even Pollux forgot about me. It didn't bring physical pain... just dread, watching my soul dissolve away.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: A school without Theology? Where you choose lessons... skip them? It sounds like a dream.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Sorry, I didn't mean to zone out... You asked me what this feather is? This is... His most prized thing... and now mine. Do you like it? It's pretty, right?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: What I covet most is how you effortlessly trust your companions. Being forgotten... betrayed... the wounds never fade.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Could you teach me how to trade? How to exchange items and how to manage the currency obtained—it's truly a profound subject. Gaining freedom is just the start; Pollux and I still have a lot to learn to live independently. May I rely on you?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
voiceLines.content: That master thief offered to teach me the best survival skills for just five hundred Leonian Florins... Have I been deceived? No, I believe this is knowledge worth learning, and it's precisely what Pollux and I are lacking... Is it a money issue? I understand. Then, how about I go negotiate with her and pay her four hundred and fifty Leonian Florins instead?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Doresain
voiceLines.content: Ah, I heard he's a master chef... The knowledge of making food is indeed very necessary. Although I'm not that particular about food, Pollux is extremely picky. I should find some time to learn from him... I shouldn't go? Why? The food that mister makes looks delicious though.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Daffodil
voiceLines.content: A store that can fulfill any wish, overflowing with countless treasures... It makes one hesitate to approach. Not that I doubt the lady's power, but "to obtain something, one must pay the corresponding price"—this is a lesson Pollux and I have learned through bitter experience, time and again.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Karen
voiceLines.content: Now that I reflect on it, the maids carrying lanterns weren't so different from Pollux and me. We all lived shackled by invisible chains, quietly submitting to our fate. Yet that green maid... she was different. There was a lightness to her, as if she genuinely took pleasure in her duties. Maybe... maybe she had already discovered true freedom.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Pollux
voiceLines.content: Pollux... The Lantern filled his mind with poisonous ideas, but he's actually kind. It's not that he's selfish... He's just terrified. Terrified of losing the Lantern's approval, of vanishing without that fragile sense of identity. His desperation to please them... it's the panic of someone clinging to the only "self" he's ever known.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Witness this will of mine—this hunger for freedom.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: At last... I've seen the stars from those pages.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Guess I never... made it out, huh...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Out of the way!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Fall!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Back off!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: You will not get past me.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Just a scratch...

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: I can take more...

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Get behind my wings!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Wind, carry them to death's maw!

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Vanish with the wind!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: All birds find their sky eventually.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: You can't destroy me!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Let the Cataclysm come. This immortal flesh will stand unbroken!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: My name is Celeste. I'll always be here, as long as you still need me.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: As you wished, my existence has grown more tangible.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: It has arrived... the white bird circling in my dream.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Hmm... the sea water is quite warm tonight...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Do you wish for me to set sail once more? I am willing to do so... if you do not mind my past failure.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I seem to hear the rowers' shanties again... and sense the familiar scent of home.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Please follow the trail of the birds of paradise; the destination awaits ahead in the azure blue.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: The destination, be it treasure or port, makes no difference to me. My purpose is only to ensure your safe return.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Thanks to your favor, even the raging seas now feel less daunting. I shall brave them to bring you my steadfast blessings.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I often gaze at the horizon, imagining the scenes on that distant land—the one I draw closer to but can never reach. If that day ever comes, please come with me to see it.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Duty and destiny are much alike. Neither can be easily cast aside, nor is there any need to cast them aside.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: My past was routine and calm, like the seas near the equator; there is nothing worth mentioning.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: My wish? Ensuring safe and peaceful voyage—does that not suffice? I have never had any other wishes... but I will consider it carefully and tell you later.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Miss Ramona once said that I don't need to accommodate everyone. I do not understand... Does it mean my protection is no longer needed?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I was brought to the ship and entrusted with the mission of the ship's maiden many years ago. Since then, my life—and its meaning—have been beyond my control. I've been told that I should live for my own wishes, at least in this second life as an Awakener... Would you help me? Help me become selfish, help me find my own wish.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Would you like to sink together with me?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Past
voiceLines.content: Ah... Are you talking to me? My apologies, I was lost in memories of the view back when I was bound to the mast. Would you mind repeating your question?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Miryam
voiceLines.content: Blessing the voyage for most people makes no difference to me... except for that woman. If possible, please arrange another route for me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Faros
voiceLines.content: That would be a dangerous person to have on board... No, I mean purely from a navigation safety perspective...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: I was punished for failing to protect the sailors, who were lost to their families forever. They named me the chief culprit of the tragedy... Is this what Dissolution is?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Thanks to Miss Hannah, I was able to observe the choir practice. Hymns and sea shanties are quite different; during my years of blessing voyages, I've never heard such a unique melody...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: The full moon's golden light always enchants me: beneath it, the sea catches the light and shimmers beautifully as the mysterious, gentle wind blows, weaving a romantic and dreamlike vision.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: It's getting a bit noisy... are those the students? They are much like albatrosses, you see? They have endless vitality, as if their journey never ends...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: My relationship with you is like that of a sail and a ship. Without the ship, the sail shouldn't exist; without the sail, the ship can hardly voyage far. Is that not true?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Souls without protection, I shall grant you final peace.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Everything went well. You may raise the triumphant sails.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: So my protection, too, may fail at times...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Shatter.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Turn into wreckage.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Turn back.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: I can keep going.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: May you have a sweet dream.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: To the best of my ability.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: I will do my utmost.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Your prayers have been heard.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Bird soaring in the azure sky, please heed my prayer.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Forgive my intrusion, I simply sensed a low psychological energy and came to check on you. Now, Keeper, shall we embark on a journey through your mind?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: If you seek my thoughts, you may be disappointed. I'm better at listening than I am at offering commentary.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Ah, I heard His voice... those murmurs, every syllable filled with the utmost agony.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: I will remember the pain of this moment... recalling and savoring it again and again.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Psychiatrists once cured patients by drilling open their skulls with a trepanation technique... Please, relax. That was long ago. We have since developed far more methods to delve into the mind.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: First, let's listen to some music. How do you like this melody? Soothing and gentle. Now, let your body and mind resonate with the music, entering a state of spiritual relaxation.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Your vision is probably filled with bizarre hallucinations now, which is quite normal. Draw them out, and your subconscious and instincts will reveal everything.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Next is Philip Pinel's moral therapy. You must express your innermost desires and fears. It's a necessary procedure to unshackle the mind and restore dormant humanity.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Remember those fears, detail your feelings of pain. The essence of emotional impact therapy is to face pain directly and conquer it. Here, I'll wipe away your tears. Take your time. Tell me those memories in detail...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Congratulations, you have been healed. Yes, those hallucinations and illusions are normal; they are proof of your recovery.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Weavers, lawyers, barons... I'll never turn a patient away for a fee. To me, they are all merely patients in need of healing.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Poor Mr. White. His family kept him in a pigpen because asylums in the neighborhood were full. I treated him for free, and after that, he finally realized he was a person, not livestock. He then reclaimed his dignity, with his own hands.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Hydrotherapy, electroconvulsive therapy, restraining therapy... those are not treatments, but torture. So, I've been treating the patients in those hospitals my way, pro bono. Eventually, they all achieved recovery and found true freedom.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: These patients have given me beautiful memories. Next, it's your turn, Keeper. I've already chosen a perfect ending for you. It will be the most exquisite consultation of my career.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I admit I underestimated you. Your existence is pain itself. This time, there's no need for follow-up visits. I want to stay by your side and see the outcome firsthand.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: To understand each other, one must open their heart. Touch here, and my silver heart will open for you.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: Mental illness is not exclusive to this era; it transcends time and space. Dissolution is the same. Both transcend the boundaries of human cognition, don't they?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: This place is filled with traces of history, and to some extent, history represents memories... painful memories of the departed.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: A dark room, all alone, along with the countless painful whispers constantly echoing in my mind... this is the best way to enjoy time.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: A numb soul holds no interest for me. Their souls are already dead. No matter how much one stirs them, there will not be a ripple.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: As a fragment of that existence, you carry Their scent... A beautiful scent, filled with pain. It makes any memory of yours taste incredibly delicious.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aurita
voiceLines.content: Though it may be impolite to say, talking to that child only bores me. You can only ever see one expression... a smile.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aigis
voiceLines.content: Aigis looks much brighter now. Of course, if my little guest needs help, I'm happy to offer it. I mean, genuine help.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Psychological Analysis
voiceLines.content: Keeper, can you help me with a small test? The Rorschach inkblot test. It will help me see the depths of your inner self... I will become the only Awakener to unveil the secrets of your heart.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: No need for such nervousness. This is merely a regular consultation.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Pain, despair, death... these memories taste like dessert after a fine meal.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Refusing a doctor's help will not benefit you. Perhaps next time, we'll try deep hypnosis.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Trust me a little more.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Expose your pain.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Listen to my guidance.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Take a deep breath.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: I am listening. Please, continue.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Please remain quiet.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Show me your truest self.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: I will savor this sweet pain.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Watch the pendulum... follow its movement with your eyes.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Shh... quiet. Now, walk toward the ending I'll guide you to.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Don't be shy, there's no need to hide. I am your sole confidante. Come, pour out your deepest pain to me.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: The navigator Corposant reports for duty! The flag has been prepared, personal condition is good, please give the launch order, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: I am merely fulfilling my duty as navigator and require neither report nor praise.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Rest assured, I shall use this power to guide the ship safely, and I will never misuse it.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: I firmly believe in the fundamental law that effort brings reward, and I shall work even harder in future.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: The ritual to deepen spiritual connection carries risks and unknown results. But rest assured, I will navigate for you to ensure the ritual is completed smoothly.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I feel... a sense of weightlessness, followed by violent shaking—as if the ship were being tossed about. Keeper, follow my movements to find your centre and stay balanced.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: This dizzying sensation is much like seasickness. Please close your eyes, take my hand, and lean against me. That should ease it a little.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: An unexpected incident occurred during the ritual. Forgive me for striking your arm with the flag; I had to keep you conscious.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The spiritual link has been established. I can sense your presence. This is my first time navigating the void. If anything drifts off course, please correct me at once.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: The ritual is complete. Thank you for your cooperation. Next time, I'll prepare special flags to guide us more safely through it.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: As long as you are in need, Corposant is always on standby.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Some people are like steamships—slow to respond, but capable of high speed. Others, diesel ships—quick to start, but with limited power. So what about you, Keeper?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Forgive me. I understand ships better than people. But if I may: your keel is neither wood nor iron, but steel. Strong. Steadfast. Truly admirable.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: You've proven self on multiple occassions. I believe you're an excellent navigator, perhaps more capable than I am.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: On our next voyage, I'd like to board the ship as something other than navigator. Uh... I mean, as one who follows your lead. You have my complete trust, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Is my hat askew? Apologies, but I'm not sure what you mean. Please give me clear instructions.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: I don't know why it exists. I know only this: I must navigate successfully, and bring everyone home.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Here, I encounter many kinds of ships and work with advanced navigation equipment. I find it deeply rewarding. Above all, I believe this "ship" is charting the right course for human history.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Rather than "like, " I prefer the word "devotion." When I look directly at that indescribable god, my mind loses reason and fills with ecstasy. I should fear Him, but I can't help myself.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Without order, what remains in this world? Only chaos.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You have my full respect. I vow to carry out every order you give.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Celeste
voiceLines.content: When necessary, a navigator trained in engine room cooperation can act as helmsman. But for the ship's safety, I still prefer to entrust that task to someone more skilled.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Faros
voiceLines.content: The lighthouse system eases the demands of navigation. Its beam is strong and clear. I'm glad to sail with Faros.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Her Flag
voiceLines.content: The flag is the navigator's language, and also their epitaph. When the ship sinks, salvagers will read the last message I left from the wreckage of the flag.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Cirrus clouds observed, with a continued drop in barometric pressure. All hands alert. The ship is about to enter a storm.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: These experiences are invaluable. I will record them in detail in the logbook, for future sailors.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: This chaos is the result of my miscalculation of the route. I am willing to accept punishment in accordance with the rules.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Surrender.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Please stop resisting.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Assessing the ship's trim and balance.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Readjusting weight distribution.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: I will not be defeated by this storm.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Ensure the ship's safety above all else.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Measuring the altitude angle of celestial bodies.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: E flag conveys instructions.

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Begin updating the nautical chart with corrections.

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: II
voiceLines.content: C flag acknowledges instructions.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: I will lead my ship to the correct course.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Lower the foremast sails. Waves are pressing against the port side. Helmsman, adjust course per my calculations.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Sailors, follow my guidance. I will make sure we reach the harbour safely.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content:
Hello, my name is Daffodil. I made an exchange with a guest who requested I assist you. So, let me hear what you require. 
Oh dear... what you wish for comes at quite a price, doesn't it?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: So I will feed on this instead of Sepirot from now on?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Delicious. Absolutely delicious.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: What do you want in return, dear guest?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Daffodil's shop is now open. Children who aren't prepared, please don't wander in casually.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: My wares? You could say I have everything to satisfy all your desires... for a price.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Skull of Love, Skull of Resentment, Skull of Hatred, Skull of Desire... Oh, here you are again, dear guest?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Since this is a transaction, I can't simply accept your gift. Would you like to choose something from my shop?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The extent of my contribution to your power ends here. Being too greedy is not a good thing, you know.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: What do you expect in return from me? Anything beside lending you power in battles?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Curious about my true identity? It's still too early for that. Just believe this: Every lost child can find their way in my shop. Perhaps that includes you as well?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: You are a delightful guest; even I am captivated by your unique skull... If you ever consider parting with it, be sure to visit my little shop. Haha... just a jest.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Oh, curious about my secret? This name, this body, this face, this voice—they all came from a woman from San Pedro, to whom one of my skulls once belonged. She struck a deal with me... After her death, I became her. As for her whereabouts... well, that is my most exquisite collection, you know.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: I wasn't always like this; she gave me a new life. In that sense, you have also given me a second life, so I will treasure your head as well.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Seeing how hard you're working, I almost feel guilty about collecting my reward too soon. So, I'll allow your head to stay where it is for now. But don't forget, it's already reserved as my personal property, okay?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hmm? Are you interested in me? Then I suppose... you're also ready to pay the price?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Caecus
voiceLines.content: Oh dear, no returns on items sold here! You do need a submarine to dive into the deep seas, don't you?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Winkle
voiceLines.content: That lady with heavy dark circles once consulted me about "living forever in the sun"... She only needed to migrate between two dimensions. Yet, she refuses to step into the Dimension Tunnel. It was truly a headache.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Goliath
voiceLines.content: Oh, how can there be such an arrogant guest, wanting "the most powerful weapon in the world"? I told him it would take a head soaked in hatred to exchange for it, and he walked away sullenly...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: A method to heal Dissolution? Such a thing doesn't exist anywhere. You ask how I remain uninfected? Hehe... It only takes "not getting seen".

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: My shop exists in any dimension, any location in the universe, and of course, it can be here. Besides, I like those careless children in Mythag.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I love new things. Over my millennia of travels, I have witnessed many fascinating innovations and inventions, such as poetic forms and cinematic scenes. Humans are truly intriguing creatures.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I detest people who don't pay for what they buy. If you run a store long enough, you'll encounter this trouble. I have no choice but to handle it personally and get the due payment back.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You are my esteemed guest. Remember, you're the only one allowed to run a tab. After all, it's been years since I last saw such a perfect skull...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Oh, do I need to display the items for you?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: That was a decent skull for a trophy... Though it can't compare to my best collection, the thrill of the hunt is always exciting. Do invite me next time, too.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: The passage of millennia has made me somewhat careless.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Go.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Give it to me.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Be careful.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Don't break it.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Cry.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: I'll keep this for you.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Beyond the Gate!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Behold your visage, O endless skulls!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: The Thousand-Faced Mirage is here!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: You'd better prove yourself worthy of making me leave the lab, new Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: The conversion rate is far too low. Report to my office tomorrow for retraining.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Not bad, I guess.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: My joint movement has notably improved.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Has my body or my consciousness improved? An intriguing subject for analysis.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: My mind feels sharper; not bad at all.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Balancing attendance, maintaining research progress, and completing teaching tasks. It seems the reverse time compression experiment requires immediate prioritization.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: I much prefer lab work to field duty—did you truly believe those assist tools simply materialized from the sea?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The will I've merged with is quite boisterous; the higher I ascend, the clearer His voice becomes... like the geese in Hyde Park, perpetually clamoring.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: This body can barely contain this Power, but it's not yet time to switch puppets. Why are you merely standing there? Assist me with this leg; adjustments are required.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Thirteen reports require urgent approval, six damaged communicators await repair, and I must also monitor the results of five distinct Silver extraction experiments... So, instead of squandering my limited time by disturbing me, why not attempt to exercise your feeble brain matter?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Do I always appear busy? Yes. Assistants can occasionally be useful, but in some research, I am simply irreplaceable. Do you wish to help? Then periodically check if I am still, in fact, alive.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I look angry? Do you comprehend how many muscles are required for a smile? I once elucidated this in class, a lesson that evidently slipped from your smooth brain. The answer is a minimum of seventeen, and I possess no logical reason to be angry with you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: "It was the secrets of heaven and earth that I desired to learn. I wanted to figure out what force is controlling me?" ...Though I find this novel's plot unsatisfying and its fictional science laughably naive, after reading it, you should grasp my motivations... Wait, you haven't read this book?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I have no time for rest. The Dissolution has already claimed two of my bodies. Before the inevitable end catches up, there is much I must comprehend... Assist me, starting with the preparation of experimental materials. I trust you won't miscalculate the balance.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Your feeble brain appears incapable of retaining lessons.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Afternoon Tea
voiceLines.content: Awakeners might consume out of curiosity, but food is not essential for our existence. Therefore, there is no need to summon me for every afternoon tea. Sugar intake only accelerates the wear and tear on this body's ball joints.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Winkle
voiceLines.content: Winkle's native species can infiltrate the biological brain, causing the Outer Will fused with me to fear her. But now, she's merely a poor soul confined within a shell.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Erica
voiceLines.content: I sincerely hope she doesn't malfunction during our conversation. My lovely yet infuriating assistant, there are no more spare labs for her to inadvertently detonate.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Since its first clear documentation, the Dissolution has impacted over a million lives. Our actions are critical to the survival of the entire human population.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: I joined Mythag at the age of fourteen. Had I graduated smoothly, you would be addressing me as Principal now.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: My hobbies include trying to solve the Riemann Hypothesis—that, however, is our Mr. Peacock's catchphrase, not mine. Personally, I find atomic mass standards far more engaging.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Things I despise... a disorganized desk, a messy wardrobe, dusty window sills—yes, I am describing your room. By 7 AM tomorrow, I expect it restored to its pre-occupancy state.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: I hope you won't squander your potential and humanity's expectations, new Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: I hope your command won't disappoint.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Keep it up! Your final grades are promising.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Should this occur again, I'll be applying for your disciplinary probation.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: It's my turn to act.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Think it through.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Stay calm and think.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: An astute observation!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: A keen insight!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: The supplies have arrived.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: The truth... it's revealed right here.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Unveil the world's mysteries with human intellect!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Next, we dissect the world's essence!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Ah, what an unforgettable scent... I simply cannot wait to welcome you into my sanctuary.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Your fragrant aroma is positively intoxicating.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Thank you so much for your enthusiasm. The honour is all mine.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: I see more impending deaths. The other side is becoming ever clearer...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: I preside over death, but please, do not misunderstand. I never create it; I merely follow in its wake, harvesting the choicest morsels left behind..

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I am no barbaric beast who gorges on raw flesh. The consumption of death is a solemn and elegant affair. You must commune with and truly understand each ingredient's unique flavour.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: No perfume compares to the human body's own natural fragrance. To know a person by their scent is a simply divine pleasure.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Different ingredients demand different preparations. The organs, they need to be marinated. The tendons in the legs are best stewed. Fatty parts are perfect for fermentation and ageing, while the more delicate pieces can be fried, roasted, or even transformed into beautifully sculpted jellies. These choices are all about discretion. For without preserving and accentuating the ingredient's natural flavour, there is no respect.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content:
The pairing of dishes also holds great importance.
The juxtaposition of sour with sweet, crisp with tender, light with rich, and delicate with coarse, creates a layered flavour and a textural contrast that leads to different sensations upon entry, mastication, and when savouring the aftertaste.
This is the endless and wondrous pleasure a proper meal provides.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Have I finally piqued your interest? Do come, my dear guest, join me at my table and partake in this grand banquet. Allow me to guide you as we savour the delicate afterglow of every spirit together.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Shhh, please, do be quiet. Let's listen to the voices of the departed.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content:
Do you know?
Every life has a long-lasting echo as it fades.
They vary in pitch and tone, stretching little by little from the moment death arrives until they dissipate into the heavens and earth, much like a sighing cry.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content:
Before every meal, I converse with the departed. For them, being eaten and savoured with true sincerity is a continuation of life and their final, most glorious moment.
Like how I long for them, they, too, long for me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: You can't smell yourself? Ah, what a shame. You're missing out on the sweetest, the most sublime... Oh, my, what is it? Why are you pulling away?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Rest assured, {Male=Mr.,Female=Miss} Keeper, I'll remain by your side until the day your life meets its destined end. On that day, I will, with all due solemnity, consume your body piece by piece. And your soul shall reside within me, forever.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Do you, too, crave the taste of my flesh, dear Keeper?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: My people and I revere the beauty of permanence. Dissolution slowly weathers a living person, wiping away all traces of their existence... Such cruel torture should not be allowed.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: I adore the classic beauty of this institution's Gothic clock tower. And the Awakeners here, ah... They exude an aromatic flavor I've never tasted: a perfect blend of departed fragrance and a trace of living scent. It truly makes me crave a little bite.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: The deceased who have found peace are beautiful and fragrant. Their beauty isn't in the flesh, before or after death, but in their souls. Those souls' enlightenment regarding death, their longing for life, and their desire to be remembered are the delicacies I have always dreamt of.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: There was a man who slowly carved away a young girl's flesh, fingernails, hands, and feet, all while continuously healing her. He didn't want her to die, nor did he want her to live. I could not, of course, grant him a peaceful death. So, I gave him a taste of his own medicine. I wonder how many years he's been trapped there... For someone who desecrates death, this is quite fair, isn't it?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: No adjective can describe the intoxicating fragrance of your body. It is like the tart aftertaste of a rich Bordeaux wine, and the thick aroma of a mellow, buttery sponge cake. The day of your death will perhaps be the most important event of my remaining time.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Leigh
