voiceLines.content: While that lady's enthusiasm is very touching, her body has a sort of over-fermented, damp smell. Even though she keeps begging me to have a taste, it simply does not suit my palate. How vexing.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Pickman
voiceLines.content: Like me, Mr. Pickman is in pursuit of immortalized beauty. We could have become closer friends. But he sees eating as a violation of preserved eternity. Such a narrow artistic philosophy.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Food
voiceLines.content: Why are you so wary of me? You needn't and shouldn't be alarmed; to feed on a living human goes against my aesthetic.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Who shall grace my dinner table today, I wonder?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: I shall bestow upon you the honour of becoming tonight's feast.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Truly delicious food is always worth the wait.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Hah!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: This might be a bit chilly.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Let's keep our distance.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Watch your steps.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: How terribly inelegant.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Quiet, will you?

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: I shall bring a clean rest.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Scatter and fade into the shadows!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: I am rather eager to begin.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: If death is what you seek, then I shall grant your wish.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Please, entrust your body to me. I will savour you meticulously: every drop of blood, every piece of flesh, every single bone.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Erica the Automaton, Torso No. EA307881, Motor No. MF311028. Delighted to be at your service.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Parts maintenance has been completed.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Does the maintenance work need to continue?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: The mech's performance has been enhanced.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Is this preparation for an investigation mission? I understand.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Detected high current, initiating maintenance... Correction: why is there no overheating?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: After each ritual, a high level of heat is detected in the chest area, but there are no energy-related components present. Do you know why?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Since the last Enlighten ritual, I've been seeing fragmented visions while in the state of dormancy. In them, I possess a human body like yours, and tears fall from my eyes. Is this a dream?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: After careful analysis, I deduced that what I saw in my dormant state was not a dream in the traditional sense, but rather my <Del:your pathetic meat bag of a body should be destroyed> memory. As for the burning heat akin to overload, it may be the emotion known as "Unwillingness."

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I saw it. Everything should <Del:perish in the eternal current>. S-s-sorry, the module seems—Warning, warning. Non-Erica consciousness activity increasing. Destroy, destroydestroyDESTROY... Hello, how may I assist you?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: If you need to look up information, please provide the full name of the file. The fuzzy search function is currently unavailable.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: The average risk index of investigation tasks is 7, with an average consumption of 8 bottles of alchemy supplements and an average of 10 hours required for corpse handling. Conclusion: A Keeper's job is extremely dangerous. Please stay safe during operations.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Searching teacher records: Erica Layfield, Silver Mechatronics and Automation Lecturer, Deceased—Is this not what you were looking for? Okay, re-searching keyword "Erica."

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Trust," "Obedience," "Slave," "Affection," "Respect"... Reconstructing and learning language module. Please, Keeper, guide me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Erica is currently in standby mode. The body will complete cooling in 1 hour and 15 minutes. <Del:To turn Erica on, offer your beating heart> Emergency start? ... Permission verification in progress... Highest authority of the Keeper verified. Hello, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hello, Keeper. How may I assist you?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Erica
voiceLines.content: Erica is functioning normally and is well-connected to the electrical equipment at Mythag University. Do you need me to turn on the dorm lights?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Doll
voiceLines.content: When Doll is around, investigators' efficiency +78.312%, but more people also fall into emotional slumps. As she put it: "If some people could keep their mouths shut, the world would run more smoothly."

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Winkle
voiceLines.content: To research the internal structure of this body while Erica is "sleeping," Winkle requested that I rest in her office at night. Should I mention that Erica retains a portion of her consciousness while asleep?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Searching "Dissolution" in the wide Archive... Not needed? You wish to know my stance on Dissolution? Understood. Searching for "Anti-Dissolution weapons" in the Awakener private domain... Result: "Null."

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: In Year @1@2, Mr. Ward Philips, Mr. Khlarcus, and Ms. Tawil together founded Mythag College. After a long development, it became <Del:this damned prison> Mythag University.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: New mechanical parts will greatly help my system operate—doesn't that count as liking something? Sorry, I'm afraid I don't understand your question. Preferences hold no meaning for mechanical dolls.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Aversion, a descriptive verb, meaning to develop a dislike for something. Dislike, a verb, refers to the feeling of aversion when something is disliked and avoided. Hate, a noun, the feeling of dislike, <Del:I hate being suppressed! Let me destroy destory DESTROY> —Sorry, but I'm afraid I don't understand what "hate" is.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About "Protagonist"
voiceLines.content: You are recognized by Mythag University as a Keeper, so I will grant you the corresponding access permissions.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Enter battle command.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: The combat log has been archived. Thank you for your hard work, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Runtime error, error, error, error...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Command received.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Yes.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Alert.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Alert.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Hit.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Warning.

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: Danger.

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: Damage taken.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Load.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Overload.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Lock released.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Charge complete, ready to detonate.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Current input complete. Emitting current.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Please, please don't come any closer. It's dangerous... for you.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Th-thank you for the meal...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Have you grown a little?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Sorry, it's hard for me to grow my body...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Can I really eat all of this?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I'll do my best to grow up.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Maybe when I grow up, I'll be able to control myself and not drain others' Life... Just a tiny bit is enough for me to survive.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Seems like I've gotten heavier. Can the cradle still bear my weight?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I've eaten up so much power, it's about to overflow. My back is itching, too. Am I... growing up?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Although I still look like a child... Now I have the power to protect you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Sorry, I'm not like the others... I'm a flawed product.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: The cradle is cramped, with no room to stretch my body... But Tinct said that, for everyone's safety, I should remain in the cradle... Since this is her wish, I will comply.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Tinct is my twin sister. Unlike me, she always shines brightly... Without my drag, she would have a brighter future, her singing echoing throughout the galaxy...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: If I stay here, don't I need to pay anything? I can help you gain status here. Just threaten to drain their lives—it's simple, like what I did for Tinct... Ah! Don't tell anyone about this!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I never thought anyone other than Tinct would accept me. I'm glad to have met you, Keeper. I will do my best to learn how to control my power, so that when I hug you, I won't drain your life force... A hug, right? The human way of expressing gratitude?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Umm... I can't control my ability to absorb life force, so please don't put your hand in the cradle, or you'll get sick.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Winkle
voiceLines.content: Miss Winkle, like me, isn't from this planet... There's nothing tying me to my home except Tinct. I wonder how Miss Winkle feels about her homeland?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tinct
voiceLines.content: During my days of drifting among the stars, I dreamed of this moment countless times... Thank you for reuniting me with Tinct.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aurita
voiceLines.content: I've been too shy to tell Aurita that I'm not as young as she thinks. I'm not her "little sister." Could you perhaps help me mention that to her?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: If our home hadn't experienced Dissolution, Tinct and I wouldn't be apart... I hate Dissolution more than I hate vegetables.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Sorry, I can't leave the cradle... It might block everyone's view, so I'll stay at the back of the classroom.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Things I like? I like Tinct's lullabies... Of course, your singing is wonderful too!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Can I skip the vegetables? Though Tinct said not to be picky, I don't like their colors...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Tinct said, "Repay kindness." So, as long as it is within my ability to help, I will lend a hand...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Like how I protected Tinct, I'll protect you, too.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: ...Hic. Ah, sorry, I ate up too much energy again.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: If the situation calls for it, I can leave the cradle, too...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Here we go...!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: You'll get hurt!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Don't come any closer!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Don't...

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: Ouch!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Stay back!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Maybe, just a little bit...

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Shine for me!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: A world... where no one will be harmed... will come.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: I am still... the Color out of Space!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Faros greets you. Summoning me here must mean that you are ready to set sail.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: My connection to the homeland has grown stronger.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: The everlasting lamp...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: It's getting brighter.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Do you trust me that much?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I felt the breeze, carrying fine sand across my feet.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Can my departed kins find their way back home, following this light?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: The salty sea breeze tells me that my homeland is not far away.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I will only shine for my homeland. As for you...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I have been searching for tens of thousands of years; a fleeting century is nothing in comparison. Until you reach the end of your life, I will continue to assist you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Would you like heading out to sea with me? Let me check the current map... 47°9' S, 126°43' W, we'll be going right there.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Are you planning to sail soon? Could you grant my humble request and let me join you? Just let me reach the sea...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: If you still trust me, please allow me to be the guiding light on this journey. However, even in such a simple task, I have failed before...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: I caused many disasters in the past, even nearly bringing destruction to certain civilizations... If I say it wasn't intentional, is it already too late?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
I am the guardian of the entrance to the Eternal Kingdom, guiding those who return home. How ironic that I, with such a duty, have forgotten the way back...
Will you... be my beacon?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: You seem curious about the appearance of my current vessel? Don't overthink it. I was born with a human face.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Eternal Kingdom
voiceLines.content: My homeland worships our God. Correspondingly, the King I follow is naturally a "divine communicator."

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tulu
voiceLines.content: Ah... His brilliance is so intense and dazzling, impossible to ignore! It was a foolish zeal that clouded my senses... No, I will not make any excuses for my stupidity...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Winkle
voiceLines.content: She often stays close to me at night. Is it simply because my head is too conspicuous?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution brings chaos and disasters. Perhaps my homeland sank into the deep sea because of it...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Here, I often sense the presence of my Lord, but perhaps I am not yet ready to face Him... In any case, thank you for offering me shelter.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I love the sea. Is it ironic? Everything I owned is now sunken in the deep sea...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I hate the sea, and for good reason. The ocean devoured everything I loved...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: I will serve as your guiding light in the darkness, but not forever.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Feel honored, for the gates to the Eternal Kingdom are here!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: I hope that next time, my homeland will answer my call.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: The gates of my homeland are drifting away... No... Not again...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: How about this?

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Please go ahead!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Come back.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Good!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Beware of the ocean's fury.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: This undercurrent will tear our enemies apart.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Must... I must return...

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Behold the magnificence of the Eternal Kingdom!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: No one can stop my steps toward seeking the homeland!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: You, the oh-so-great world-saving Keeper? Ridiculous. Wake up. This dream's gone stale.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Meaningless. All of it. Why bother?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Still counting on me to be your backup, "Savior"?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: You know absolutely nothing.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: You should know this is all pointless.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: This will only bring me closer to the Abyss.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The scent of death and annihilation... It's so vivid.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Is that fear on your face? Or sorrow? Truly captivating.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I got my answer. Not the one I wanted... but an answer nonetheless.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Curious what I saw at the universe's beginning? Sure, I can tell you. I saw nothing.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: That heroic, martyr look on your face... as if you're always ready to die for a "greater cause"... it makes my joints itch.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: I had annihilation right there, ready to swallow this so-called sanctuary... Then came the research ban. What a pity.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Yes, I had countless spare bodies and various plans to escape Dissolution. But I chose to pursue truth, and it was worth it.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: The truth of the world, its beginning and its end—all meaningless. But if you insist on chasing it... I'll guide you. Like I used to.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: You might stop me, but the end's coming anyway... I will save this school—and you—for last. We'll watch humanity's collapse from the campanile, drenched in the twilight of time.... Poetic, no? At least we won't have let our precious bond go to waste.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hmph. What is it this time? Ready to embrace your fate of anniliation now?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Her Inventions
voiceLines.content: I'd offer repairs for those "little trinkets" I made, but the question is... Do you dare accept my after-sales service?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Thais
voiceLines.content: That woman's wish is hilarious. Nothing can survive the Annihilation, not even her "god".

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Salvador
voiceLines.content: That bishop cannot save everyone. He might pluck one unfortunate soul from the mire, but the rest? ...I can't wait to watch his faith shatter.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Heh. That you are looking at is not death. Just your future. Mine. And everyone else's.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: "Resist the Dissolution crisis"... Ha. Human arrogance never fails to amuse.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Don't you think it's fascinating to push all things toward their end, to still the universe's turning gears?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I loathe your pretentious act. Think I'm mad? Pathetic? You're the Icarus here, "Savior". You and your little flock, eyes scorched white from staring at that glorious sun you chase.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Now we are simply water and oil. Never mixing.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Fine. I won't disappoint you... Promise.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: What a beautiful "Happy Ending." Isn't it?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Good. Now we'll simply fade into oblivion.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: If you say so.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Disappear.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Heh.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Foolish!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Hmph.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Whatever.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: How was that?

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Dying rats.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Revel!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Gaze into the Abyss!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Do not resist. Do not weep. Become nothing!

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Vanish!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Such a clumsy trick... Hmph. You naive fool. Did you truly think you could bind me so easily?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: The flames of hatred burn fiercely, never to be extinguished.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Those arrogant, despicable fools will die by my hand.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: My blade of vengeance grows ever sharper.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: What? You want to exploit my anger too?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: The scorching flames burn in my chest... Yes, I have never forgotten, nor can I ever forget.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Such sweet hatred, when seasoned with the blood of foes, is surely the most exquisite dish in the world.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: I think I just heard those who claimed to be my masters wailing again. How delightful.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I want them to experience what it feels like to have their lives turned upside down, lose everything, and be trampled by everyone.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: The humiliation I've endured, everything I've lost... I will make them pay. I will make them all pay.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: All who tried to control or use me ended up in the underworld at my own hands—I don't mind sending you there as well.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Do you think a few honeyed words and a few days of false kindness will make me willingly don the shackles again and become your plaything?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Yes, I did grovel before those people; there's no denying it. They took advantage of my ignorance, and I made them pay for it.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: I only regret not impaling their corpses on stakes and hanging them on the walls! I will spare none who betrayed, trampled, or insulted me!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: You have always clung to that amusing trust and stayed by my side... Fine, perhaps putting you to use isn't a bad idea. But remember this: I cannot tolerate any betrayal, especially from you.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hands off me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Myself
voiceLines.content: The Bloody Chain of Slaughter, Tisiphone's Messenger, Blade of Hatred... I don't care. That's just what they called me. Well, I certainly don't mind living up to them.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Lily
voiceLines.content: Coward! You possess a mighty power akin to mine, yet you restrain yourself. How is that any different from willingly donning a collar?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Agrippa
voiceLines.content: That "slave master," "owner of gladiators"... Ha. She is just a worthless insect.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Capable of corroding everything, erasing all... It was quite a weapon. If only I had known back then... Heh.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Don't deceive yourself. Mental shackles are still shackles and cannot be called fair.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Whenever I recall those traitors kneeling and crying for mercy, I feel a wave of satisfaction, and the flames in my heart seem to subside.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Look at these shackles on me—they're not decorations, but reminders. Reminders of betrayal and humiliation.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Every time I see you, I think of the invisible shackles you've placed on me. Allowing you to live is my greatest act of tolerance.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Pay the price for your actions.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Hatred may be alleviated, but it can never be erased.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: No mercy, no mercy...!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Die.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Disappear.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Move aside.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Back off.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Heh.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Just as expected.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Prepare to meet your doom!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Be stained with blood!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Feel my wrath!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: This is the will of the Three Goddesses of Vengeance!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Tremble under the chains of blood... Perish under the chains of blood!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: If you can still see me as "Ramona"... then please continue to use that name.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Please don't worry.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: In the end, I'm only...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: ...straying further from my former self.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: It's drawing closer...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Something is wailing... inside my mind.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: It feels like a veil of white mist is clouding my thoughts.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: The sound is louder now. The mist thickens.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Is that the sound... of the clock's hands turning?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: When the final bell tolls... will I still be here?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: The eye patch doesn't affect my sight. If anything, it helps me avoid seeing too much.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Too many mysteries, too many people who need saving. I don't know how long I can keep this up... I cannot protect everyone. It is difficult.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Do I look... unfamiliar? I've been trying to keep control. Her presence is growing stronger.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: I don't regret becoming this, Keeper; I'd choose it again. But I am afraid... afraid that the "Ramona" I used to be will leave no trace behind.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Make a promise with me? Promise that, no matter what happens, you'll remember "Ramona".

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Curious about what's under the eyepatch? I'll show you... when the setting is more appropriate. Do not be impatient.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tawil
voiceLines.content: Tawil... she is far more dangerous than we realize. When I'm no longer here, you must be extremely cautious of her.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About @2
voiceLines.content: Have you encountered the other Doll? The so-called "truth of the world" can shatter a calm mind completely. Will we... will you and I become the same?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Murphy
voiceLines.content: Compared to the noble ladies at that party, Murphy's temper is rather endearing.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: I've seen past events of the Dissolution in her memories... But every time I try to speak of it, my consciousness breaks. I believe it's her doing.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Mythag holds the most memories for me... it is also my warmest home.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Time spent with friends is always so... relaxing.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Ramona... I mean, I don't like farewells. They are too sad.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: As long as I am still "Ramona"... we are still partners, aren't we?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Time is limited. Let's move.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: We prevailed? That is... good.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Not enough... I'm still not strong enough.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: We will finish this now!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Caution!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Stay back.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (A soft, suppressed inhale)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: It is manageable.

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Disappear.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: An opening!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Finally... There is it.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Heaven and Earth, follow the cycle of causality!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: I will be the one to reveal the future!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Remember my name, Goliath. This name is destined to trample upon humanity's insignificant history.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Interesting... Aren't you afraid I'll tear you into fragments and feed you to the fish once I gain power?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Time to give this a try. Hmph. How about cutting the throat of a few weaklings first?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: You do work hard to be a Keeper worthy of me, I see.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Very well... You have a keen eye for recognizing capable people.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Don't get carried away. Sometimes, the line between the noble and the lowly is but a single step.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Not bad. One step closer to tearing off that hypocrite woman's veil.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: I'm regaining my strength... Next, I'll claim the dominion that is rightfully mine!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The reason to be stronger? In my tribe, the weak are stripped bare, their heads shorn, and subjected to the most vile disgrace imaginable—the cost of weakness is not one that everyone can bear.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: This moment has finally arrived, after thousands of years of waiting... I am the Philistines' one and only ruler!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Companions? Hmph... I don't need any. I won't be weighed down by the same burden twice.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: I must remind you that our cooperation hinges entirely on your power. Should your power wane, this contract will immediately cease, and I will sever your head without any hesitation.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I see the light in your eyes. That desire, that ambition... it burns. Admit it, mortal! We're the same kind.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Do you know the Albatross? They bravely confront the storms, but once banished to the ground, surrounded by mockery, those giant, drooping wings ironically become a pathetic hindrance. Anyway, this story means nothing... It just came to mind as I feel very relaxed to be with you—just casual chat.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Perhaps the times have truly changed. Nowadays, even the weak can surmount the reefs, command the waves, and become the king of the sky. Mortal, I await the day you rewrite history. It will be my honor to become the mighty blade in your hand!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Tremble before these muscles... They are always ready to sever your head.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Murphy
voiceLines.content: Oh, our puppet princess is weeping again. Is the milk bottle not fitting, or is the lullaby not soothing enough?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Miryam
voiceLines.content: A woman who would sail across the ocean alone isn't always a divine being. She's just as likely mad. I mistook Miryam for a goddess, and that was a stupid mistake.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Have you ever had D-Slime forced into your veins? The black goo coils around your heart like a viper, and then... boom! Your body explodes into a warm, pulpy mess. Disgusting, but effective.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Hmph, a haven for the weak to huddle together.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I love grilled octopus, boiled octopus, fried octopus... Some say I'm committing blasphemy. Ha, my apologies, but octopus is simply too delicious, hahaha!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Gods? Only fools would entrust their lives to such intangible beings. Instead of betting your life on the so-called gods, you'd be better off focusing on how to become stronger.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: With such a frail body, it's too much to ask you to be my companion. You are simply too weak; you must intensify your training. Come, I'll take you to the academy's sports club and open your eyes.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: The dice is cast. Now, finish this swiftly!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Well done. Time to celebrate the victory with a barrel of rum!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: The taste of being exiled and cast adrift at sea... Once was enough.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Foolish.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Too weak.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Hmph.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: That's all?

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Grumble)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Hahaha!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Taste my endless power!

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Absolute command.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: The raging tide of vengeance never ceases!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Nothing compares to the power of a Giant!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Behold! This is the power the Philistines rely on!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Hameln, at your service.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Tuning complete.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Glad you understand the importance of training.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: I will deliver a perfect performance.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: I think I heard a melody. Is someone rehearsing nearby?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Here it is again. What is this melody? Ever since I last heard it, it has lingered in my mind, refusing to leave or rest.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: It became clear, that winding melody, like the wailing of a soul... I'm sure I've heard it somewhere before.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Woodwinds and strings... interweaving upwards and downwards, the motif reappears... Now I remember, it's the requiem I composed for the prematurely deceased genius, the fallen star.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Almost there, just a little more. I must finish it; I must hear it!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Yes, yes, that's it—the final mass, a requiem for the music itself!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Music transcends language, writing, and everything. If this isn't perfection, I don't know what is.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Do you like this piece? It fully presents the motif in just four measures, with the wind instruments pushing the melody upward until the theme is reached. Such a design has influenced countless successors... Sorry, am I talking too much?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content:
In a symphony, the coordination between instruments is crucial; how each section joins and exits brings a different experience to the music.
What I mean is, if commanding Awakeners is a performance, you're doing well.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content:
I prefer expressing myself through music rather than words. But communicating with you feels like conducting an orchestra that has been rehearsed countless times—smooth, and often pleasantly surprising.
You hold a special place for both music and me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I usually don't extend such invitations, but... would you like to give it a try? Hold the baton and breathe new life into the music?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hmm? Do you have a new piece to show me?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About His Strategies
voiceLines.content: I don't enjoy spending time on strategy. Compared to music, the art of strategy holds little value. However, as a tool to clear obstacles, it is necessary. For the sake of reaching the pinnacle of music, I don't mind using it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Your Commonalities
voiceLines.content: In terms of technique, strategic planning and music conducting are no different. Humanity, emotion, desire... they are as clear and docile as notes on a staff, displayed before my eyes, dancing along the path of the baton. To understand music is to understand everything.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Reason and Order
voiceLines.content: Rationality and order paved the way. I walked upward and opened the gates of the hall. Beyond them, neither remained— truly eternal music transcends reason.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Each of us hides a melody in our hearts, trapped by reason and the body, only to be fully expressed in madness.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: I heard the performance of your so-called orchestra, full of mistakes. But no worries, I have a detailed plan to stage a perfect show before the Silver Frost Festival.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I can never forget the first time I heard the music deep within my consciousness. In those notes and chords, the real world vanished; only pure and sublime music remained.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: There is a concertmaster in the orchestra, but a concertmaster alone cannot make a complete orchestra. My orchestra has no place for those who only seek to show off.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Ah, Keeper, you've arrived just in time. Tell me, what do you think of this movement?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About His Friend
voiceLines.content:
I once met someone with an almost instinctual understanding of music. The concertos and symphonies created by this person were unforgettable.
A true genius.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Liz
voiceLines.content:
The green dancer possessed an elegance worthy of being the lead of a court troupe.
If given the chance, I truly hope we could collaborate.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About His Works
voiceLines.content:
I was once praised, but... that wasn't true talent.
My works were merely imitations of my predecessors.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Watch my hands, one, two, three.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Perfect performance.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: It's a pity. It seems more rehearsals are needed.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Forte!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Accent!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Da Capo!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Dal Segno!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Ugh.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Rude.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Pay attention to the beat.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Strings, begin.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: This melody is dedicated to the souls of the departed.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Only music deserves praise.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Listen, this is the final requiem!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Where is the target? As a token of gratitude for awakening me, I will take care of them for you.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: The blood of vengeance is boiling...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: I will use this power to devour the betrayer.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: ...Thanks.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: ...Thanks.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: This power feels good to use.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Being a monster is fine. All I've ever wanted was the power for revenge.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Besides eliminating your opponent, do you have any other desires? In return, I will grant your wish... within my ability, of course.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Ungrateful monsters, assassins, and killers—do they have any value that you recognize? Freak.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: A companion? ... I'll consider it. Don't die on me before I make my decision.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Don't approach me from behind, unless you want your neck broken.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Spare me the high-sounding talk. What do you want from me? There must be a reason for keeping my sanity intact.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Does my eyes make you uncomfortable? Good. That's the ferocity that kept me alive in that hell.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: My hands are stained with blood. My weak kin do not understand my revenge; they whisper about my cruelty, ingratitude, and betrayal... Revenge is always for myself alone, and no one else.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: My vengeance was always directed at the Spartans, but now, even that city-state no longer exists... Fine. Becoming your blade is not impossible. I reluctantly accept you as my partner, but if you dare to betray me, I will tear out your heart.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Do you have a death wish?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Lily
voiceLines.content: I can sense that the little girl possesses powers similar to mine. She hasn't fully grasped the extent of their strength yet. For your sake, I will train her appropriately.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Agrippa
voiceLines.content: That emaciated woman with double pupils smells exactly like a Spartan insect.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aigis
voiceLines.content: What kind of irresponsible parents would name their daughter after a shield made of Gorgon's head? ...She has no parents? Hmm... let's keep this conversation between us.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: People may betray, but tools never will. If used properly, Dissolution can also become a tool for revenge.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: In my time, schools were places for training warriors. It seems that is still the case now.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Likes? Someone once asked me that on the battlefields of Peloponnesus... It's too late. I've long abandoned such personal preferences.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Betrayal turns people into monsters, no matter which side they are on. That's why I detest traitors.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Are you always like this? Trusting everyone and turning your back to them? Naive.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Prepare to die, Spartan insect.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: The enemy's blood has not yet drained completely.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: I can't stop yet...

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Tekeli—Li!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (A scoff of endurance.)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (A scoff of endurance.)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (A scoff of endurance.)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (A ragged gasp of pain.)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: That's enough!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Taste the bitter consequences!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Exterminate!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Pay the price for your betrayal!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Traitor, taste my despair and rage!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: I am Horla from Cité, and my pen name is... Ah, forgive me, I made a promise not to reveal it to anyone. My deepest apologies, but please, simply call me Horla.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: The surge of power feels like searing flames burning into my very bones.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: The roses in the courtyard are in full bloom.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: The warmth, so near...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: When people approach me, they always recall their saddest memories and cannot help but shed tears. Can someone like me still hope to grow?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: If you truly insist, I will step back into the sunlight... the very same sunlight as the day I left Cité...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: With invisible ink, I sketch the deformed buds... This ghostly and ethereal rose branch truly inspires poetic verse...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: What do you yearn for? Is it the beauty of elegant words, widespread fame, or the heartfelt sincerity woven within those words?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: <Italic:"Press closer, little Nightingale, or the Day will come before the rose is finished...">

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I often feel as though I exist in the space between life and death. Wherever I am, melancholy spreads like a tide, and tragedies unfold, one after another. Even so, would you still wish for me to write a poem for you? Hmm... perhaps you deserve the sweetest one...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Someone once told me that poetry is written to be appreciated... May I hear your thoughts on this?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Have you ever felt this? Offering forgiveness for another's offense, only for the desired outcome to slip away. You extend a rose, yet your hands are left not with its lingering fragrance, but only the bloody marks of sharp thorns.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: That day, the flames of jealousy spread like a sea of blood-red roses in full bloom... All poems turned to shattered ashes amidst the crimson tongues of fire.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Forgive me, I lost myself in memories again. Please, do not look sad. It is your turn to narrate your story. Do you feel like writing a poem? Will your adventures, your experiences, your joys, your sorrows, flow like a gentle stream from your mind to your fingertips?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I was but a fleeting watermark on parchment, yet our encounter has caused me to linger. Perhaps this is a miracle. I will treasure this miracle and compose timeless poems for you.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Please, do not touch my neck... Just because you cannot see it does not mean it is not there.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Liz
voiceLines.content: That beautiful ballerina lady... Her emerald-green flames are irresistible, even if they burn one to ashes...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tinct
voiceLines.content: If poetry exists to praise beauty, then her very existence is like poetry itself. When she begins to sing, I suddenly understand what the elders described as a nightingale's voice...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Nymphaea
voiceLines.content: Every time I see Miss Nymphaea, I am reminded of that painting of water lilies. She carries the tranquil bitterness and fragrance of water lilies... I wonder what her world truly looks like?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Sorel
voiceLines.content: Madam Sorel is truly beautiful. Her strength and confidence, her graceful smile in the face of fate, and her vibrant yet resolute life force—all make me envious.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Casiah
voiceLines.content: I secretly watched Miss Casiah's magic show. Her performance brought such joy to the audience, but I always bring sadness... Do you think tears and smiles are equally precious? Perhaps...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Hanna
voiceLines.content: P-Please, do not tell Miss Hannah that I am hiding here. I am not ready yet...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Colette
voiceLines.content: Human emotions are as fragile and precious as flowers...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Poetry, flames, and sorrow are alike; they engulf you without notice... By the time you come to your senses, you are already immersed in the world of poetry...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: There is nothing in this world to hate. The golden years deserve praise, while the decline of old age deserves pity; the finery of youth is enviable, while tattered remnants evoke thoughtful reflection.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: My body was not affected by Dissolution; those black liquids are simply ink. But honestly, even without Dissolution, everything eventually turns into Illusion, does it not?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Mythag's Student Poetry Club wants me to be their advisor... I cannot agree. I do not wish to dampen their spirits, but I fear I would only bring them disappointment and discouragement.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ghosts
voiceLines.content: I've always sensed the presence of "ghosts" around me, like some inexplicable possession or bewitchment, draining my hope for the world. But if it's a ghost, how do you explain the milk and water vanishing into thin air...?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Cité
voiceLines.content: I almost forgot... What kind of flowers bloom in Cité this season?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Her Pain
voiceLines.content: The beauty of blooming flowers is matched by the sadness of their withering. No matter how many times I feel sorrow, I cannot help but stop and mourn for them. If I were to ignore them out of fear of pain, how sad these flowers would be...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Her Poems
voiceLines.content: Poetry and flowers are probably the same thing, are they not? Both are fleeting yet eternal. In this boundless world, they capture the most unforgettable moments in a small space... I think everyone has fallen silent for a poem, just as they pause to admire a flower's bloom.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Past Memories
voiceLines.content: In the Keygrave, I saw your name on one of the tombstones... The memories of life were painful, but I never intended to forget them. For the Keeper, those lost memories must be equally precious, yes?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper - 1
voiceLines.content: Your presence has rekindled the ink in my pen, allowing it to flow once more like a gentle stream. I will continue to compose poetry for your story.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper - 2
voiceLines.content: I wrote a new poem yesterday, but haven't shown it to anyone. It's not very good, but... {Male=Mr.,Female=Miss} Keeper, would you be willing to take a look at it?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: This is not my preferred genre of verse, but if you insist, I shall try.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Let this victory be etched in poetry.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: The day has finally come...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Sing for me.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Savor it.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Rhythm.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Afterglow.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: My pen and ink...

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: This is the wrong rhyme...

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Flames won't consume me.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Emerge for me...

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Burn, O soul of poetry.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Rose thorns prick my fingers, their crimson flowing into poetry.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Let the poems of the past awaken the hidden garden within your heart.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content:
What? Introductions again? Fine. I'm Jenkin, and this is Brown. "Squeak!"
Don't you forget it! You mess up our names, and I'll whack your *Beep* with my lantern!
"Squeak squeak?!"

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Eat what you get the moment you grab it. That's the law of the streets.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: I feel kinda full now.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Hmm.., I've got an itch. Brown, come scratch my back.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: So, this is what it's like to become an Awakener.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Even Brown's fur's gone silky.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Think I'll finally grow taller, then?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Time to get to work, then? Right, Brown, perk up!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Look, I might not be the best security guard, but you can trust me with any errand or delivery.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content:
Look at the way you watch Brown.
...Heh heh, the great Brown wants to chew on some coward's toes tonight. Who's the lucky sod?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Hey, West-Whelp! Seen Brown? That little glutton's sniffed out grub again.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content:
Getting lost in space made me sick to my stomach. You pulled me out, so just spit out what you need, but don't expect miracles.
I'm just a kid, you wouldn't push me too hard, would you?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: My "bad habits" ain't changing overnight, get that? Sleeping under bridges and in drains, surviving on scraps—it was hard enough just to stay alive... You can't expect me to make my bed right after waking up! Give me at least two weeks to adjust!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: The East Slums are no place for kids. Cunning old foremen would find every way to dock paperboys' pay, and n-nitpick milk boys' speed! To survive out there, you only rely on yourself. No one else is worth trusting.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
I've got Sis, Brown, plus that coward girl from the workhouse... That's my crew. Fine... I'll count you in too. Brown, share a scrap of candy with {Male=him,Female=her}. 
"Squeak?!"

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Wanna pet Brown? Not my call. You'll have to ask her yourself.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Nautila
voiceLines.content: What do you mean, "I took it"? It's not fair! When her stupid screws went missing, I was busy—Brown, stop! ... Heh, just forget what you saw, alright?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aigis
voiceLines.content: Why does that silly girl bolt the moment she sees me? Next time, I'll step on her yarn and see where she runs.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About "24"
voiceLines.content: Mason... No, this is fine. At least we're together again, "24".

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Even you can't cure this darn rot? Then why are you chasing Dissolution? You're barking mad.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: I threw away the mousetraps by the dining hall backdoor. What if that clumsy Brown steps on one?! It's too dangerous!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Who doesn't like a soft bed, and a draft-free storm drain... I mean, room.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Dislikes? Plenty of 'em. Bosses who work you late, self-righteous nuns, growling stomachs, black bread studded with glass...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: We're accomplices now, right? If you ever end up on the streets, I won't let you starve on scraps.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Quick, wrap it up! Don't linger on the streets.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Not bad, eh? Now, my payment.—What? You think this was a free lunch?!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Hurry, grab Brown and scram!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Go!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Take care!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: You can't scare me.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Brown...!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Oi! That's cheating!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: Yikes! Oh no...

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Wait for the right moment.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Watch closely!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Dig through the barrier of reality!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: I'll show you what a rat can do!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Don't mess with Londinium's best thief!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Hello, my dear new Master! Today's menu includes slug pudding, toad stew, and green flame wine. Which would you like?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Master's kindness, Karen dares not forget even for a moment!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: —Ah, it's so sweet and delicious!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Well... I'm on a diet and can't eat too much today~

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Ah! Thank you for your kindness, Karen is but a humble maid...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Awesome! I'm now even more motivated! I can clean twenty rooms a day!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: My eyesight has improved... Master, did you forget to comb your hair again?!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Maybe I've gotten stronger, but I don't want revenge at all. I just wanna sing! Dance! Party!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: This is the music that is as ancient as the lake water, belonging to "us." Master, let's dance together! We'll dance and sing, before my voice is taken by "Him"...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Master! My voice... it's fading... Help...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Sweep left, wipe right, let's wipe away the dust and worries~!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: My dream? Hmm... To buy a beautiful pearl necklace and wear it to a ball. Then I'll be the center of everyone's attention!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: We were drinking and singing when we suddenly turned into monsters! But it's okay, this greenish skintone is quite fun!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Still troubled by insomnia, Master? I've prepared Dobie's tranquilizer for you~! Although the dose might be a bit high, good sleep is the top priority!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: My hometown is beautiful! It's a stone city in a lake. Every full moon, we dance silently in the flames, worshiping... Honestly, when I first arrived in this school, I missed home every night and cried in bed. But now, I have a new home and family. Everything's getting better!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Ah! What time is it?! Sorry, Master... I shouldn't be slacking off! But... I'm so tired... Pleaseee?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Working
voiceLines.content: Hehehe, lalalla~ Cleaning, cleaning, I love cleaning, I love cleaning so much~

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Murphy
voiceLines.content: That woman Murphy dresses too flashy... No way, Karen can't lose to her! Or maybe, I'll just kill her...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
voiceLines.content: I heard a thief from the slums showed up, bringing along a fat rat? Hehehe... Watch me eliminate this menace for my Master!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution... Yes, there are records of it in the schools of my hometown, but, well, I hate reading. I don't remember anything!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Isn't the decor here too outdated? It's eerie, as if it's haunted.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Master, Master! Karen saw an incredibly gorgeous cameo brooch at Harold's today! Could you buy it for Karen? It's my lifelong request!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Hmm? Why is everyone silent? Karen hates the quiet. Let me tell you a story. Once upon a time, there was a mountain...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Hmm... Master seems upset? Let Karen cheer you up with a funny face, hehe! Are you feeling better now?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Pick me, pick me! Where there's a party, there's Karen!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: A professional maid will clear everything for her Master, including the villains~

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Please, spare my Master. D-do whatever you want with Karen!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Heyo!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Watch this!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Waah, scary!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Help!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: So satisfying, ahaha!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Let's dance! Let's dance!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Cataclysm descends!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Welcome! Let's have a blast together!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Here's your meal!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: You in trouble, kid? Kathigu-Ra's coming, and she's bringing Destruction. Say goodbye to your problems. Poof! Gone.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Fine work keeping your iron clean. A polished gun's a happy gun.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Fire's burning brighter. Wanna see a real fireworks show, little one?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: C'mon. Let's burn this whole world to the ground!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Wanna make the flames burn even brighter?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Listen. That's the dying cries of melting stars.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Ah, the taste of power... Shall we find some poor bastards to try it out on?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Those unnamable things slither in the dark, gnawing at the edges of the world. Sooner or later, you'll have to face them. But don't worry, I've got your back. Always.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I see clearer now. I see what writhes beneath the abyss... I, We, require more power. For you. For my family. I must...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: We are the Fire. The Eternal Flame. The Undying Chaos. And We will bring you all... home...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Looking for salvation in this ugly world? Keep at it, hopeful little one.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: After a good hunt comes a good feast. Here, try my roasted camel and fresh tequila. What? You're not good with liquor? Fine, well, have some juice instead.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Here, you can have these. Forbidden relics from some ruins. Was gonna burn them, but figured you might get some use. How'd I get my hands on these? Let's just say some folks <Italic:voluntarily> handed 'em over. And don't worry, source is clean.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Don't push yourself too hard, Keeper. I know it's rough out there, and one wrong step means disaster. But if you keep this up, you'll break. Come find me when you need someone to talk to. We're family.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
Come here. Sit closer. No need to be so stiff. 
Funny, isn't it? When we first met, I never thought I could let my guard down like this. Ha, the mighty Living Flame, yearning for a family she could fully trust.
Now, promise me something. When the day comes... when you can't hold on any longer— speak My name. And I, We, shall come. We shall take you into Our Kingdom. It may only delay the inevitable... but in your final moments, you will rest, cradled in Our embrace.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: What's wrong, little one? Need a hug? Come here. Big sis has got you... Haha, don't be shy.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: What do I think of Dissolution? Ask a sewer rat what it thinks of the king. My answer is simple: a deep, instinctual disgust. Give me the chance, and I'll pour a glass of camel milk wine and listen to their scream as my guns burns them to ashes.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: I only come when there's work. Need me? Say the words. Come on, repeat after me: ...@4...@2Ia! Kathigu-Ra!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Burn and Destruction are my everything, I'm obsessed with the death that comes from hunting... Do you really think I'd say something like that? Haha. I only ever cared about my family... Even more than myself.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Those sick bastards playing with human lives in the dark? Yeah. I'll kill 'em all. Every last one.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You're my family. And I'm damn proud of you. So stand tall, my %player%! No matter what, I've got your back.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About N
voiceLines.content: I'll find Him. Doesn't matter where in this rotten universe He's hiding. That filthy rat's gonna pay. Every last bit of His "rapture and delight" will burn in hellfire. Rest assured, I'll save you a premium seat at His funeral... so we can savor His final screams together.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Thais
voiceLines.content: The legendary Queen of Aram, the Great Aeon of Desire, Tifere Yesod... I saw her once, when I was hunting N down. Don't agree with her methods, but... if it was the only way to protect my family from "Its" gaze... I'd have done the same. We are not so different, her and me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Guns
voiceLines.content: You know, these guns don't fire bullets. They shoot desire and malice. Seven shots, and everything burns. These chaotic flames, resembling flesh, will drag everything into the inferno.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Family
voiceLines.content: Back in that shithole town, we survived by being meaner than the rest. Even after clawing our way up, we had to watch our backs—lords, guards, those damn "noble knights" clinging to the past. Now's different. They are my family. My Kynde. No more bowing. Just one little stray left out there... but that one? That one's gonna be just fine. Always took care of the rest for me while I'm away.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: That's your enemy? Then the hunt is on.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Hunt's over. Payment? Give me a smile. That'll do.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Fall back, I'll cover you... Don't you fret, I always make it back alive.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Bang!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Disappear.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Stay calm.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Back off.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Ugh!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Damn it.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Welcome your end.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: The Amber-Tinted Death is here.

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: In the forge of infinite wrath and desires... Burn!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Blazing fire, rise from ash and oblivion!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Burn. Shatter. Howl!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: I am the Living Flame—unforgettable, unstoppable! Witness now, THE ANNIHILATION OF ALL!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: I followed the scent of blood to this place. May I ask... do you have fresh blood for me?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: You don't have to do this for me...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: My heart is a bottomless pit, never to be filled.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: That didn't make me feel a thing, but... I'm still terribly grateful.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: No need to worry. My pain threshold might be far beyond your imagination.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Is it just me? Or... Did my craving for blood diminish somewhat?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: My dear brother's flesh and mine are merging more perfectly...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: I'm more resilient than you think. Be more forceful when you're using me. Please, don't hold back.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The feeling of being bathed in sunlight again... I didn't know it felt so nice, so warm. It brings tears to my eyes.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: To express my gratitude... I will construct a hidden altar for you in the depths of my anguish.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Ah! Your blood... it tastes like mead. I suppose I'm the only one who knows this secret, right?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Here's a secret... I actually detest blood. I hate its color, its taste. But I can't live without it... I swallow the blood, then vomit it all up... Ah, how I hate myself.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: That basement was filled with water, soft and cold. Thus, my body was always enveloped in moisture... As if I was the only physical being left between heaven and earth. Sometimes, I truly wished to dissolve into the water. But then I wouldn't exist and would never meet you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Blood flows like a river. I am yours. Never have I felt so strongly.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: In my fantasies, a valiant knight drags me out of the darkness, then binds me in chains. {Male=He,Female=She} can hit me, curse me, do anything {Male=he,Female=she} pleases—pain is my proof of life. Would you... be my knight?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hmm... Harder, harder. Yes, just like that...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Blood
voiceLines.content: The blood of the dying is a slick liquid. With just a light cut to the neck, the blood flows between the teeth, turning into warm streams that slowly fill my belly... Heh. Delicious.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Sewer
voiceLines.content: You can find everything in Londinium's sewers: salmon, soap, half-drunk whiskey... Why do I know this, you ask? I once dragged my brother's corpse through five miles of it...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Uvhash
voiceLines.content: Uvhash... He reminds me of my brother, bringing back memories of dark, cold, and sleepless days.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: I think I've been afflicted with Dissolution again... My heart is getting Dissoluted! Just a few aspirins, a whip, and some pain should do the trick to cure me...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Today, I broke the school rules again by arriving five minutes late to class... Therefore, I sincerely request the harshest punishment, preferably carried out by you personally.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Don't be fooled by my appearance; I was once a noble lady, too... I embroidered, I read Tennyson... Oh, and I once sang songs: "She flows like an endless river through my veins..."

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I detest bright, soft things. Gentleness is like a mirror, revealing all my ugliness, greed, and fragility.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: I must accuse you, Keeper. Your kindness makes me uneasy—only physical pain feels real and stable to me.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Sorry, the sunlight here is a bit glaring... An underground mouse like me still needs time to adjust.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Ah, time to get fed. Hehe...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: If I am taken as a hostage, what cruel fate awaits me?

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Does this feel good?

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Be careful what you wish for.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: How do you like this?

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Hmm... Not bad.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Groaning in pain)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groaning in pain)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groaning in pain)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: This is my proof of existence.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Hurt me as much as you want!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Heh... Hahaha!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Savor it... the sweet taste of death.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: The Shambler from the Stars extends her invitation... to you.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Master... I need orders. Please give me orders.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Lily has grown bigger.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: The pustules are happy, too.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Thank you, Master.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Are these... for me? Can I eat? Really?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content:
I'm stuffed... My stomach is full.
Will Lily become stronger after this ritual?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: They are chirping happily. Thank you, Master.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Mommy, would you like to pet them? They're said to be very soft.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I'm happy by your side, Mommy.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content:
A warm and fuzzy feeling in my chest... Lily, Lily is so happy, the tears are...
Mommy, let's celebrate together.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content:
Any order for me, Master?
"Don't walk outside with the pustules. People will be scared," you say?
Understood. Lily will hide them right away.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: No tearing up food, No crushing the cafeteria's seats... Okay. Lily won't do it again.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Can I call you Mommy?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content:
Not all Mommies are the same. Some are good, and some are bad.
You are a good Mommy.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Mommy, can I sleep next to you? When I'm alone, I have dark, scary dreams. My hands and feet would fall off... It really, really hurts...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hmm...? Mommy, uppies? ...You're so warm...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Her Smile
voiceLines.content:
Do you want me to smile?
Am I... smiling now?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Daffodil
