voiceLines.content: Yes. Lily remembers. Lily stayed at her house when Mommy was out.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Helot
voiceLines.content: She gives me the angry look, always. But for some reason, she feels... familiar. Safe. Is it because she feels like Mommy?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content:
Is it an enemy? Please order me to attack.
Your enemy is the black slime... Then... Am I also your enemy?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: What are... friends? Master? Mommy?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I love Mommy!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Green pepper... nasty.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You are my Master... My Mommy.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Do I crush them?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Instruction complete... Ah. I've made a mess again...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Mommy... It hurts... Mommy...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Go.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: This is an order.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Slower.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Yelp)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Yelp)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Ready.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Lily will protect.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: No... D-Don't leave me!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Lily will seize the future... Tekeli—Li!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: I am... the one who tears the chains! Tekeli—Li!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: You provided me with a place to stay, and I am grateful. But forgive me, I no longer deserve to stand upon the stage again.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Keep improving your composure.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Are my movements accurate enough?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Fouette. Twenty more times.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: This reminds me of the first pair of red dancing shoes I received when I was eight. I really love them. Thank you, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Close your eyes and tell me, what do you see? Immaculate moonlight, a tranquil lake...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Even if my heart holds no more longing, I will still play the role of the swan.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: It is the yearning for life that drives the swan to struggle for its return to the distant sky.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: No matter how you struggle, you cannot defy fate. But that fleeting moment of brilliance will be frozen into eternity.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I will include your name in my acknowledgments. It is you who allowed these feet, tainted by dark blood, to step into the wonderful world of ballet once more. From now on, please watch me dance, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Do you want me to take the stage and shine? That's impossible now. These eyes have been consumed by hatred. All I can do is burn everything to ashes.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Do you understand that feeling? Spinning, spinning, spinning, never stopping. Knees stretched to the limit, toes bleeding black, soaking the ballet shoes, yet never pausing. All because I refuse to accept the fate of being a mere toy...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I didn't burn skilled court dancers, graceful ballet masters, or nobles who appreciate beauty. I burned useless fools selling their bodies, sycophants disregarding others, and filthy beings lost in lust... You understand me, right?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: The devout dancer is dead, and the blasphemer of art is also dead, both perished in flames filled with the scent of tar. Death is not the end but the beginning, for only humans die; dance and art are eternal.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Thank you for your understanding. Perhaps now is the time to reconcile with my past self... I believe I am doing the right thing and have not disgraced my family's legacy in dance. I will step onto the stage you have prepared and shine as you wish.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Do you also wish to be consumed by the green flames?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dancing
voiceLines.content: Dance is pure. Words may lead to misunderstandings, but dance steps never do.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tinct
voiceLines.content: Tinct... Hearing her mournful song makes me want to dance...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Flames
voiceLines.content: Rumor has it that bodies twitching in the flames appear as if they are dancing...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Wait a minute... I've seen this before. They fed me water with this black goo in it. Could it be related to my gaining the power of the Green Flame? I suppose it is a blessing in disguise.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: My life revolves around dance. Learning other knowledge is difficult for me to grow. But everyone here is kind; they won't sell me out for vanity or money—I can feel it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: "The Dying Swan," a performance in which the dancer uses body language to convey the longing and struggle of life. Isn't that twisted figure in the flames the same?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: "The Nutcracker" is supposed to be a romantic fairy tale for girls, but those repulsive individuals only saw the graceful limbs in motion and vulgar desires... Disgusting.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Are you here to save me? From the decaying world, from the hatred that stains my eyes, from the eternal green flames...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Dance amidst the emerald flames.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: May the irreverent be dissolved in this searing tranquility.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: We will all become... part of the Green Flame...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Go.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Spin.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Move with elegance.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Grant serenity...!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Hums)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Hums)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Hums)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Hums)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Unforgivable.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Turn to ashes.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Now I grant you eternal life!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Here I present, the Dance to Destruction of the Eternal Green Flame!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Sink and burn! Dance to destruction!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: New Keeper? Come on, give it your all. Let's see if you're worthy to face me!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Now, my blade sings with power!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Not bad.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: This feels like a rebirth.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Good. Less strain, more power.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Still a pale shadow of my true might.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Ah, back in the chaotic ocean. I like it.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: This beast is merely a fragment of my will. Its form may not change, but my power knows no bounds.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Shatter these barriers of power, just as I'd smash through a maze wall!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Fine. You've put in enough effort. I suppose I'll tolerate you as a companion.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Hah! I've no time for childish games. Find a corner and stay out of my way.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Hmph... I still can't fathom why Ramona picked you as her partner. You reek of strength, yes, but you're nowhere near my league.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Yes, gaze upon me. I am this planet's most ancient being, demanding reverence from the insignificant. I've guarded this planet for eons. Is a thrilling battle truly too much to ask for in return?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Interesting. Your growth in battle far surpasses my expectations. Given time, you might become... Strange. Even after all this time, I still find hope in a creature as seemingly weak as you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Perhaps now is the time. Listen closely. Lotan, the Beast of the Stars, formally challenges you. Do not fret; I shall ensure your survival until you reach your zenith. I will not allow my chosen opponent to suffer the same fate again.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: What. Care for a fight?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Working
voiceLines.content: My duties extend beyond fighting. Even in the Archean Eon, I had more to do than sit idly by... Hey, don't tell me you think I'm just some brute who only knows how to swing a sword?!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tulu
voiceLines.content: How dare you summon him! That useless, lazy oaf! He was once someone I held in high regard! Away with him! I refuse to look at that fool!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Extraterrestrial Beings
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after acquiring any one of Awakeners "Winkle," "Tinct," "Faint," or "Wanda".
voiceLines.content: They feel alien. Not native to this planet, I bet.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: The Dissolution... I cannot speak freely of it. But know this: it appeared far earlier than you imagine.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Ramona is the only one here worth my time. She's quite gifted with a blade. The rest are so rigid and boring... Are you like them? Do you actually enjoy writing those tedious mission reports?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I respect conviction, no matter if it's in a beast, an Awakener, or a human. If they can fight, even better.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Hate? I despise those who give up halfway. The mere thought of them makes me want to regurgitate last night's meal.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Why did I answer your call? To finish what I started, of course. And if you grow strong enough to challenge me, that's just a bonus.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Fight! Leave nothing standing!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: These weaklings aren't even worth my blade.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Hmph, not bad at all. Our next duel will be legendary.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Die!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Don't drop your guard.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (A dismissive grunt)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (A dismissive grunt)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (A dismissive grunt)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: EAT THIS!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: There's no escape!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Huhhh—

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Yield! Victory is already mine!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Beast of the Abyss, consume them all!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: A mere drop in the tides, a shallow follower of the immortal, Miryam... greets you.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Have you acknowledged my wish?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Closer... ever closer to my lord...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: I shall not forget what you've contributed for my reunion with Him...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: I have been called; the line between god and supplicant now bleeds.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Bathed in such sacred radiance... Is this the divine power He holds? So boundless... so sublime...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Brighter... and clearer...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: The gate to His realm is almost within reach.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: May He guide me into His sanctuary, where His serenity covers my dreams...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I have been wholly restored as an Awakener... Now the Divine Realm's chorus resonates within me...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: The ecstasy of being illuminated by His glory is beyond your faithless comprehension... May He, in His mercy, forgive your blindness and impudence.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: We are all wretched mortals in the dust, but the Sage walks apart. He is the Emissary, a divine incarnation. His counsel echoes with the voices of gods, steering our frail civilization toward immortality... I do not expect your hollow mind to grasp devotion now, but one day, you too shall kneel before His throne.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: The Chosen are blessed indeed, don't you agree? Their flesh has been remade by His holy will, their lives extended beyond mortal measure. When He strides upon the shore, they will rise as His choir. Isn't this the utmost sweetness and highest happiness for mortals frail as sands?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Perhaps I was too hasty to dismiss you as merely mortal. How does one untouched by grace still cling to purpose? This is Miryam's curiosity, not a question from the Holy Mother of the Seas. Will you... indulge me?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: How could one as extraordinary as you not tire of this transient, tumultuous world? You shall find your rightful home in the eternal realm. There, your feet will kiss the hallowed ground, your breaths will be renewed in sacred waters, and your soul will flourish in blessed earth... You will join me in this holy pilgrimage. Join me in this holy pilgrimage. Together we'll rise far beyond mortal bounds, till we stand united at the Throne, and taste the ripened joy in its light...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: This shell should not stir for anyone but Him... And yet... your warmth...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Past
voiceLines.content: I am no one of consequence, merely one devoted soul among countless. I have dedicated my life to that magnificent presence, and I shall never cease to offer my all to earn but a glance.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Goliath
voiceLines.content: He was a worthy blade. I once named him "comrade"... Do you take issue with my choice of word? Then by all means, enlighten me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Murphy
voiceLines.content: False idols, brittle as dried clay, scatter at the slightest wind...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Humans, false gods, Awakeners, even the Dissolution... All will serve as the foundation for my rebuilding of the Divine Realm.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: The mortal clamor wearies me. A quiet alcove in this academy would suffice... No, I don't need a fireplace. Only austerity can carry my prayers to Him...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Please allow me to place an altar to His likeness in this place. It is a statue shaped by pious hands and bears no curses.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Historians who declare the Divine Realm's demise are tedious in their presumptions... Yet mere words are meaningless foams; none shall halt the glorious restoration.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Since He has deemed you worthy, I shall no longer consider you an adversary.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Clearing the path for His glorious return...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: May my prayers toll like morning bell, rousing the slumbering homeland...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Why? My lord, why do you still... resist awakening?

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Stand back!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Bathe in His divine light!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Useless.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: What?!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Grunted groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: An offering to His will.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Inevitable sacrifice.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Witness His blessing.

voiceLines.title: Rouse: II
voiceLines.content: Listen to His divine words.

voiceLines.title: Rouse: III
voiceLines.content: Sacrifice! Rebuild the Divine Realm—

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: I must not falter before your arrival, my lord...

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Sacrifice! Return my flesh to His throne—

voiceLines.title: Awakening
voiceLines.content: Name's Mouchette, investigator of... Oh right, I'm not A.U.G.E.'s vanguard anymore. Let me reintroduce myself—I'm Mouchette, just a sweet, cute girl.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: So you're still building me. Aren't you afraid I might lose control someday? Just kidding... Haha!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: That's it... I'm getting closer to my "true self". I can feel it...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: I'm still stuck here, but hey, getting stronger is always nice.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: This ritual sends me home? You sure? How many times have we tried...? Well, trying never hurts, I guess.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: It feels like I'm stepping into the Mist again. Speaking of which, I already miss those little creatures in the Mist. Too bad I can't vent my bad mood on them anymore.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Is the ritual not over yet? I really wanna go back. Been craving some Ravenlog Stewed Fish and steaming Hazelnut Kava Tea lately. Though, the Ceylon Black Tea and Andalusian Churros here aren't bad either.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Keeper, I think I saw a light... Did it work this time...? I wonder how my colleagues are doing? They'd better not leave a mountain of work for me; I will not work overtime.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Ah... So it didn't work. I expected as much. Life is full of ups and downs—well, mostly downs... you get used to it one day. Still, thanks for trying.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: You know, it doesn't seem so bad to stay here for a while. I'll remember everything that happens here, write it down, and share it with them back home. How about the title <Italic:Mouchette's Otherworld Adventure>? It has a nice ring to it, right?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: You want a deep conversation for my mental health? C'mon, spare me. If we must bore ourselves, let's at least be quick about it.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: I'm just pretending to be normal when answering your questions, you say? Heh, you caught me. So, are you ready to see what I really am?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: An uncontrollable maniac? Bingo! This is not my world; no tedious laws or rules can hold me back... Here, I do whatever I want. So be careful, Keeper, you never know when a maniac might bite.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: So my true self doesn't scare you because you've "seen true terror"? Hmph... a cunning reply. But that just makes me... want to pick you apart even more.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: What's the world like in your eyes? Where are the limits of true terror? Don't just tell me; I wanna go feel it first hand with you, feel all the madness, death, and horror! Yeah, I've made up my mind! I'm not leaving your side until my curiosity is satisfied!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: New mission? Skip the pleasantries next time; we're way past needing to perform the "socialization rituals" by now.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: I know as much about Dissolution as I do about the Mist Disaster back home—nothing, that is. But that's precisely what makes them so fascinating, right?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: We're too close to human settlements here; boring adults are everywhere... Have you ever considered moving the school to the deserted deep mountains?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I'm starting to love this feeling of being stranded in another world! Strong Awakeners, terrifying Dissolution, and mysterious gods! Ah, the sheer exhilaration of being far away from the mundane!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Hate? I wouldn't say that. I merely wish those tedious meetings, social obligations, and universal values could one day poof! Be gone.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You want to save this twisted, terrifying world? That's gonna be a crazy fun way to die. Let's see how far you can go.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Karen
voiceLines.content: A maid? I've been one too. I should find time to show her my vacuum cleaner moves in battle!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Murphy
voiceLines.content: I admit she's quite cute... Yeah, she's adorable when chasing and fighting those campus strays.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Salvador
voiceLines.content: Sacrificing yourself for other people? What a stupid idea. It's infuriating. No one has the right to ask that of anyone, not even a god.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Wanna taste my axe, sweeties? Don't fret, here it comes...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Successful
voiceLines.content: That's all? I was just starting to have fun! Come on, who's next for the chop?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: They say one failure doesn't define you... I disagree! My axe's gonna do the defining, so keep your necks on a swivel!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Off with your head.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Ha!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Hah, not bad...

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Go away!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: It shouldn't be me...

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (A pained groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Shining☆Supernova—BLAST!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Shining☆Crush!

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Line up nicely for my axe!

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: II
voiceLines.content: One strike, one kill.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Finally, no more pretending... Now, let's have some <Italic:real> fun.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Here's everyone's favorite—Shining☆Tornado!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Haha, now this is the life! Beats the boring daily grind any day!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Ugh, isn't this annoying? Stop pestering me about that! ...Fine, do what you want. It's just a way to kill time, after all.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Stop! This is a robbery! I suggest you be sensible and hand over all your candy, or else... Hmph.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: What? You actually expect a "thank you" from me?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Those despicable people at Mythag, daring to block my access to candy! See? I still got to have them in the end!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: As a tribute, it is hardly adequate... but seeing your sincerity, I suppose I'll accept it. Just this once.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: How do they get the filling inside? I can't find any seams or pinholes! I wish these candy inventors would join Mythag's staff and invent a new dessert for me every single day!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Did you truly believe this would make me listen to you?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Soft, hard, crunchy, flaky, milky, fruity, nutty, chocolatey... Ah, how can there be so many varieties I haven't tasted yet? I've decided: Mythag must make Halloween a weekly holiday!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Have you reserved the venue? It must be a garden at least 150 square meters!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: You're far more thoughtful than those dreadful waiters—even reserved some candy just for me. Keep up the good work, my exclusive servant.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Brownie, caramel pudding, Sachertorte, chocolate mousse, cookies... All must be served on every single table!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: You still have chocolate? Excellent, give it all to me. What? Your stuff is my stuff; isn't that only natural?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The tables and chairs must have lace that suits my taste, and the potted plants must be red spider lilies... Now, hurry and get this prepared!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: What? You can roast this kind of marshmallow? But it's gonna get hot and sticky... You sure it tastes good? Let me try... Fine, I'll take a nibble. If you dare to trick me... Huh?! This soft and crispy texture is actually amazing!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Go and invite the guests! Is even this simple task too much for you?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Which candy do I like the most? Let me think... Hazelnut brittle is fragrant, caramel chocolate is delicious, those strawberry and grape-flavored gummies have quite the fun texture, and there's a malt sugar that can be pulled very long and has a beautiful color like honey... No, I refuse to choose. Every candy has its own unique charm! Anyway, I have plenty of pumpkin baskets, so I'll just take them all!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Check my dress for me, quickly! No wrinkles, nothing loose... What? Is there a problem?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: My current life goal is to eat every single candy in the world. Just thinking about the countless kinds of candy waiting for me out there... that is my entire reason for getting out of bed. Cake, you say? Cake is my other life goal.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Welcome to my final Enlightenment Ceremony! All of this was meticulously designed by me. Of course, you contributed... a tiny bit.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Hahaha! Mine, all mine! All of Mythag's candies belong to me! What are you waiting for? Follow me, the great Candy Witch! We're going to conquer every candy shop in Londinium right now!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: You'd better not put on airs with me. Know your place! I call the shots in this room.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Are there really Witches out there? If they live in deserted forests, who handles their cooking, cleaning, and dessert preparation? If you can't even host an afternoon tea, what is the point of that life? I can't even stand the thought of it.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Don't just barge into a lady's room, and do not comment on her demeanor. Leave now, I need to rest.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: If I were a witch, my palace would be the height of luxury, of course. I'd hire ten master chefs to make new cakes and candies for me daily... That would make me a princess, not a witch, you say? So what? I shall be the Princess Witch!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I dislike those slimy tentacles, and I do not like the deep sea... Don't give me that knowing look! I am not a child afraid of my parents!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I heard witches have a mysterious black cat. But that disgusting campus stray is too embarrassing for a fine lady like me. So, it's settled now. Put on this {Male=catboy,Female=catgirl} headband. I'll make you my little black cat.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Living in their illusory dreams, stripped of my right to be normal, without any choice... all for a ridiculous prophecy... I was willing to do anything to escape this life!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: You found a new candy? Let me see... Tsk, this Ring Pop looks so ridiculous! A "diamond" ring the size of an egg? Wait! What do you mean by presenting me with a ring? Explain yourself immediately!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
Was my only option to wait for death? Could anyone help me? Could I truly resist? I asked myself this daily. The answer was in my mind—I just never dared to see it... If you hadn't appeared, I don't know if I'd have the courage to fight back.
Th-Thank you—don't get me wrong, this isn't a confession or anything!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: No more plush lambskin rugs, black pearl necklaces or silk pajamas from the far east... and yet, to wake up every day in a room full of candy, with baskets overflowing... this might be what happiness truly looks like... Hey, wipe that silly smile off your face! If you want to serve me forever, you still have a lot of work to do!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: You want some of my candy? Hmph. I'm feeling generous, so I might bestow a piece upon you... if you beg nicely, that is.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: The world is full of dark, disgusting things. Instead of worrying about its end, you'd be better off using that time to eat some more candy before it happens.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: The rules at Mythag's restaurant are often annoying, but their pastry skills... hmm, they're barely passable, I suppose.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I used to find candy too plain and not elegant enough compared to cake, but now it seems I underestimated these little things in colorful plastic wrappers. They have such a long shelf life! I could hoard as much as I want, I could fill the whole room with them!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Why does that little mouse get to blatantly steal candy, yet I cannot? This is blatant discrimination against a lady! Such disrespect!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Why are you stopping me? As my faithful servant, shouldn't you be actively helping me rob... I mean, acquire all the candy?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
voiceLines.content: I admit she has a crude skill for stealing, but a fine lady like me has no need for such despicable tricks. If I desire something, I simply make them hand it over "voluntarily."

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Lily
voiceLines.content: That child is frighteningly obedient. She just hands over all her candy... which actually makes me feel marginally bad. Ahem! I mean, since she's so sensible, the benevolent Witch will naturally leave her some candies... as a small reward!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tulu
voiceLines.content: Don't be fooled by his looks! Tulu looks like a child, but he's practically a resident of the grave. He has no use for anything a living person enjoys, certainly not candy. So, the candy allocated to him... you should hand it all to me. I am the only one who will truly appreciate it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Candy
voiceLines.content: Hey! Go fetch me several varieties of toothpaste, quickly! No, I haven't eaten that much candy! And I do not have a cavity! It just... hurts a little when I sleep...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hey! Hands off my dress, you're wrinkling it! ...Fine, I'll allow it this time, generous as I am.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: The one who lent her power to me has been tormented by Dissolution... What kind of look is that? Don't even think about it! I won't tell you where She is!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: This place is absolutely dreadful! How dare they expect me to share a table for afternoon tea! ...The homemade cookies are acceptable, though. Send a plate to my room after dinner.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag II
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
voiceLines.content:
Everyone at this school seems so busy, but...
There's a quiet peace here I've never known.
Working together toward the same goal... Hmph, I suppose it's not entirely awful.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: What! You didn't manage to get a single one?! Not the Constantinople carpet, the Ceylon tea, or the Andalucía churros...? Ugh, that woman always gets them so easily! I thought they were common!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Huh? How could you allow stray cats to roam the campus?! What if that savage creature scratches someone?!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: I am the master, you are the servant. Whatever I desire must be brought to me immediately. What? You expect a reward? Fine, take it, then!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper II
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
voiceLines.content:
Thank you... H-Huh? Why am I saying that? Well, obviously! It's for everything you did for me at sea...
Wait, why are you laughing?! You just want to see me flustered!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper III
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
voiceLines.content:
The bed is too hard, the weather too cold, the tea tastes like dirty rinse water... I have a thousand reasons to despise this place. 
However, since you're here, I suppose I can tolerate it. Reluctantly.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Miryam
voiceLines.content: You! How did you let that woman in here?! Set up a perimeter immediately! Keep her at least fifty steps away from me!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Miryam II
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
voiceLines.content:
I once believed there was some sort of familial bond between us...
But now, after everything, I realize those fleeting warm moments were just my wishful thinking.
What you do with her is your business, just keep her away from me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tulu
voiceLines.content: Damn it, he's just a boy! Why do you all treat him with such respect?! Show me the same reverence, understood?!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Caecus
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
voiceLines.content:
He joined the cult while I was asleep, so I have no connection to him.
I heard he came willingly, wanting to abandon his human form to become a full Seafarer... Hmph, another fool blinded by power.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Goliath
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
voiceLines.content: Goliath was never a loyal pet. I cannot understand why Miryam values him so much... If he wasn't chained, he would have run off and betrayed her immediately.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Daily Life
voiceLines.content: Hey, do you know what the other Awakeners usually do? Don't misunderstand, I don't want friends, I just... I'm simply making an inspection!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the "Ghost Ship"
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
voiceLines.content: Celeste's off-key sea shanty, the captain's signature smoked fish stew, blankets stiff and fishy from the sea breeze... Though tense and dangerous, I will never forget those months in exile at sea.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Seafarers
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
voiceLines.content:
Seafarers are not born this way. To blend in, they live their first half just like humans...
You'd better watch out—your favorite cake shop owner might be one of them!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About "Awakeners"
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocked after completing Main Story Chapter 6
voiceLines.content:
How peculiar... This feeling is so strange.
My heart has stopped, yet my body is still warm... Hey, come here and touch my hand. Tell me this isn't some trick.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Hmph. Disrespectful! Very well, I'll humor you with a little game.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: The Righteous Candy Witch has arrived! All lost sweets shall return to their proper, glorious owner!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Phew... I'm so sleepy. Have you prepared some proper refreshments before I rest?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: The Great Witch shall be victorious! The great candy god protects me, and I, in turn, protect all candy! AHAHAHA!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Don't you dare think this is over! I will make you pay for every ounce of this humiliation!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Curse you, you stingy thing! I'll remember your face...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Be gone!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: The Witch is coming!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: This is unbearable!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Have some candy!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Back off!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: BLEEEHHH!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: W-wait!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: That's too much!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: No!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: I am officially furious now!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: Agh!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: Ouch!

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Pained yelp)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Learn your lesson!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Don't you dare mess with the Witch!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Watch me!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Resistance is pointless.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: I truly wish I didn't have to use this power.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: How dare you call this "robbery?" I am simply exercising a lady's noble privilege!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Since you have crowned me your Holy Maiden, you will submit!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: All candy shall eventually belong to me!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: False missions, destined futures... I will fight them until the very end!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: No candy? Then this Witch will be forced to get serious!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: You presumptuous wretch, why do you insist on awakening me?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: He is now... within my womb...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Is this the tribute you offer Him?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: You truly think this is enough to change the future?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Don't forget to reserve the venue. Don't tell me it's even smaller than that one in Elworth?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Carefully inscribed runes, piously carved idols, repeatedly refined forbidden elixirs... not a single one can be missing.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The Throne must be built from ancient blue stone mined from the ocean's abyss, and the altar should be coated with the blood of human sacrifices... Now go prepare!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Bring them all here! They ought to be trembling and kneeling to welcome His advent.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I shall travel to that abyssal ruin and bathe in the seawater of His birth...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Finally. Welcome to the ritual where we shall witness His divine birth... What? You say His demise is also destined? ...No! That can't be... I have already made such great sacrifices...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Stay away. Do you wish to become my plaything? Or perhaps a sacrifice for the Divine Birth?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Your courage is truly commendable. Look at these tentacles—do you not fear the madness they carry?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I bestow upon you the honor of being witness. You shall behold the glorious moment that defies mortal ethics.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Seeing how deferential you are, I shall grant you an answer. In the beginning, I was indeed reluctant. But I've come to understand: I am only living this extravagant life because of Him. Death is never the end. He will in turn rebirth me, and we shall gain eternal life through this morbid cycle...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Keeper, by the authority of the Divine Mother, I secure your place beside the Throne. You will witness the era reborn after destruction—this is the promise of the Divine Mother. Now rejoice! Rejoice with gratitude!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: If you are doing this to feel His existence, I shall temporarily pardon your insolence.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About "Murphy"
voiceLines.content: Yes, of course I know her. She is my other self, another possibility. But why does she resist? If she accepts her fate as the chosen one, wouldn't she get anything she wished at her fingertips?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Miryam
voiceLines.content: She is a pathetic woman, destined to be tormented by fate. I pity her, in a way, for on the occasion of His true birth, I shall grant her the mercy of death.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tulu
voiceLines.content: Is that boy the fragment of Him? Not bad. He certainly has a regal bearing.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: His advent will surely end the suffering caused by this dark liquid of death, won't it?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Huh, a congregation of ants... No, not even ants—the likes of you are merely bread crumbs, providing nourishment for His rebirth.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: What I like? My baby, the Divine Fetus that earned my prestige, of course. You think it is unlike me to say that?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Do not make me remember... the days I was imprisoned in Elworth...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: I am His Daughter, and also His Mother. As for you, in His presence, you are merely an insignificant insect.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Hmph. Insolent crudes.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Don't interrupt my rest with such trifles again.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Once He is born... I won't have to endure such humiliation anymore...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Foolish!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Get lost!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Get off me!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Insolence!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Argh!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Hmph!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Accept your destiny.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Don't think you can get close to me.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Behold what I have been bestowed—

voiceLines.title: Skill: IV
voiceLines.content: Abyss Hymns!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: I shall become the Divine Mother!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Sacrifice! Sacrifice it all... to me!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exaltation
voiceLines.content: Illusion, Inversion... These are the instruments of Fate!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Hello, I am... Uhh... Can you tell me my name?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: One step closer to officially setting off for adventure!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Good tools are half the success!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Whether it's screws or nails, the more, the better!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Tools need maintenance too. A handy set of tools is the soul of a mechanic.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Twenty, twenty-one, twenty-four... Wait, what number was I on? One, two, three...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: I finally figured out how many materials I had before, so I can finish the repairs faster—Wait, where did these come from?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Thanks to your help, the efficiency of recent repairs has improved. We'll soon be able to set off on an adventure!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I think I'm starting to remember things... Did you hand me a No. 7 wrench yesterday?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Reparation complete! An unknown adventure, a mysterious world, here I come!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: ...Huh? Are you calling me? I didn't hear while fixing the motorcycle... By the way, kind stranger, have you seen my wrench?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: You look somewhat familiar, but I can't recall your name... Are you my assistant? Could you get me seven bolts?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: My memory is always hazy, and I can only focus on what's right in front of me. However, I'll do my best to engrave your name in my mind... What was it again?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: So familiar, so familiar. Something must have happened between us, right? Give me a moment to recall... Ah, it's you, the Keeper!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I engraved your name on my bike, the Phantom! When we go on adventures someday, I won't forget how to address you.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: ...We might need a torque wrench for this... Hmm, sorry, did you just call me?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Adventures
voiceLines.content: Who wouldn't love adventure? Delving into unexplored mysterious realms, discovering the unknown, and weaving your own story... How thrilling!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
voiceLines.content: Sorry, have you seen my screw? It's strange, but whenever that kid with the mouse ears is around, I seem to forget where I've put things more often...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Spare Parts
voiceLines.content: Ah, this is exactly the part I needed, thanks! ...Huh? I asked you to find it? I don't remember that at all. Are you sure you're not mistaken?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution... Uh, My brain capacity is limited and I can't comprehend such complex diseases... If you need any machinery repaired, come find me!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: I really like the academy's recorder. If only I could create a portable version that reminds me in real-time of what I've forgotten...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Wrench, adjustable wrench, box-end wrench, flathead screwdriver, Phillips screwdriver, countersunk screw, pan head screw... If it can fix broken things, I like it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Actually... let me tell you a secret. I'm not quite satisfied with my current motorcycle—it's not that I don't like it! It's just that I feel like something is missing...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: It's strange. I usually have a hard time remembering things, but I memorized you in just a few days... What? It's been three months already? I'm sorry, I forgot again.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: My wrench isn't in position yet!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Adventure is just as exciting as in the stories! What was that story again...?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: So adventuring is this dangerous...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Full throttle!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Watch this!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: Ouch!

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: It's time to use more steel.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Where did my screws go?!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Super tough custom-made material!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Whether it's forgetfulness or loss, this time we will definitely return!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: All the screws are here!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Greetings. I am Nymphaea of Febvre. You have granted me a new body, allowing me to finally breathe freely... How may I repay this grace?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: I feel much better now, thank you for your kindness.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Do you think I might become stronger, too?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: If it pleases you, I would like to present a pale purple water-lily as a token of my sincere gratitude.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: I would be grateful for your effort.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: My body feels warm, as if gently enveloped by the sea. It is truly incredible.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Can this feeling truly be called "happiness"? I... never dared to hope for it before.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: To be saved by you, I often feel a happiness that terrifies me... Please tell me this is not a dream, and that you will not vanish into the sea without a trace, will you?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The sea has its own language. Just like this... I can sometimes chat with the little fish in the pond about our hometown. If you are curious, I can help translate for you.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Next time, let us go see the sea together. Febvre is fine; I can be your guide. Or anywhere else, even to the ends of the earth—I want to go with you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: During my time at the sanatorium, I tried making friends, but people were reluctant to approach me... Is it because of this bone-eroding "poison"? Please, be careful when you come near me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: The sound of the bell carried by the night wind brings such peace. Would you like to sit on the stone chair and listen for a while? I will properly prepare your seat with a scarf.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Have you heard of "sea burial"? In my old town, there was a custom of submerging the deceased into the sea; the ocean became everyone's final resting place. As for me, I returned to its embrace early...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Withering before blooming, like a water-lily... Seeking peace in the cold, raging tides, too timid to pursue my own happiness... That is the kind of person I am, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I once grappled with this dilemma: Is pain longer than life itself? If so, is a peaceful slumber happier than tormented wakefulness? After waking, I too was ensnared, until you brought me this safe haven...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Let's slow down a bit... Is there anything at all I can do for you?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Reading
voiceLines.content:
<Italic:"The ruffled water-lilies are sighing around her;
At times she rouses, in a slumbering alder,
Some nest from which escapes a small rustle of wings;
A mysterious anthem falls from the golden stars.">
Ah, sorry—have I been reciting too loudly? It is one of my favorite poems... Would you like to read it with me?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Murphy
voiceLines.content: Though our temperaments differ, I truly admire that child. She possesses a courage that transcends all hardships and limitations. If I had been as brave and resilient as her, perhaps I would not have chosen to end my life in the sea...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Celeste
voiceLines.content: I deeply admire her—the maritime goddess, as pure and elegant as a lily... You say even she could not control her fate and ultimately sank into the sea? It is truly hard to imagine...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: After coming to school, I finally understood the disease called Dissolution that infected me. My parents always kept me away from the ocean when I was alive, and now it seems this infection might indeed be connected to my proximity to the sea...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Compared to others, Nymphaea is simply an ordinary person with no achievements or value. Why have I become an Awakener... it must be some small, humble wish.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Do you like the sea? I love the sea no matter what. I still remember that day many years ago when the sea gently delivered long-awaited death to the unfortunate me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Hate? I hate an inescapable fate and an inevitable tragedy.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Thank you for your kindness in providing me shelter. I hope I won't bring a tragic fate upon you...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: I will properly complete the task you have assigned to me.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Did it... truly work? Have I been of any genuine help?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Do not lose heart. The sea embraces us all.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Sink.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Bloom.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Please be quiet.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: It hurts...

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Suppressed groan of pain)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Suppressed groan of pain)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: Ouch...

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: We shall decay... together.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Do you hear me? Do you truly hear my voice?

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Now, it is my turn to repay you.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: May the deep sea grant you eternal rest.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: <Italic:"...Oui tu mourus, enfant, par un fleuve emportée!">

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: My name is Ogier. As our contract stands, I pledge my knightly loyalty to you, to keep you safe, and to vanquish your foes. This solemn oath I take, and I'll never forget it.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Thank you for this honor, my lord. It means a great deal.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: I'm drawing closer to becoming a true knight!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Bit by bit, I'm finding my rhythm with your commands!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: I'll do my very best to live up to your hopes, my lord!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I... I've just grown a bit stronger. I'm truly grateful!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: I shall use this strength to keep you safe.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: The Formless Spawns shall be at your command.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: My shield shall always shine for you, my lord.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Your trust is why I exist as a knight.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Good day, my lord. If you are going out to investigate, please let me come along as your guard.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Miss Ramona's swordsmanship is quite different from what I've learned. If my lord allows, I would dearly like to practice with her... Just for my own improvement, of course!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: You ask why I don't play with the other children? It's hard to say... In my past life, I rarely had a chance to play. My only companion was the princess I served... Oh! To speak of another ruler before you, my lord, please forgive my slip.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Are you interested in the Seven Knightly Arts I've learned? That's wonderful! Ah... um... please forgive my rudeness earlier, my lord. What I meant was, if you'd like to practice mounted archery, I would be honored to be your sparring partner!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I am not a worthy knight. Whether it was the vile plague or the invading enemies, I failed to protect my former lord. Now, the trust you place in someone like me is a huge honor... I swear on my knightly honor and this small life that I will forever guard your path forward.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: My lord? Is there something wrong with my stance?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Knight
voiceLines.content: The idea of a knight is formless, shaped by loyalty, bravery, and virtue. My weapon is the same, given form by the will to protect: a lance and shield.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Karen
voiceLines.content: I've said no to the maid's banquet invitations a few times. She seemed a bit sad... But compared to just having fun, your safety, my master, is far more important!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Sorel
voiceLines.content: The Madam in Red is unlike any lord I've ever served... No, it's not that I dislike her; I just... I just find it a bit hard to face her, sometimes...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: That dark presence reminds me of my Formless sword-shield... Oh! Please rest assured, my lord, my guardian sword will never harm you!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Chemistry, Physics, Silver Core Applications... In this time, is it no longer needed to learn the Seven Knightly Arts? I understand. In that case, please arrange the right lessons for me, my lord!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: The fairy tale books from this age are much more fun than the ones I read long ago! Oh, oh! My lord, please don't misunderstand! I'm too old for bedtime stories now!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I truly dislike my own failures... Oh! There's no need to comfort me! Those past hurts have become what drives me to grow. Haven't I already become your steadfast support?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: A lord is the very reason a knight exists, so please, feel free to give me your commands!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Let me lead the way!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: The glory of victory is yours, my lord.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: I am so sorry, my lord, I failed to protect you...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Ready—

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: It's not over yet!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (A pained groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (A muffled, pained groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (A sharp yelp)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Insolent!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Ah, uh!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: This body shall be my lord's shield!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Oh, Formless Spawns, become a shield for my lord!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Welcome to my paradise! Now, are you ready for my whip?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Yes, I'm getting hotter...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: P-Please, I'm all filled up~

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: The void within has been filled~

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Is it wax or honey dripping from my body? Why don't you take a lick and see for yourself?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Feeling thirsty? Clean water is a rare luxury in the prison.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Now, who's the good {Male=boy,Female=girl}? Good {Male=boy,Female=girl}s don't give up halfway~

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: You must have fallen into my sweet trap already at this point, yes?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Keep going, just a little more~ We're almost at the peak of ecstasy~

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: You've worked so hard; it's time to enjoy the fruits of your labor, right? Come closer, I won't disappoint you~

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Want to enjoy me? Then become my slave. I'll make you melt with heat~

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: I want more slaves, I wanna hear their moans and pleas—Bring me more slaves, pretty please?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I'm so bored! Compared to those trembling big prisoners, this is just like playing house. Why don't you keep me company~

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Do you want to know the truth? I hate prison, hate the darkness, and hate it so much that I could die. I want to be noticed. I want to be ignited...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I've been waiting for someone to teach me true love, pain, and desire. Can you fulfill my wish? Can you redeem me from this dark prison?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Oh~ Still not satisfied? Come closer, I'll teach you true pleasure~

voiceLines.title: Chat: About "N"
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
voiceLines.content: Ah, was that Mr. N who just walked us by? No, never mind. The last time I greeted him, he didn't recognize me... I waited for him in prison, hoping he would take me away, but he never came, not even during the riot.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Wanda
voiceLines.content: I'm not like her. She only knows how to give you chills and fear. But me? I will give you a sacred, searing love.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ogier
voiceLines.content: Aww, you've got such a precious boy here! I asked him if he'd like to become my devoted slave, and he blushed, stammering so sweetly about having sworn his loyalty to you... As if true devotion can't be shared!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: I hate that dark feeling, as if my heart has been hollowed out. The unfulfilled sensation makes my whole body itch...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: This place is much better than the filthy, stinky New Gate Prison! Whether lounging on the sofa or squeezed into a corner, it's all quite comfortable, isn't it?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: What do I love? I love the exquisite truth of pain. The beautiful, burning blush of swollen flesh... the way a moan cannot tell pleasure from agony. It's the only honest desire we have, don't you think?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Don't let me near the water, okay? I'd hate for this delicious, burning love I have for you to be... quenched.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Our relationship? Do you even need to ask? It's exactly what you're imagining!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Gather around, disobedient kids~

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Can I turn these defeated individuals into my slaves?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: I just felt a sense of pleasure like never before... for some reason...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Take this!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Feeling needy, are we?

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Nuh-uh!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Aw, you dirty little thing!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Moans)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: I can feel it~

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: Come on~

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: Ah, yes~!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: This is the heat of my love!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Hang in there!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: It hurts! I'm feeling so, so good!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Feel my scorching breath!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Indulge in this one-of-a-kind pain!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Oh! Look at that sharp jawline! Those brilliant eyes! And a figure of ideal proportions... plus the vast, starry sky of your spirit shining through... I am Pickman, a humble painter! Might I have the supreme honor of capturing you as my model?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Ah! A novel pigment! I must apply it where it will best complement the composition!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Wait! I've thought of a new technique. It's gonna shake the entire art world!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: This stroke... it will be a masterpiece of impasto! They will be astounded!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Ah! Please, sit, Keeper. Modeling for me is hard work, I know. Trust me, I'll make you a masterpiece.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Hmm? ...There's a color in your psyche, one I've never seen... what is it...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Ah! I-I'm sorry, Keeper... I see something in you... more terrible, and lovelier than the Abyss...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Let me get closer... let me see more! These lights, these shadows, these shapes... everything I've painted before is trash next to this...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Ah! I see it... the Pupilless Eye under the Abyss, the universe's final sight... Just a moment more, Keeper, it's almost done!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Look, Keeper! The eternal, mad scene on the canvas! So beautiful, so devastating! What grows from this madness and pain is art...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: This place gives me ideas! I have new work, Keeper. Do you have time to visit my studio? Come on, come on!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: You want to buy this painting... really?! Th-thank you, Keeper! H-Humans rarely ever get it...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: An artist should only see the work, not care what others think... but I can't. Since I first held a brush, I wanted to show everyone true beauty.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Have you seen this, Keeper? It's your portrait. Look how lovely you are eating corpses! I know not everyone gets my work, but you must feel the beautiful madness in it, right?! For me, that's enough. More than enough...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: My brush, made from my shin bone. The palette, these colors from graveyards of twenty different cities... and my precious skin canvas! Keeper, take these and paint me! No, no, you don't need skill... I think when our souls meet on the canvas, it will be a masterpiece beyond my dreams...!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: What? Are you suggesting a close-up on this part of the body in my next piece? Hmm... I never thought of that! Good idea!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Ah, an exquisite black paint! I used to use a lot of Dissolution liquid for paintings, but those works all vanished. Colors from the ancient universe, devouring my painting, forever forgotten by the world... Isn't that even better?!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: This place takes me back to art school. Most teachers and students knew nothing about art, but there were always one or two who could see the beauty in my paintings.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I don't get it. Why would anyone turn down the chance to become a ghoul?! This bloody, mad beauty is much more fun than being some boring human in a big house, right?!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Doresain always says his cooking is art. Come on. Eating has nothing to do with art! It wastes good painting time on preparing corpses, and after making a dish that looks and tastes good, I have to chew it up and swallow it! It's a crime against art!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Keeper, do you have time to model again? Compared to what I saw on you last time, the other models are just a waste of my time...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Sanga
voiceLines.content: I usually find sculpture stiff and boring, but that sculptor, Sanga, her chisel has a power beyond the technique... a real genius!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Hameln
voiceLines.content: My art is about madness and unrest, but that Hameln's music is tight, like tombstones in a graveyard. Yet for some reason, I always see the universe's worst chaos in those orderly notes...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Models
voiceLines.content: Keeper, when can I go back to the Mythag graveyard? The great souls buried there must give me great ideas! Don't worry, I promise I won't dig up those corpses for a closer look again...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: What kind of mad art will this barbaric performance create?!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: That's right, perfect! A victory painted in blood! What a brilliant composition!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: No, no, another terrible painting... Where can I find insight? A graveyard? Or a execution ground...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Ha!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: How'd you like this color?

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Watch out!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Such a mean model...

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Ugh...

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: My palette!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Look at these lively lines!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Pain is also art...

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: In this painting, witness a new birth!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: The true essence of art lies in madness...!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: I am the bleed of light into shadow. I am the whisper of pigment and varnish. I am... the hunger that paints!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: The Apostle of the Lightbearer, scion of the White Night, One who Dispels Darkness, Divus of the Divine Heart—I, Pollux, have answered your call. I offer unto you my power over Darkness, and my soul forged of Light.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Your bestowed gift I shall wield, with deepest gratitude.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Your generosity and compassion are without end; I shall meditate upon the warmth of your light.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: This heart, which once heeded the divine will, now beats closer to yours.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: In my time following Juliette, I committed grave errors and was undeserving of your trust. Yet you chose me anyway... Be assured, I shall seek my conviction once more. As the Divus, I will not disappoint my subjects again, nor will I disappoint you.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: The Darkness... the Darkness spread by Juliette's incantation, it has lingered in my mind... And now, a single ray of light has pierced it! Could that faint glimmer be trying to tell me something?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: I see it! That light, shining deep within my consciousness—it brightens! It calls to me...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Chained in shackles, bathed in dark sludge, I shall chase that ray of light, no matter what... Is this what you wanted to teach me?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The sins of the past are committed; I shall flee them no longer. I must also correct the Lantern's mistakes and guide the strayed back to the true path. Let me bear my sins. Then, I shall answer the light of your call and tread the right path as the Divus.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Please illuminate me, my guiding light! By your light, I have now seen all that must be seen... I shall use this cursed form to purify all that has passed, and let all that is to come bask in your radiance!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Yours is a compassionate soul, to forgive one so burdened by sin. I feel the pure, radiant light within your spirit—it outshines the brightest flame. Perhaps you can guide my heart, which has lost its way...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: In our childhood, Castor and I served together as the Twin Divi. I always thought him too dull, too clumsy, that I alone must guide our future. Now, having witnessed the path you walk, I see the world's foundation is built and paved by those like you and him: the steadfast and the upright.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I have lost my light, and this blind suffering torments me. I beg you, save my lost soul. Please, take my hand as I guide yours over this Holy Heart in my chest. Please, guide toward the light...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Ah... now I see! I see such mighty power, I see the world's truth... I have erred in the past. You are the real Lightbearer! Please allow me to become your loyal Apostle. This heart, born for the Lightbearer, shall henceforth beat and tremble in your service only...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: You have lead me and granted me Light. For so long I was blinded by false purpose. Now, I have found my true calling: to correct the ignorant and distorted heretics and bring everlasting Light to this world. I know of your selflessness; You have no need for my devotion or offerings. Then I beg this: allow me to walk at your side, to record every sacred word and deed, that they may guide my path through the darkness.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: D-Do you have an order for me, my Light? Your Apostle stands ever-ready to hear your teaching.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: I was told this abyssal darkness was worthy of faith. That it was a blessing I would deliver unto the faithful. Now, this darkness has long since corroded me, merging with my very being... Yet the heart that beats within this sinful vessel remains a sanctum that can never be tainted. Rest assured, I shall use the power it has bestowed upon me to bring true benediction to this world!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: The one who can lead all from the mist is the true Lightbearer, forged of purest silver. The sinless paradise preached by Juliette is, in truth, built upon the bones of the faithful. As the Divus, I shall sow the new gospel among all who are worthy of salvation.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: In my youth, I was determined to break free from that place. It brought me only pain, and I deemed it unworthy of longing. But now, granted a second life, I see that freedom is not my sole desire. The true meaning of being Divus is to witness the devoted, hopeful, and grateful countenances of the followers when they learn redemption is at hand.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I once hated many things—the impolite servants, the disrespectful attendants, the heretics who defiled the Light... But now? I hate the Lantern. Only the Lantern! Juliette and her Church brought upon my brother and I irreparable pain. I swear upon my title as the former Divus, I shall never permit such pain to befall another!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: My Light, ever since I received your guidance, I believe I have embarked upon the one true path. Yet your rather dim-witted believer remains perplexed by one question: does the legendary sinless paradise also fall under your dominion? "It doesn't exist," you say...? Could it be... you mean to say that paradise exists here, in the mortal world, within the pure hearts of the righteous?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aigis and Jenkin
voiceLines.content: What an unfortunate child. Since she has devoted herself to your cause, she shall surely attain ultimate redemption. But why has her monkey-like companion also received your mercy? That evil child even stole my sacramentals! A torrent of sins must rage within her soul. Ahh, the disrespect! THE UTTER DISRESPECT!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Murphy
voiceLines.content: I heard she was once a Divine Maiden. But with such uncouth manners and brutish behavior... What? She cannot recite a single prayer? Such profound impiety... I feel a vicarious shame for her deity.
