voiceLines.title: Chat: About Miryam
voiceLines.content: Ah, that overzealous believer. The world might see her as a raving madwoman. Though she once committed evil, such fervent devotion—the will to offer everything to her god—is a resoluteness most ordinary souls could never muster. What do I think of her, you ask? ...I only feel... a certain commiseration. A kinship, with one cast adrift in the same turbulent sea.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Salvador
voiceLines.content: That priest's blind pursuit of redemption is the height of folly. Divine grace should be bestowed solely upon the devout and the righteous. If even he, an apostle, lacks the discernment to separate the wheat from the chaff, rewarding unrepentant sinners and allowing them to defile his deity's kingdom... is that not the most profound betrayal of his faith and of the righteous souls he claims to serve?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Castor
voiceLines.content: Ha... After all this time, he hasn't changed one bit. I never imagined as a child that I would be the one to hurt my brother—that I'd come to owe him so much it aches with shame, for a fate we did not choose. We have suffered enough separation. Now that I am back, I swear: nothing will ever separate us again. Not even death itself.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: I shall bring Guidance and Judgment; may the White Night purge your sins!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: I will herald your glorious name, and all that is unclean and impure shall be purified by its radiance.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: You blasphemers... will be punished...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: In my name!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Filth.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Begone.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Tsk.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Impudence!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Chanting Light!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Purge your sins!

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Punishment！

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: I shall walk the path of light until my final breath.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: My heart is alight!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: May the Lightbearer's radiance pierce this endless night!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Ramona Dexter, just call me Ramona. I'm looking forward to working with you, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Shortcut methods may give a boost, but don't neglect skill training.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: So this method applies to me as well...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: A wonderful feeling.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: It feels like something is boiling inside me. Is this what it feels like to undergo Enlightening?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Besides combat ability, my memory and logical thinking haven't improved much. Indeed, I shouldn't rely on something else to think for me.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: It feels as refreshing as reading "On the Origin of Species" in one go.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: I've gotten stronger. Let me try handling the next mission alone, alright?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Now, the line between me and the Awakener is even blurrier. Take good care of me, will you?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Let's go. We have a world to save.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Whether it's the Awakener Affairs Office procedures or the date for Indian food in the canteen, I can answer any question about Mythag for you. Don't worry, you're not bothering me. Do I look that unapproachable?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Are you curious about my relationship with Professor Dexter? It's no secret. He is my foster father. As for my mother... I grew up here at the school and was cared for by all the teachers. However, among them, I am closest to Professor Doll.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: You've met that woman, right? The Awakener in a white veil—she's one of the university's founders... But honestly, I don't like her. That aloof attitude, as if she doesn't care about the world at all, really gets on my nerves... Oh, you think she looks like me? Let's go get your eyes checked at the campus clinic.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Ah... It's natural for you to have concerns. I didn't think it through. As your partner, I should have explained this from the start. As you can see, I do possess some unusual traits, likely tied to my background. It's impossible not to be curious, right? But having a place like the academy is a blessing for me, so I choose not to lift the veil of fate.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: "With such abilities, am I truly still human?" I have asked myself this every day since I started training for battle. I love this world, despite its darkness, filth, and monotony, but your presence makes it shine like diamonds amidst the dust. I once feared that as my power grew, my stance as a human would shift... Now, I am grateful to have you by my side. Our bond anchors me firmly to the human world. Please continue to watch over me, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: You don't know what to do? If you're bored, just go write up some mission reports.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Studying
voiceLines.content: Your assignment is done, right? Can you come with me to the downtown... Eh? Your math homework isn't done yet?! Ah... sorry, I didn't expect anyone not to understand calculus... Let me help.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
voiceLines.content: I hope Jenkin and Brown are enjoying their time at the academy. Father's cufflinks are insignificant. If Jenkin wants them, she can have them. I'm sure he has a whole box of spares.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Thais
voiceLines.content: You'd better not get too close to Lady Thais... No, I'm not jealous. I'm just afraid someone might fall for her tricks.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution is the reason this academy was founded and why we met. To save humanity's spark from Dissolution, let's do our best, partner.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: If you want to know about the academy's past, I suggest you look through the archives. Come on, including its predecessor, that's a history spanning 300 years! You don't really expect me to recount it year by year, do you?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I don't have any particular favorites. If I had to say, the feeling of going out on missions is quite nice.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Theory classes are pretty boring. I secretly read investigation records at the back of the classroom. Don't tell Doll this. It's our secret, okay?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: I've been looking forward to your arrival even before you were officially admitted. It seems we're working together quite well, huh? Partner.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Go! Issue the battle command!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Good job! Do you still have the energy to keep going?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: I guess... human strength has its limits...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: It's now!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: How naive!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Leave it to me.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: I can still hold up.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Leave it to me!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Dive into the depths of free will!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: With this deductive reasoning device... I shall interpret the world!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: This is how we will comprehend the world's mysteries.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: What's up, you wanna go gamble? ...An investigation? Aww, nah, that's a waste of a lucky streak...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Feels like my dice are rollin' a bit hotter today!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Wow! Your luck is burnin' hot right now!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Lucky~

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: This beast's sense of smell? That's just luck, alright? Don't get it twisted.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: My luck might not rub off on my companions. You know the saying, right? "A rabbit's foot isn't lucky for the rabbit."

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Sigh, I owe you too many favors to keep this secret: Actually, I might be the unluckiest bloke in the whole world.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Seems you didn't take my warning to heart... Ah, never mind. I'll still help you tear through the enemy. After all, these claws and fangs were won by chance, right?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Still wanna bet on me? Guess living carefree isn't as easy as it looks. Don't worry, I'll solve your problems... with plenty of breaks.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Well, looks like we gotta bring out the big guns, right? Where's the crime scene? I'll burn every last bit of my luck to bring the suspect in before the deadline!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: You keen on this fur? Wanna touch it? Don't worry, I don't mind!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content:
Perfect—fancy a gamble? Win, and I'll share a secret.
But careful, Alva might catch you~

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Hmm? You wanna ask about that photo in my wallet? Ah, that's the old me. This current look was a... gift, from my gambling buddy and rival.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Do I ever regret? Not a chance. Life'd be too boring if everything went smoothly, wouldn't it?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Course there are benefits. I met my Watson, didn't I? Compared to that, dying and a change of look don't matter much.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Aw, you're interested in my new look? Guess there's always a trade-off. Gotta be one of my lucky breaks—that's Ryker's luck!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Salvador
voiceLines.content: I just can't get along with that guy. Life isn't all about sin and punishment, is it? What's wrong with seizing the moment?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Others
voiceLines.content: That man... Hey, hang on, our bet's not over yet, is it?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
voiceLines.content: That kid's sharp; you need that kind of wit on the streets. If I was still out there investigating, I'd definitely buddy up with her.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution... worked a case that touched on it. But disappearing seems pretty natural, doesn't it? Everyone vanishes in the end.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content:
Mythag University's a great place, especially with the underground casino that pops up every week...
Wait, you didn't know? Oops, let the cat out of the bag.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Likes? Good luck, obviously. I always look for a good omen before heading out.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Dislikes? A pipe that runs out, a missed carriage, rain on new shoes. Basically, any bad luck is a pain.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Our relationship's like Sherlock and Watson, right? You read the latest magazines?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Alright, let's start this with a win!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: With enough luck, anyone can be invincible.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Whoops, my bad! I'll make it happen next time, promise!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Wouldn't hurt to be a lil reckless!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Bang!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Ooh, that was a close one.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Hey!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Oops!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Not bad.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: ALL-IN!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Lady Luck, smile on me just this once!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Hit, Stand, Blackjack!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Make it an easy win! It's our total victory!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Our meeting must be a promise from the Father to those who suffer. You are the Pale Flame that dispels calamity, and I shall be your arm, standing faithfully by your side.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: The tempering of a person involves not just the body, but the heart as well.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: If I can free this world from its suffering, I shall be content.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Give me your commands, Pale Messenger. May your flames ever light my path.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Those with strength must not use their power to oppress others, for you all share my blood." I remember the teachings of our Father God of Compassion. I will use this strength only to protect those around me.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: This warmth deep within my soul... Thank you for this gift, Pale Flame. With this power, perhaps I can finally fulfill my duty as His emissary and save more of His children.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The All-Father once said: 'Suffering is not my creation. Bear and dissolve it, my emissaries, and build a land without suffering.' For this, I would offer everything. Even my life.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: In the face of the all-consuming curse of Dissolution, other sufferings pale. Even if I cannot bear the curse for others, I will do my utmost to alleviate their pain.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Am I now able to ease their pain and comfort their souls?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Thus, I shall bear all suffering, to pave the way for all beings to a land free from pain.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: There is no need for courtesy, Pale Messenger. There should be no barriers between us, for we are both the All-Father's creations, walking together on this muddy and testing path.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Will you pray with me, my Pale Flame? Let us pray for those who died in our battle today. Though cursed with dissolution and madness, they are still children of the All-Father, our brothers and sisters. May they now find their deserved peace.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: No, I do not fear them. I feel only sorrow for those poor souls tormented by Dissolution. I know I cannot bear their suffering for them, but I would give them all that I have if it brings a moment's comfort.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Regret? No, of course not. My death eased their suffering and bought more time, and that is enough. But... as you have been honest with me, I shall not hide this: the pyre that day left its scars upon my heart.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Even though the red flames make me uneasy, I would step onto the burning platform for you once more. Do not dwell on it, my Pale Flame. My sacrifice is insignificant next to the blessings you bring.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Your hands are warm, like your soul. I... appreciate your touch, Pale Flame.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About a Chapel
voiceLines.content: A chapel? Thank you, but I am not so old-fashioned. As long as I keep the teachings of the God of Kindness in my heart and follow His will, my soul will never stray from His glory.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Fatigue
voiceLines.content: The burden of guiding light can overwhelm even the purest of saints. If you feel weary, my pale flame, please confide in me. I will do everything in my power to ease your burden and share the weight of these countless blessings.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: If I had known sooner that those people were tormented by this all-consuming curse, I... No, it is not too late. I must eradicate it, and eliminate all suffering, even if it costs me my life once more.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: They call me a master counselor? Those children are too kind. I simply do my best to listen and help them release their inner distress—as I have always tried to do.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: A world untouched by sorrow, untainted by grief, free from pain and unmarred by suffering... perhaps an unattainable illusion, but it is the ideal I have pursued all my life.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I believe all things happen for a reason, but... the senseless violence, the prejudices that drive siblings to turn against each other... these things truly sadden me. If there is anything I detest, it is that.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper: I
voiceLines.content: Since the day you Awakened me from darkness, I have been certain that you can save all from the despair of Dissolution, and bring them to the sinless land. I await that day with a hopeful heart.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper: II
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after clearing Special Operation "Color of Blood"
voiceLines.content: Let me express my gratitude once again, Keeper, for respecting my wishes and keeping my secret from the Committee. I fear their intervention would see me barred from continuing my service to the Chantry of Life.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Vision
voiceLines.content: Losing my sight does not mean I have become blind. While the All-Father brought darkness upon me, He also allowed me to see the faint light of souls.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the "Pale Flame"
voiceLines.content:
Many in the Chantry of Life believe the "white flame" in the Scriptures refers to moonlight: a Pale Messenger appearing from it to lead us from suffering.
But I know the true flame is the soul burning within you and me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About "Awakeners"
voiceLines.content: For me, the state of being an Awakener is a gift from our All-Father to the souls in His embrace. It is a second life, an opportunity to mend past regrets. I will continue His work, fulfill my duties as His proxy, and alleviate more suffering.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About His "Blessing"
voiceLines.content: After years of this invisible plague, the All-Father finally heard my prayers and bestowed upon me the "Blessing" that can counter suffering. It indeed grants life, but also requires a price. As His executor, I ought to bear that burden on behalf of those blessed.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Home
voiceLines.content: I may not have been born in the Kingdom of Leo, but the Church of Redemption is where I received my second life. Why, then, can I not consider this place my home?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About His First Life
voiceLines.content: Back then, although I had received "The Blessing," I was just an ordinary man. There were too many who suffered, too many who needed it. I wanted to save them all, but I failed. This is my greatest regret and my eternal guilt.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ogier
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after clearing Special Operation "Color of Blood"
voiceLines.content: That child is sincere, steadfast, and kind, with a rare bright soul. The last time I met a spirit like this was during the first chapter of my life.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Hiding Identity
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after clearing Special Operation "Color of Blood"
voiceLines.content: In fact, I was told to hide my true identity by the Archbishop. He did not elaborate, but warned me: even in the purest places, shadows may exist, and one must remain cautious, even when doing good. Of course, I trust you completely.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: All of this is for the eternal well-being of the future.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: May His divine love warm your soul.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: No matter how many times we must start over, I will walk alongside you.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Do not harm.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Do not kill.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: This meaningless struggle...

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: To give is to receive.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Follow the divine commandments.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: God treats all His children equally.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Lambs, the All-Father's will shall redeem you.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: All of this is part of His divine plan.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Sanga, the sculptor from Cité, offers you her chisel. You may be flawed, but you are still worth carving.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: You chose the perfect carving knife for me.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Good taste.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Inspirations are endlessly flowing...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Absolutely amazing... Your offhand remark has resolved a creative problem that has been troubling me for months.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I am well acquainted with the pain of carving and the burning of transformation. Yet all of this fades when compared to eternal beauty.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: I need only a bit of stone, two chisels, and three sun-facing irises... and I can create anything for you.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: I shall convey these unspoken words to you through my work.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Thank you for preparing this studio for me. Everything here is bathed in sunlight; it seems that every piece of work, every carving knife, glows with a golden light. Oh, spring is golden.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: The sleeping sovereign murmurs in my ear, the ruins of the deep sea constantly reconstruct before my eyes... Have the countless dream scenes finally come true?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: A wonderful life lies in indulgence. Sometimes, you shouldn't be too hard on yourself.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Inspiration is like bubbles rising in the sea: a gentle touch, and they vanish. Are you the same?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: War, plunder, and fame are all human desires. The humble sculptor has no interest in what humans pursue; she only wishes to be a slave to beauty.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Smiles and etiquette serve as a layer of armor, helping me maintain distance from others and avoid tedious disturbances. As for my true self... I don't mind showing it to you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: My thoughts accumulate like white limestone and are washed into beautiful coral. They merge with me, pulsing with my heartbeat... Will you listen?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Ugh! Your temperature is a bit high for coral. But... it's warm and intense. I like it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Past
voiceLines.content: I'm from Cité. There, everyone wants to be an actor; no one is content with just watching. In reality, we are merely the city's pitiful footnotes.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aurita
voiceLines.content: Pickman and I are working on some fascinating installation art, exploring the reconstruction of abstract representationism by deconstructing visual primitivism... Huh, why did Aurita faint?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Morning
voiceLines.content: The air on campus at 4 AM is refreshing. I'm glad you're willing to work out with me. I must say, sculpting is quite the workout.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: From Dissolution wounds flows not only black slime but also endless inspiration. Honestly, I wouldn't mind some more.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Did you know about the legend of that certain "Painter" here? From those expressionist graffiti, I sense a familiar touch...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I enjoy wandering aimlessly. Swamps, graveyards, infirmaries, abandoned castles... In these places, I always find unexpected delights.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Things I hate...? None. Would you hate a speck of dust or a leaf?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Explaining art is as ridiculous as explaining railroad stocks—please don't make life harder for us artists.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: I need to gather some carving materials, preferably fresh ones.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: What a glorious victory... I shall engrave this moment into eternity.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Sometimes, the beauty of art lies in its annihilation. But your failure... clearly doesn't fall into that category.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Stay focused.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Does it hurt?

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Come on.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Be careful.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Perfect!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Bow to beauty.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Listen to the Sculpted Cantabile!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: True art needs no explanation.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: The long-lost city of Lemuria, now finally unveiled.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Guests at my salon receive the finest hospitality... As an entry ticket, have you prepared secrets worthy of this grand banquet?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: I shall accept your generous gift with gratitude.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: What kind of return gift could match your dedication?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: How beautiful...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Consider this my vow of loyalty to you.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: This academy is... in desperate need of refurbishing; only the principal's lounge is somewhat presentable. What do you think?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Silk cushions, black tea, macarons... I also need fresh roses with morning dew to adorn my reception room.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Please allow outside guests. I need to host my salons. Tell them to make an exception for me, please?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: My salon is not as innocent as a ball. Are you prepared?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: My salon is the soil, the garden, where intoxicating beauty and power will flourish...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: As the hostess, it is my duty to ensure every guest is satisfied.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: In the past, guests called me "Madam in Red". Of course, you can also call me "Sorel"—after all, you are my most special guest...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Before the salon begins, would you like to hear a story? A tale of how a village girl claimed the crown of power... Where should we start? From her parents forcing her to marry an elderly man, or perhaps the part where she blossoms in the noble garden?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: You're quite an unyielding guest. What must I do to make you relinquish the privilege in your hands? Power only invites trouble—such a simple truth, surely you understand it?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Power is a double-edged sword. How could I not understand? I realized it far too late. Once I let go, they will tear me apart... If only I had been as clear-minded as you from the start, I wouldn't have met such a tragic end. Eh? You say I can host salons in the principle's lounge from now on?! This is... How else can I repay you besides serving you personally...?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: So eager. It seems a bit crude for someone of your caliber.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Humans
voiceLines.content: After all, humans are only shallow creatures. A few words, a hint, and they begin to fight each other... Sigh, this level of conflict is hardly enough to inspire.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Daffodil
voiceLines.content: I swear to you, that shopkeeper definitely showed up at one of the salons in Fontainebleau... I see, her looks have not changed. I wonder how many secrets we can trade from her?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Karen
voiceLines.content: A skilled maid can greatly enhance the salon, but a bluish-green maid... let me reconsider...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution... I must admit, there are things in this world beyond the control of power.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: You have quite the gathering of talents here, worthy of a grand salon... Rest assured, the invitation will be delivered to you by my servant.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I love the stained glass at Fontainebleau. It casts different shades on people's faces: despairing purple, flattering blue, and, of course, my favorite—ambitious red...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I hate candles that go out easily, black bread, and loose threads on skirts... No reason, I simply detest them. Isn't that natural?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You are the master here, but also a guest in my salon. I will prepare the finest hospitality for your visit—do you prefer a scarlet petticoat or a white rose-colored nightgown?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: After plucking the flower of victory, I would like to claim a small prize...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Ah, my dress is dirty. I should change out of it before the next salon.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: How dare you inflict such humiliation upon me...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Hah!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Aah!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: That is disgraceful.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: How dare you!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (An elegant, stifled gasp of pain)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (A careful, stifled groan of endurance)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Watch this.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Out of my way!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: This is MY salon.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Now I will cleanse myself of disgrace!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Bow down and kiss the tips of my feet!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Directly linking with an Aeon will damage your mind. However, since you insist, I will respond to your call.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: A fragment from the infinite space-time continuum arrives within my awareness.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Visit Their dream and glimpse the universe's forbidden secrets.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Do not let Their knowledge and memories be wasted.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: The First Gate. The infinite universe was born from a point.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: The Second Gate. A line extends from a point, stretching toward infinite polarities.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The Third Gate. Planes are partial and one-sided constructs.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: The Fourth Gate. The eternal archetype solidified in a space of dimensions.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: The Fifth Gate. The passage of time is but an illusion; there has never been a beginning, and thus, no end.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: The Ultimate Gate. The final void linking countless universes. Pass through it, and the mysteries of the world will be revealed to you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: The synchronization between us should not require such a lengthy adjustment. However, to preserve your mental clarity from the illusions, I will proceed gradually.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: I will show you my dreams. Everything bizarre and chaotic that you see is closer to the true nature of this world than the reality you know.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Here is my advice: Remain calm. When you feel tired, stop immediately and conserve your strength. Otherwise, you will be forever lost in the dream realm.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: You have gone deep, very deep. Soon, you will witness an extraordinary miracle. I hope you can remain as sane and calm as you are now.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: The Ultimate Gate opens for you. Embrace the world of deathly silence beyond.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Do you wish to confirm something? The senses of this body are too restricted. If we meet in the Abyss, I can show you much more.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: It is Their will... No, it is an unconscious gaze that encompasses all things within Their breath.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: I only helped them found this institution for "Storage." The school has achieved more than I anticipated.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I love... the "Answer." It is out of this love that I have guarded this Gate, and out of this love that I placed its Key in your hand.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I hate... "Ignorance." No, to diligently seek the ultimate truth is not ignorance. True ignorance lies in living in a haze, unaware of what one does not know.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: I was only meant to be your guide, leading you on this journey before returning to rest in the illusory waters. Now, you are my Linker, and our connection is so intricate it is difficult to sever.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ramona
voiceLines.content: That child has endured far too much because of the Fragment of me within her. Thankfully, her soul remains as clear as flowing silver.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ramona: Timeworn
voiceLines.content: She is a Fragment of me from another dimension that has been eternally annihilated. Sadly, while she mastered time reversal, she failed to grasp the essence of transcending spacetime, repeatedly succumbing to anguish. This is my fault.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aeon of Desire
voiceLines.content: The Aeon of Desire, Tifere Yesod, has found her path to survival. In the face of the unknown, no one can judge the nobility or baseness of her methods.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: I will reveal the truth.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: I have witnessed the whole.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: I failed... to see it all....

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: I see.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: I know.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Insignificant.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Maintain composure.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Ugh.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: I am not here.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Everything exists within the void.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: The universe cycles endlessly.

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Gate, open for me.

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Listen to the voice of wisdom.

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: III
voiceLines.content: Infinite, boundless, endless, limitless.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Pass through the Silver Key Gate to reach Their Throne.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: The Ultimate Gate has opened. Witness the All-in-One and One-in-All!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Past, present, future. A billion brilliances gather as one!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: My veins surge with the will to survive, screaming and driving me to spill my blood on every inch of this planet... Ah, I've rambled on for too long; do forgive me. I am Thais. Have you summoned me? Are you ready to merge with me?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Thank you for your efforts. Allow me to reward you in kind.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: My body is getting warmer.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Your generosity is greatly cherished...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Would you like to touch it? My heart beats because of your presence.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I'm so happy... You're so biased and favor me so much.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Others may get upset if they think you're showing favoritism.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Do you long for me as well?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Is this the manifestation of your desire, to deepen my affection?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: For all that you have given me, your love has already become one with mine...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Why not lose yourself in my love? Didn't you awaken me for the warmth of my embrace?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Why do you always avoid me? Are you shy? How cute, this reluctance to face your desires.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Hmm? You're wary of me, a woman of unknown origins? Very well... I was the deposed queen of Nineveh, the Shinarite who clawed at heaven's gate, and the girl who had her consciousness stolen beneath Euphrates' sacred bough... Where shall I begin, my wary one?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Since I am Awakened as your apostle, I seek nothing but your peace and joy, that is my wish... Ugh... Ahh... Yes, yes, I wish for survival, perseverance, reproduction, we must live on, LIVE ON...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I have always awaited the arrival of destruction, never considering "resistance"... Will you help my shallow soul cross the abyss? Even in a world where I narrowly survived, you still grant me salvation...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Oh dear, are you being affectionate with me? This is troublesome. If this continues, I won't be able to wait until you fully mature, my dear {Male=Mr.,Female=Miss} Keeper...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Past
voiceLines.content: To survive annihilation, I've shared my spirit and blood with too many. My power now is a ghost of what it was when I first embraced this Supreme Will...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Salvador
voiceLines.content: I'm not good at dealing with clerics. They're dull and rigid, and they've given their belts to their beloved "God". Such a pity, Mr. Salvador smells so sweet...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Lotan
voiceLines.content: I can sense that girl's hostility; my love for you has lit the fire of her jealousy... Look, even that humpback whale gapes with envy.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: What filth, what abomination! Ah—stop it! Please! Don't make me see it, don't speak of it near me...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Oh dear, most here are still children. That white-haired gentleman, the stern one-armed youth—none of them are ideal for children... Sigh, this is quite a dilemma.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Have you seen those ancient stone carvings? Merged with mountains, enduring through time, such wonderful relics... but they still don't last long enough...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Human faces twisted by desire never cease to amuse. So fragile, so small... This alone makes me feel as if a cat were scratching at my heart..

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You truly are a dishonest child. Lucky for you, I have eternity to wait...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Alva
voiceLines.content: She's an overcautious child. Not that I blame her—without her, my free-spirited people would've perished long ago, no?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tawil
voiceLines.content: Oh dear, I've lost to her this time... But since she chose you, you'll drink the Holy Tree's sap and carry my blood and seeds to a new world, yes?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ryker
voiceLines.content: That wolf-boy... Did you know? He and that N have something... indescribable, going on between them.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Jenkin
voiceLines.content: Oh dear, a little mouse scurried past... They love nibbling forbidden things, don't they? But this one's still much too young.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Erica
voiceLines.content: All conscious beings have desires. Even machines, yes?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Agrippa
voiceLines.content: Spiders... Mmm~ I adore them. They are born walking and fertile beyond envy...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper - 2
voiceLines.content: I'll teach you pleasure, the thrill of riding that high... In return, you will bare your desires to me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper - 3
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
voiceLines.content: Come closer. Embrace me. Taste me... Never forget me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Aram
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
voiceLines.content: They carried my blood, my lineage, becoming the flourishing waters of Remouahe... Now, my dear, you must see my legacy endure.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About The Mother Tree
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
voiceLines.content: I am the Mother Tree. The Mother Tree is me. Her sap flows in my veins, her will whispers in my mind...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About "N"
voiceLines.content: That one, of the three Aeons, is a monster wrapped in riddles. Please don't let his honeyed words sway you, or I'll be heartbroken...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Desire
voiceLines.content: All desires sprout from love; love is the seed before the towering tree of fertility.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Keygrave
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
voiceLines.content: I glimpsed your tombstone in Keygrave's shadows... Will my mummified flesh rest here too, one day? No? What a pity.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Offsprings
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
voiceLines.content: Those with the flowing tree's blood are my children—you, who've swallowed its seeds are of course included.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Desert
voiceLines.content: Born from the yellow sands, and to the yellow sands you shall return. On this brief journey, shouldn't you leave some souvenirs along the way? Sow some seeds?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: After the victory, please allow me to take the materials needed for reproduction.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Is it over already? ... My excitement was just beginning to stir.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Ah, unpardonable...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Come on!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Don't run.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: That's enough.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Be gentle.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Please don't...

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: No...

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Accept my affection.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Aw, am I causing you pain?

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Look this way!

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Good child.

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: III
voiceLines.content: Hey!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Grow stronger~

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Grow and thrive, my little sapling.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Join my ritual and become my seed!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Thank you for your summon. If there is an occasion where my voice is needed, please notify me in advance.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Thank you. You're too kind.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: I shall sing for you.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Please look forward to my performance.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Yesterday, I dreamed of the day I started drifting through the stars again.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: The vast cosmos, the boundless deep space, and the seemingly endless journey... I felt so lost during that time.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The spaceship was cramped and claustrophobic, like a metal coffin floating in space. I had been waiting for my Morning Star since forever, until you showed up for me.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Yes... I lost my voice back then. Your grace brought it back.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Will your side be the place where Faint and I finally find belonging?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: It has been a long time since I felt this way. I will take the stage in perfect form and deliver a song that embraces the whole cosmos just for you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Why am I always dressed in this gown? So I can sing for you at any time.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: What do I want to do for myself? Sorry, I don't understand what you mean. Actually, Faint has asked me this question many times, but all I want is for her to recover soon.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: During our time on that now desolate planet, the compassion of those influential figures provided my sister and me with the resources to survive. In the end, they also gave me the chance to escape the dying planet, though it was limited to one person. They are all my benefactors, just like you, Keeper, who gave me a place to stay.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Thank you for your guidance. I finally understand Faint's choice. I took everything for granted, not realizing the mental burden it placed on her. From now on, I'll try to live for myself.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Through the long, endless times, Faint and I only had each other. But now, I have a new significant person in my life. Keeper, please allow me to retract what I had said before. You are different. You see more than my songs and my appearance; you truly see me. This is why I will protect you, too. I will never turn my eyes away from you.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Lah... Oh, do you need something? If possible, let's talk backstage.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Singing
voiceLines.content: I don't deserve the title "Heavenly Voice." As long as you enjoy my singing, that's all that matters.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Faint
voiceLines.content: I never expected to see Faint again... I wonder how she has been doing since then. No matter how I ask, she only reassures me she's fine... Sigh. Ah, excuse me, I got carried away. I should thank you for reuniting us first.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Faros
voiceLines.content: That lady looks like a lighthouse... If I could have seen her dazzling light during the eternal night voyage, perhaps I wouldn't have become lost.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Ah, the calamity of destruction and misfortune... Why did it have to torment my sister and me?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Here are lush plants, tranquil air, and a remedy for my sister's illness. For the two of us, it is the most wonderful new home.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I love all lives. I love light. I want Faint to emerge from her secluded shell and experience the world with her own eyes and ears.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I fear loneliness, and the worry of being lost in endless darkness... So please, promise you will not leave my side.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You are my most important listener. Whenever you need it, I am ready to sing and give you everything.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Ahh—

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Has my singing been of any help to you?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Ah... the stars... have fallen...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Let's set off.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: The dense mist descends.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Gaze upon the star cluster.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Exclamation)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: O Stardust...

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: O Meteor...

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Flow for me, river of stars...

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: I still sing of the Color out of Space...

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Sing, chant for me!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Who dares disturb This One's slumber?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Fine. I shall consider it a subject's humble offering.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Do you seek This One's sigil branded upon your soul?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Do you covet my power so desperately?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Wait, without my permission...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Those who remain stubborn in their folly perform futile deeds.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Isn't it good to follow the will of heaven? Why resist the will of fate?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: To fulfill your wish, you are willing to sacrifice so much...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Very well. At this point, I can somewhat grasp your aim. Proceed.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I see your resolve. Before returning to the void, This One shall bear witness to mankind's heir defying fate. But now... rest is required.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: I see none of my vassals' traits in you... Perhaps that is for the best. Merely recalling that woman wearies me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: I never demanded worship. Mortals' fervor only exhausts me further... Withdraw. I will sleep now.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: It has been a while since you awakened me. Have you no questions? Divine secrets? The absolute prophecy? Even the drowned continent's treasures... Nothing stirs your curiosity? Hmph... You are peculiar, indeed.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: To shoulder calamity's weight... it must be a heavy burden for your age. Tell me—had you known from the start that destiny is immutable... would you still have fought so fiercely? Keep your answer. Reflect as I rest. Your reply... interests me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: I am not omnipotent. Even I err. That woman's ruinous action was my miscalculation... Hence, I require your aid. That you may heed my summons, you may place a bed here, in my chamber.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Your insolence... This One shall interpret as a plea for eternal rest.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Slumber
voiceLines.content: My slumber spills dreams like poison. Approach not while I sleep—and wake me never without cause.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Divine Bloodline
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after acquiring either Awakener "Aigis" or "Murphy"
voiceLines.content: This girl... her veins undoubtedly carry my blood. No—I have not walked this earth long enough to sire progeny. And yet... her power mirrors my own.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Seafarers
voiceLines.unlockCondition: Unlocks after acquiring any one of Awakeners "Miryam," "Goliath," "Caecus," "Sanga," or "Faros".
voiceLines.content: ...It matters not, so long as their zeal doesn't rouse me. Sharing quarters is tolerable.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution... Those vile black tides invade my dreams. Unbearable.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: No matter how many cushions you stack, a lapis lazuli throne can't compare to a feather bed. In this regard, there is something commendable about your place.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Preferences? A king should not indulge... yet if I could avoid tedious rites, a soft divan might suffice.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: They found my bones beneath waves and presume I enjoy water? Now they wish to build a pool outside my chambers? ...Ha. They may do as they will. As long as they cease troubling me with trifles.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: For a subject, you observe keenly. Before my next long sleep, I shall... grace this era with my presence.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Let's make it quick, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Not worth mentioning.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Ugh, it's still rather hard to focus...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Impudent rogue!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Insolent!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Quite bold of you.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Groan)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Divine Punishment!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Kneel before the throne.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Witness the radiance of This One's might.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Slumbering stars of mine dream now stir—let them converge unto their ordained fate. Point thy path to the Divine Realm!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: The hour has come. My promise shall be fulfilled.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: How many times have I been summoned... Human, you'd better have enough 'food' ready, or I can't guarantee anything.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: The power surges, nonstop, filling my whole body...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: I'm really, really excited right now... If you still want to live, better stay away from me.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Not bad. You're less worthless than you appear.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Hey, stop meddling with my body. True warriors never rely on external aids.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: This strange feeling... not bad. Better than that Levantine wizard's nightshade.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Well done, Keeper. So, who am I killing this time?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Hahaha, that's the feeling! Give me more... double, no, ten times the dose!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Crimson body, pulsating tentacles, mouthparts constantly opening and closing... Great! I can't wait to tear a throat apart!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Worms. Stars. I am... Uvhash! Kill... let me kill!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Scared? Hahaha, that's right! To hell with everything. I just want to savor your fear.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Interesting, your blood tastes... sweet, like mead.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Back then, tens of thousands cheered my name. The loud roars of "Uvhash" drowned everything else, celebrating me breaking a bald weakling's neck. It felt incredible. As my partner, you should understand.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Shackle me, drag me by the hair, make me kneel as your slave... I don't care, do anything to me as you please. Just let me kill. The Sculptors, that Lady Lantern, some random hag with asthma... anyone! I promise I'll tear their throats out and drink their blood.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Frail human, your conviction is sufficient. I will be your weapon. Let's carve out some chaos together!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Touch me all you like... These are the scars I earned at the arena, a man's badges of honor!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Etiquette
voiceLines.content: Top hats, bowler hats, deerstalker hats, berets... Gotta say it's funny how those high and mighty "gentlemen" would do everything to hide their bald heads.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Agrippa
voiceLines.content: Agrippa? Who was that? Oops, I've killed too many. Most of them weren't worth remembering.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Leigh
voiceLines.content: Who is Leigh? Oh, the woman who begged me to beat her up. Haha, interesting... This place isn't boring after all.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: I've seen many go mad from Dissolution. Truth is, I'm already mad enough. Bet that thing can't affect me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Don't expect to find me in the teaching building. It stinks of musty old scholars; I can't stand that place.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: After Tiberius's death, the Romans finally had their long-time wish granted: they got to dump him into the Tiber to feed the fish. The price was small: Caligula threw those people to me in the arena for my amusement.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: You call this little toy a handgun? Hiding in shadows to ambush enemies... Hmph. A weapon for cowards only.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Want to please me? Then kneel, offer your neck, and shut up until I finish draining you.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: I smell... the scent of blood.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: I'm not done yet... How about you get up so I can kill you again?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: The thrill of battle beats everything—not even winning comes close.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Awesome！

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Tsk!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: No need!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Fuck off!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Interesting!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Humming with interest)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Scoffs disdainfully)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Burn it all!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Hahaha!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Bathe in my enemies' blood!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: I am the last Roman warrior—Uvhash!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Enjoy this feast of slaughter! To the fullest!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: Ugh! The squalor and disarray everywhere... I can barely find a suitable place to rest my foot. Very well, offer me your soft back, mortal.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Quite good, indeed.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: This level is hardly sufficient.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: So, what reward do you want?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Offering tributes obediently again? Such a good {Male=boy,Female=girl}.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Your dark circles are worsening... Why exert yourself so? You should be more like me and learn to indulge in your leisure.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Shh... The morning glow of the valley—this must be your first time seeing it, no? Consider it your reward for loyalty.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: This tome, "The @1@2 Revelation," is yours now. It helps to enlighten the mind, or perhaps, to swiftly invite slumber.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Good... I'm getting closer to my original form.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: This is the power to counter "Green Corruption"... You've touched something forbidden. As for me, I will never relinquish you again.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content:
Hmm... Although you're dull, you're not entirely unpleasant. Starting tomorrow, you shall serve me.
You don't want to...? Ha. This isn't a request; it is a command.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Keeper, is there anyone you don't like? As a favor, I can teach them a lesson. Within a week, they'll be a changed person, obediently prostrating themselves before you.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I adore my servants. These handsome little creatures, trembling from Dissolution and hiding behind me, are so endearing. The tears of a beauty are always captivating. How about you? Do you fear Dissolution?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Do you know what makes you the most charming? It's when you say "no" to me. Your nose wrinkles, your eyebrows lift ever so slightly... Yes, precisely like that.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
What a surprise, I've gained an equivalent companionship.
However... I request to retain the right to command you, merely for our mutual amusement. Come to my chambers tonight; I still have much to learn about human sensibilities...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hmm... You're getting better at massaging. Nice application of pressure~

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Past
voiceLines.content: I hail from a distant alien planet, a place of relentless snowstorms and extreme cold. But it matters not; in my manor, over a thousand servants offer comforting warmth simply by their presence.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Pandia
voiceLines.content: Pandia... She calls THAT being a dominatrix? Haha... Allow me a moment of amusement. Humans are still too soft-hearted; everything they do seems like mere child's play.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Caecus
voiceLines.content: Was that a half-blood Deep One we just passed? Hmm... Look how uptight he stands. Tonight, I shall see him arch that beautiful little back, groveling before me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: Dissolution is a divine gift. The pain it brings is just enough to paralyze our nerves, allowing us to wholeheartedly indulge in food, wine, and revelry, as we glide towards extinction.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: If you ask me, beautiful fools are the best. Unfortunately, there are far too many clever but useless minds around here.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: A qualified servant must be pliable and vacuous—I prefer obedient lambs.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I despise losing control. However, your presence has shown me that a touch of subtle chaos can bring a singular enjoyment.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You are my beloved servant. I know you call it a friend, partner, comrade... Call it what you will.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Is it finally beginning? My little darlings have been famished for such a very, very long time...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: The feeling of being crushed under my feet must be utterly divine~

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: A bunch of incompetents. If you'd rather not end up as minced meat, you'd do well to pay closer attention next time.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Stand aside!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Do come now.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Tedious.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: How dare you!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: (Questioning with great interest)

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Intrigued whisper)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: What do you intend?

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: A minor chastisement.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Kneel before me!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Move, you cur.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Surrender... Welcome to a realm of exquisite pleasure and dreams.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: This is the city where countless lost souls wander, forever unable to find their way home.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: I'm... just call me Winkle. That's what everyone calls me. Yes, call me that, just like they do...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: No, don't! Don't continue! It will find me! It will find me!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: This should keep me awake.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: It's over! It's over! It's over! They'll definitely find out...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: When I partnered with Mythag University, it was clearly stipulated that I wouldn't be sent into battle...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Damn it! Damn it! This power only keeps me trapped in this body!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: If I could shift Dimensions again, I'd want to become a star...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: No matter how I calculate, the formula for consciousness transfer remains unsolvable...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I wish to stay in a place that's always bright... Yes, the poles. On this planet, only the poles.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: I... I can't bear heavy responsibilities. I can only chase the light. So, please, don't stop shining...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Whoa! Stay away from me! F-First, you have to prove that you're not a servant of darkness! Yeah, just take off your clothes and show me that you don't have that disgusting black slime on your body, then I'll know you're not evil...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Could you use your supply share to get me two bags of caffeine supplements?... I can't sleep. Why would I sleep? I must never sleep! Once I close my eyes, everything turns into darkness... endless darkness...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Please, Keeper... As long as you let me stay on the locator and not move, I'll do anything except enter the darkness and face that... that black thing! I can't leave this spot! Just a little more, and I'll locate the remains of my home planet! Only 1.2 billion calculations to go!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: When my planet was destroyed, I abandoned my body and transferred my consciousness to a human vessel... But the black demon pursued me relentlessly, binding my spirit and preventing my escape! It seeks to pull this world into an abyss of darkness!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Once inside a human vessel, I lost all contact with my kin. I'm terrified that the others didn't escape the demon and that I might be the last of my kind... Please, Keeper, save me! Let me stay by your side, don't leave me to the darkness...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Aaah! Don't sneak up on me from behind!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Night
voiceLines.content: Don't go out at night! Even with a 2000-lumen light, it's not completely safe... Once you step into the darkness, the evil lurking beyond your sight will chase you, devour you, chase you, devour you... until nothing is left!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Doll
voiceLines.content: Miss Doll says that I can temporarily avoid Dissolution by abandoning my body like her... No, I can't do it! I can't do it! I will lose consciousness during the procedure, and the darkness will take over!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Daffodil
voiceLines.content: I want a lamp that never goes out. She actually said I could purchase it with... with a specimen of a "wingless flying hydra." Where can I find such a bizarre species?!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Dissolution
voiceLines.content: No, no, no, don't! Don't mention it...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: How do I like it here? P-pretty good. As long as I share some mechanical science and spirit research knowledge with Ms. Doll, she lets me keep the lights on.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Powered by the nuclear fusion of a red giant, supplemented by the energy from a collapsing star, you could start a perpetual motion machine and light an eternal lamp... Eh? You say there's no way to build a perpetual motion machine here, and no red giant? Hmm...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Don't ask! Don't ask! You know exactly what I fear and hate the most! Darkness! Endless darkness!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Why do you appear so dark, yet so radiant...? No, never mind, just ignore my rambling.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Boohoo... I don't want to face those things...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Finally, it's over. No more seeing those black, slimy...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: It's catching up to me, the eternal darkness... No one can escape...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Watch this!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Careful!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Go away!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: No!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Spare me!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: (Cry of fear)

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: (Cry of fear)

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: I must... eliminate it!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Calm down, calm down...

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: I must escape the darkness!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Run... I must run! Get away from here!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Here's my last bit of shifting power... You can have it!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: I am Xu, the Mistress of the Dreamless Land. If, in your heart, there is one you ache to see, yet cannot attain, I shall lower my fan and grant you a glimpse.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Do you anticipate a greater beauty from me, or a greater dread?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Such attentiveness makes me want to tease you all the more.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: These slight diversions are more to my liking than the offerings of my devotees.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: There was once a Princess born of Pleasure. Her robes were threaded with gold, her skin like ivory, the scent of agarwood drifted around her, and the mere sweep of her gaze could steal a soul.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: I have almost forgotten her tale entirely, but it was one of Rapture, one of Cruelty, one that began with Abandonment and Retribution, and concluded with Sacrifice and Blind Obedience.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: She soon tired of the sport. Her devotees merely repeated the same theatre, consumed by the Love born of Lust, or the Lust born of Love. Their foolishness—their heartbreak over betrayal and loss—it bored her. Their tears, too, bored her.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: First Their bearing, then Their shape, until They also possessed a pair of... or rather, until all that remained memorable was a pair of beautiful, Soul-Capturing Eyes—eyes just like mine.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content:
Do you not love me? Then why cower when you are encompassed? Do you not loath me? Then why weep when there is no return?
Oh, now you fear my shadow? Has the fragrance of white magnolia become a cloying, inexplicable musk to you?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content:
Do not trouble yourself; you are not like those common multitude. 
Hush. Do not look behind me. Pay no mind to the unseen caress. Look into my eyes, and my eyes alone.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content:
Ah, you stare, enraptured by my fan again? Hehe. No matter whose face you desire, I shall let you have it. Come, draw closer—
Oh? You refuse? Such cold words, yet such an adorable expression...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content:
I am utterly bored this day. Is there no wish you require me to make manifest?

A pity you don't. So many are willing to wield the scythe and offer me sweetmeat for far more trifling ends.
But if it's you asking...

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content:
Why does the Order of the Swelling Grace follow me, and what was its genesis? An amusing query. Have you, too, known the person unattainable, or the regret of failed struggle?
Hmm, it seems not. What a waste. That look of desperate struggle—it would be so very amusing to behold on your face.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content:
You are truly a marvel, so preoccupied with the trivialities of the corporeal, in a world already marked for ruin.

It compels me to take an interest myself.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
Beneath my fan, every soul sees the face of their most cherished. I lend this power to the weak, that they may wield it as a blade for my own amusement.

But perhaps—I only say, perhaps. If you were to be enthralled by it, I would know a true, unsullied Ecstasy.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: ...If you continue to trespass thus, the guise I adopt for you may not remain so agreeable.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content:
All things end in the Void. Why not seek some further pleasure with me before then?

Rest assured, should the day come that you cannot resist the Dissolution further, I shall not allow It to claim you first.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: The University so firmly rejected my application for the psychological therapy office. How strange; what objection could they possibly hold?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: In the legends of the Panlong Empire, the peacock is a handsome, flamboyant, and malicious beast. Beautiful and viscious—it makes the heart race. Ugly and kind, however, is rather boring.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content:
All nascent beings are a bother. Small, soft, loud, they unconsciously command all things around them.

I enjoy a spectacle, but decidedly not that sort. Pray, ensure they remain far, far away.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content:
You? You are my little Jasmine, my obedient darling, the delightful game of playhouse I so willingly participate in...
Ah, mere happy ravings. Please pay them no mind.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Sorel
voiceLines.content:
That Madam in Red once sent me several invitations to her salons.
The foreign confections were passable, but... 
She ought to have informed me sooner that at her residence, "desserts" and "servants" were not synonymous.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Lily
voiceLines.content: I, too, once had such a pretty, compliant girl. A tempting flower-bud, of course she needed a few thorns—she could not simply be placed in a vase.

voiceLines.title: Chat: The Order of Swelling Grace
voiceLines.content: Oh? You ask why they bore those marks under their arms? Do you not find it utterly diverting?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: The gaze of such petty, common minds is an utter vexation to me.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: You ask why Their crania are so vacant? Hmm, perhaps it is merely Their nature.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: ...This, at least, grants me a slight spark of interest.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Boring.

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Noisy.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Hold your impudence.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Advance not!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
