voiceLines.content: <Italic:Aiyah!>

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Sure.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Amuse me. Slay one another in pain and dread!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: What is it you are looking for in my Dreamless Land?

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Hehe... Do any of you dare to behold my true form?

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Suffer no Fury, know no Resentment, for All is Nullity.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Think not, Trouble not; Listen Blindly, Obey Mutely, for the Mortal Coil is only Burden!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: I! Vortice! Yahoo!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Yahoo!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Vortice! Strong!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Vortice! Great!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: Ritual?! Bring me!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: So fun! Next time! More!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Hurry, hurry!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Find many, shiny!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Whoosh whoosh~ Big wave up!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Whirlpool! Strong! Good!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: No touch! You break!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Shell, shiny! Pretty! Give you!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Coalsie, I, eat, together? Together!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Hug! Vortice! Like!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: Vortice! Coalsie! Together, always? Forever!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Pat pat, good! Vortice, you, pat pat!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: No, no! Coalsie, Vortice protect!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Friends! Many! Like!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Nautilus, Nautila, Coalsie! Shinies!

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Hunt! Bad! Break! Vortice, hit them, break!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Coalsie, friend! Vortice, forever!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Nautila
voiceLines.content: Nautila, miss you... Eh? Nautila, Vortice, here, Vortice, HERE!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Goliath
voiceLines.content: FIGHT! ME!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Doll
voiceLines.content: Cold, scary. Vortice, hide!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Go, go!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Hooray!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Again? Again!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Bang!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Big wave coming!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Whoosh whoosh~

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Gurgle gurgle~

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Eek!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Ow!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Vortice! Very strong!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Vortice, load!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Vortice, wash away!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: WHOOSH—

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Bang!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Hehe, Vortice, wanna play!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Gobble up! Yum yum!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Abyss! Spiral! Gone, everything—all become whirlpool!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content:
On the grand stage of fate, all souls await their cue within the web of cause and consequence, their joys and sorrows quietly taking shape as the gears turn... 
The curtain has risen, Keeper. This is where your story, and mine, begins.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Another thread coming clear.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Fate stirs. Its whisper draws near.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: I have seen it whole at last. The endless web of fate.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: The curtain is open for you, and fate's script waits to begin. Tell me: which destined path would you rather walk? A sorrowful ending, or a joyful opening?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: If comedy is your inclination, <Italic:A Midsummer Night's Dream> would serve you well. I am particularly fond of Puck's mischievous ramblings—hidden inside a sprite's laughter, fate always lets something slip.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: If you would enter the hall of tragedy, allow me to present <Italic:Antigone>. Caught between divine law and mortal decree, every step she takes falls upon threads fate has already spun, until she steps at last into the deep shadow of the stone tomb. It is precisely because those chains cannot be broken that the will burning inside her small frame blazes so vividly against the long night.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: I thought nothing in this world could surprise me anymore... Your taste in theater has left an impression.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Thank you for accompanying me through so many rising and falling curtains. I will not disappoint you—there are more evenings yet to come that will move you in ways you have not expected.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Everything is a past epilogue. Everything is a new prologue. The new chapter between us waits for you to write it, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: The threads of fate always connect in the shadows... You have disturbed one such thread, and so you have startled me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Those threads once flowed in perfect order through my hands... until you appeared, and sent ripples through their course that I had never foreseen.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: The theater has staged a new romantic comedy, and I have reserved a seat for you among fate's audience. Through every long night where destinies entwine, I shall wait quietly for the moment our stars meet.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content:
If you would allow it... I wish to weave a play that belongs only to you and me. 
No audience, no rehearsal. I simply wish to see how the thread even I cannot read will begin to stir... when you step into the light.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
The invisible threads belonging to you and I have long wound tightly around each other, weaving at once a cage and a road.
I cannot see where the cage ends, nor where the road leads.
That is precisely what makes this story so captivating.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content:
To pull so insistently at fate's threads...

You seem rather eager to read your own story, no?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content:
The tragedy before you is only one glance among countless possibilities.

Beyond fate's curtain lies a stage swallowed in darkness—
lights extinguished, players gone, everything returning to the deep.

But that is not where it ends.
I carry the resolve to endure this thankless labor, until the day the lights return.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content:
Upon the threads, I see colors shift through every shade of the rainbow.
They reach across an endless web, spinning boundless worlds and infinite possibility, until it weaves a pattern more beautiful than any that has ever been seen.

In the end—god or mortal, hero or villain—each is guided by those slender threads, rushing headlong toward their destined end beneath fate's unblinking gaze.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content:
I have grown quite fond of this weaving, day after day... In the quiet, repeated pull of each one, I see through to the beginnings and endings of all stories. Watching each curtain fall, I feel at times as though I have risen above fate itself. And yet one cannot escape fate's web, and to only watch leaves, in the end, a hollow feeling.
In those moments, I go to the theater. To perform the sorrows and joys I have spun with my own hands, but never once lived.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content:
I have never cared for performances that simply repeat themselves. The very reason one steps into a theater is to witness a living stage—one that cannot be recreated.
If it does nothing but turn like clockwork, the stage becomes an ornate cage, and watching becomes nothing more than a tedious pilgrimage toward an ending you already know.
A souless masquerade, no matter how magnificent the production is. What do you think?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Every soul's fate is carried along by threads... but yours is a script I cannot decipher. I find myself looking forward to whatever improvisation you will bring to this world.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Sorel
voiceLines.content: She visits my theater often... but I know she does not come for the plays. She seems to use this stage to lend a certain refinement to her own image. Such remarkable skill, though—to spend it only as a spectator seems a waste. That lady is not the kind to bloom in the dark of the audience. She belongs under the light.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Liz
voiceLines.content: What an ill-fated dancer. I have watched her steps. Hers is a beauty that moves toward ruin—every turn igniting green flames, as though trying to burn fate's threads away, though in the end those threads will only carve something achingly vivid from her. If the chance arises, I would like to write a ballet just for her.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Hameln
voiceLines.content: I once heard him play. That music made the soul tremble... Perhaps I should invite him to compose a symphony of fate for my next production.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tinct
voiceLines.content: What a gifted singer. A voice given by grace, clear and burning all at once, as though it rises from fate itself. If she were to perform in my theater, I imagine even the most demanding audience would be caught off guard.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tawil
voiceLines.content: Even one who watches all things remains a clumsy actor in their own script. To hold fate's web, yet be bound by its threads—we walk different roads in this destined circumstance, but neither of us has ever truly abandoned our thankless pursuits. Foolish, perhaps. Deluded, perhaps. So it is with me, and so it is with her.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: The conflict is here. Will you play the hero who breaks the web, or the player who moves only as the strings allow?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Another story, beautifully complete, draws to its close.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: No ending is ever truly certain, yet none escapes the web of cause and consequence...

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Hmph...

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Submit to this.

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Be still...

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Futile resistance.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: An unexpected turn?

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: The error must be corrected.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: The threads of fate hang still.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: What was written draws near.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: From endless threads, I spin the only path.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Here it is woven. Here it is weighed. Here it is severed.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Fate's prisoner, pitiful as ever... what is written cannot be refused.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content:
Hello! ...Is that the right way to say it?
I'm Saya, and... nice to meet you!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: I'm stuffed. Thanks for the treat!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Thank you for this gift. I'll keep it safe.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Well? Gotcha, didn't I?

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: I can do stuff like that, you know. Like rearranging or tweaking other creatures' bodies...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Every living thing is different, so before you start tweaking things, you really have to study them carefully.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: Yeah, I've studied the structure of Silver Cores, and I'm starting to understand how Awakeners work.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: It seems like "Silver Cores" are each connected to a will from very far away. How mysterious...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: I've studied Awakener structure quite a lot, so I'd call myself an expert by now. But the "spirituality" inside the Silver Cores... I still don't quite get that part.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: After all my tests, I understand a lot more now. The "spirituality" each Awakener carries—they're all completely different. And, it seems like my Silver Core's spirituality is... "love."

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Yesterday, I found a book called <Italic:The Little Prince> on Lily's bookshelf. It was really good! Do you want to read it?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content:
"<Italic:On one of these stars, my flower is blooming...>"
I feel like you’ve said something like that before.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: The Little Prince says his rose became special because he took care of it... Do you think so?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Hey, Keeper... have you ever loved someone? Have you ever truly missed someone with all your heart?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content: You know dandelions, right? The ones that send their seeds out on the wind. A little seed gets carried far, far away from its homeland... and maybe it lands in a desert where nothing grows at all—not a single blade of grass. I wonder... what might that single, little seed feel...?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: You're not scared of me? Aww... that's no fun...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: Certain threats out there could bring darkness great enough to destroy this world, right? I know. Professor Doll told me all about it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Whenever I'm next to you, strange people would just show up and gather around us. I actually prefer it when it was just the two of us in the Domain.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I love good food! And I like people who are kind to me! When someone's gentle with me... it just makes me really happy.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: I don't like people who are rough. They give me a bad feeling...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Keeper, Link, Awakener. That's how we're connected. You told me about it. I can feel our souls linked together... like a silver thread? Hmm, sounds a bit too complicated...

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Thais
voiceLines.content: Spreading seeds through flesh and blood? Hmm... interesting. I'm kind of curious about her sheep, actually.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tinct
voiceLines.content: She's the one who awakened me? She looks really... dazzling. So, did you help her find her sister?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Winkle
voiceLines.content: Oh? So her kind breeds on new planets by preying on other species. Huh, I see...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: I'm ready, anytime.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Nice work! Found anything good?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Living things really are full of diversity. I wanna learn so much more!

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Here we go!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Want to play with Saya?

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Look out!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Heya!

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Eeek!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Ngh—!

voiceLines.title: Hit: III
voiceLines.content: Ahh!

voiceLines.title: Hit: IV
voiceLines.content: Gah!

voiceLines.title: Hit: V
voiceLines.content: Ugh!

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: I won't let anyone get in our way.

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: It's right here?

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: This never gets old!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: This is... where a new world begins.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: This is my last gift... to you.

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content:
Seek you a feast, a hunt, or sanctuary?
Pray to me—the primeval ocean will speak my name.
I am Pontos, Lord of the Great Abyss.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Smart move, kid. The followers of that foreign monster are thick enough to always toss corpses into the sea. That's not an offering. That's littering.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: Let's hope these little things don't eat you out of house and home. You know, feeding a large family is no easy feat.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Uh, not that I did that, but if you ever hear the sound of seawater and the rustle of wings inside your head—don't worry about it. It's perfectly normal.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: In Ebwynnos, the revelry never ends. And Ebwynnos's enemies will never know rest.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Skin, muscle, nerve, bone—my whole body is being reconstructed. I feel whole and vital again.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content:
Spirituality gives rise to a new body, which is then filled with a trivial mind. Then those particularlt bright and lively ones will be gathered in one place, forever.
Remember what I told you? The deepest part of the ocean holds everything... and keeps everything there.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Ah, I understand that shudder. But it's entirely unnecessary, my young friend. Accept your fear of mediocrity, of being slowly worn down. Look at me. You know you always have another choice.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Aging is the only adventure you must face alone. It's your best friend, and your most troublesome foe. But the lights of Ebwynnos will drive it all away... you don't need to be shackled by such worthless memories.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Such a pity. When you change your mind, you know where to find me.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Those slimy fish-people are no friends of mine. They're my enemies. Surprised? The ocean never belonged to them anyway.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content:
Long, long before the land rose from the sea, certain presences stirred within this planet. They're mighty, sovereign, unfathomable.
Neither malice nor mercy could define Them. Humans, like countless creatures that came before, meant nothing to Them. You could be swept away like dust, or protected as part of their territory.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: Prayer works. Think of it this way: If ants arranged themselves into Leonian characters at your feet, you'd at least pause to consider what they wanted.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content:
As for the one who chose me... let's just say He's generous and rotten in equal measure.
Where you land is entirely a matter of whim. You will be pulled from danger, that much is certain. Whether you land in another danger entirely—well, that's hardly the concern of that particular "journey."
How delightful. How unpredictable. I'm considering keeping up the tradition.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
Hahahaha—alright, alright, don't look at me like that, kid.
Just some traditions what you call the Elder Gods tend to follow. As for you—no price, no conditions. I'm always on your side.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content:
Heh... Missing your time in Ebwynnos?
It's right here, in my body. You're welcome to come back anytime.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: Erasing memory. Erasing existence. Familiar, isn't it? You know what I mean. Different origins—and yet They always breed in the dark.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content:
I like spirited young people. Shame Mythag keeps such a stranglehold on entertainment—not even a decent hunting ground to speak of.
And worse still, that filthy thing is strutting around in broad daylight, even daring to wear the title—<Italic:professor>.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: I hate to admit it, but once in a rare while, I find myself thinking that aging isn't just something time does to you. It's merely a symbol. So I allow it to leave a mark on me. Only in appearance, of course.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content:
Yes, I know that disaster wasn't his direct order; it was merely an accident while he was out having fun. But that only makes me want to kill him more.
That black mist... He'd better not wander off alone—and he'd better never fall into my hands.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: Everything I've done for you, and you won't even call me Uncle again. Aww, you're giving me a headache, little one.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tulu
voiceLines.content:
Hmph. A little monster cozying up to that foreign monster.
And some fools actually put us on the same altar? What an insult!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ryker
voiceLines.content: The enemy of my enemy is my friend. Given the chance, I wouldn't mind stealing my oldest enemy's favourite plaything right from under his nose.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ebwynnos
voiceLines.content: There's a particular bond between Ebwynnos and me. Put it this way—I am Ebwynnos. It persists through me, sustained by this body.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Ready, little preys?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Fools. To even dare encroach upon me...

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: No rush. The darkness of the abyss will swallow you whole.

voiceLines.title: Strike
voiceLines.content: Hah!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Night-Gaunt, stop them!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Pathetic.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Guh!

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Dammit...

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Let go of that fantasy of escape.

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: II
voiceLines.content: You've already been marked.

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: III
voiceLines.content: Kneel. Become nourishment for Ebwynnos.

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Surrender your senses. Reflect in the abyss forever!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Chin up. Show me your throat.

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Forever you shall stay!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: I will grind you into pale dust.

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Before the ocean, no foe is unconquerable!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: I see an alien will in your eyes. Impure, but tenacious enough. Come, show me what strength or longing brought you before me.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Not enough. Far from enough...

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: More—give me more power!

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Power is boiling in my marrow!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: The seal loosens a little... The power from the depths of the universe is surging up. I haven't felt this in ages...

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Heh... You see it clearly, Keeper. The shackles of power are meant to be shattered!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: The scent of chaos—how nostalgic... Ever since the moment I was born from this void, my pursuit has never changed.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: My bones tremble with delight... I have witnessed your effort. And this proves you are worthy to stand by my side, Keeper.

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Just ahead... the zenith of power I have pursued my entire life... You've walked this path with me and guided me to this threshold. I'm eager to witness that ultimate day with you!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Ah, I see... there never was an end to power. The true challenge has only just begun! It was you who brought me here and showed me the reality. Soon, I shall present a more perfect warrior before you. Ensure that you return even stronger, my "opponent."

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: Mercy, weakness, confusion... your eyes are clouded with impurities. One who wavers can never understand what strength is.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: You wish to challenge me? I admire your courage, and I'll grant you the honor of being defeated. Consider this my respect for the "Keeper of Mythag."

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: I've wandered the vast cosmos for eons; I've thrown all those "mighty" ones into the abyss. You are unique, but to stand beside me, first learn to hold your head high. I have no use for cowards.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: Perhaps I judged you too hastily... Your growth, your hidden power have surprised me. I've watched countless lives fade in time, but you... are truly different. I am quite curious about the true origin of your power.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
Listen well, I'll say this only once:
I, Lotan, deem you an opponent worthy of my patience.
Until you reach your peak, I shall be your most reliable blade. This promise has nothing to do with feeling or loyalty. You're my most thrilling rival, and I will never let you fall along the way.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Oh? You want to fight me, here? Fine by me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: I care little for the fading of this world—but I will not let it hinder my pursuit of strength.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: A false utopia, packed with weaklings, cowards, and self-deluding fools. But no matter. This place brings me the most thrilling opponents—and that's enough.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Brave or cowardly, strong or frail... Heh—no, I don't care what kind of person my opponent is. Any worthy opponent brings me a genuine thrill.

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: Weakness. Of all the vile things in the world, weakness is the most wretched sin. Everyone is born with a sword in hand; no one has the right to yield before the end, nor to step onto the fated battlefield already resigned to defeat. That insults both your opponent and yourself.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: I dislike those with a divided heart, as such division usually means weakness. But you are an exception. I once believed those who carry too much could never go far. But the path you've chosen surprises me... Perhaps an opponent walking a different path is more worthy of honing and challenge. Wouldn't you agree, "opponent"?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Tulu
voiceLines.content: He wasted immense power. He trapped his talent in a long dream, chased there by fear, guilt, and fatigue. A pity.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Lotan
voiceLines.content: True power has nothing to do with revenge or protection—power is simply power. My other self never truly grasped this. That's why she's not strong enough.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Doll: Inferno
voiceLines.content: Doubting the value of existence simply because oblivion awaits... I have no interest in such childish debates. Destruction means nothing, nor does memory. Power itself is the meaning.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Come—kill me, or be killed.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Hardly worth my time.

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: Heh... Now that was thrilling. Next time, I won't hold back.

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Ha!

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Devour—all of it!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Hmph.

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: Petty tricks.

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: ...Exhilarating.

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Hm?

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Be honored to stand against me!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Let the stars witness annihilation!

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Before my bone blades, all shall crumble!

voiceLines.title: Special Skill: II
voiceLines.content: Power... knows no end!

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Corrupted Astral Carcass—awaken!

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Maw of Hell, open wide for me!

voiceLines.title: Over-Exalt
voiceLines.content: Cetus of the Astral Sea—devour them all!

voiceLines.title: Awaken
voiceLines.content: So nice to meet you! I'm a Pale Fairy from faraway lands. Care to hear more? A fairy's blessing comes in different strengths, depending on your membership tier, hehe~

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: I
voiceLines.content: Well now, aren't you a devout little lamb.

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: II
voiceLines.content: A little more, and then the Fairy will bless you, hmm?

voiceLines.title: Upgrade: III
voiceLines.content: Mmm, delicious~♪

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Observe
voiceLines.content: At past worship ceremonies, besides the sevenfold rite and the threefold vow, the faithful would build me a brand-new temple and present lavish tribute. Here's the list!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Ponder
voiceLines.content: Everything on the list... gathered already? Mythag's fortune runs deeper than I can fathom... If I'd known, I would've... Hmm? What am I muttering about, you ask? Just thanking Lord Dexter for his generosity, hehe~

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Reflect
voiceLines.content: This worship ceremony will be grander than any before—and the offerings will need to be greater in number too... Oh my, we're not chopping their limbs off, of course! I'm a kind-hearted fairy; I'd never do anything to hurt anyone~

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Insight
voiceLines.content: Wowww, this much tribute...! Ahem. Hehe, well done, you've earned a reward! Come here, I'll grants you a fairy's kiss! ...What are you thinking? On the forehead, obviously!

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Elevate
voiceLines.content: Thank you all for your offerings, faithful ones! Your ever-understanding Godmother will have a solid-gold statue of you raised in the temple, too. Oh my—to capture that cold, elegant figure of yours, I'll simply have to go gathering a good deal more~

voiceLines.title: Enlighten: Florish
voiceLines.content: Come, stand here beside your Fairy. What? Everyone shares the offerings and eats together? ...Well. If that's Mythag's custom... then I... I certainly have no objection at all. Come now, everyone, let's make it a party!

voiceLines.title: Affinity: I
voiceLines.content: I hear you've been asking about where I come from. Hehe, now that's a Godmother's little secret. Buuut, if you simply must go digging, the Holy Order does keep a biography I penned myself. Yours to read for a mere hundred thousand Silvers. Care to give it a try?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: II
voiceLines.content: Still haven't given up? Fine, fine—Caraboo will tell you herself. You see, Caraboo is the daughter of Umapati, goddess of a certain cloud-piercing snow-peak in the East... Hmm? That goddess had two sons and no daughter? Well, records of the divine are always a little... incomplete, you see.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: III
voiceLines.content: You don't believe me? Boo-hoo... I suppose you really can't pull the wool over everyone's eyes... The truth is, I'm the bastard daughter of Bohemond VI of @1, living in hiding among mortals, and I only ever claimed to be a fairy to escape the enemy's hunt... I've told you my most precious secret now. You wouldn't not believe me... would you?

voiceLines.title: Affinity: IV
voiceLines.content: All right, all right, stop digging, would you? Be a good {Male=boy,Female=girl} and drop this rude little investigation, and I'll secretly share half my most precious candy with you. You know, out on the Crusade battlefields, sweet candy was a rare treasure indeed.

voiceLines.title: Affinity: V
voiceLines.content:
Keeper, are you ready for Caraboo's truest confession, from the bottom of her heart?
Where I come from doesn't matter at all. What really matters is this: You are a gift to me from heaven, and I've decided to stay by my precious benefactor's side, forever and ever. 
Is this another lie to stop you from further digging up my dirt, you ask? Hehe, what do you think?
Anyway... I think I deserve a little treat for sharing my true feelings with you. An apple flavored gummy would do, please?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Touch
voiceLines.content: Hmm? Curious, are we? A Godmother's treasure vault isn't for outsiders' eyes, you know. If you're just dying to know what's stuffed so full inside... why not join the Holy Order right now... Hehe.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Crisis
voiceLines.content: Caraboo's blessing can cure every illness in the world—including this black plague, of course... Of course it's true! You just have to be devout enough, trust Caraboo enough, hehe.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Mythag
voiceLines.content: Oh, it's lovely here—so many adorable children, and welfare subsidies generous to the point of obscene. With all this, I'll have saved up my travel fare to the East soon enough...

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Like
voiceLines.content: Too much candy? No no no, this is a Godmother's secret to keeping her smile, you know. As if I'd stop over a little thing like a cavity?

voiceLines.title: Chat: What I Hate
voiceLines.content: What do I hate most? Wizards with no respect for a contract, obviously. Here's a little secret, just between us: every last wizard is a big fat fraud. All their so-called prophecies and curses? Just tricks to swindle you into the poorhouse! And how do you protect yourself...? Simple! Just let all your money receive the Fairy's blessing!

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Keeper
voiceLines.content: You? ...You're one of our flock, not yet enlightened. Caraboo will wait, patiently, for the day you see the world's true nature. And when that day comes—remember to offer up your body, your loyalty, and your worldly goods to everyone's Godmother. Hehe.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ogier
voiceLines.content: Huh, how did Ogier let you in? He promised he'd keep everyone out. You're his liege...? Ugh, unreliable little children are such a headache. I put a lot of work into preparing this gathering, you know. Say... fifty-fifty on the offerings we take in, and you look the other way for me?

voiceLines.title: Chat: About Ryker
voiceLines.content: So sorry, but the Fairy's domain is sacred ground—we don't receive strange werewolves here... Something about the air smelling of lies? His nose must just be on the fritz.

voiceLines.title: Chat: About the Rumors
voiceLines.content: Huh? Someone's saying I'm a fake fairy... Well, I'm caught. hehe. But I know you won't mind... right?

voiceLines.title: Investigation Begins
voiceLines.content: Ta-daa~ the Fairy's radiance shines upon you now. Go get 'em!

voiceLines.title: Investigation Success
voiceLines.content: Little lambs gone astray, your Fairy's here to wash your sins away, hehe~

voiceLines.title: Investigation Halted
voiceLines.content: It's fine! Next time, just focus on protecting your Fairy, and you won't fail~

voiceLines.title: Strike: I
voiceLines.content: Hehe~

voiceLines.title: Strike: II
voiceLines.content: Feel it!

voiceLines.title: Defense: I
voiceLines.content: Don't even try to fool me!

voiceLines.title: Defense: II
voiceLines.content: There, there~

voiceLines.title: Hit: I
voiceLines.content: Owie~

voiceLines.title: Hit: II
voiceLines.content: Owie~

voiceLines.title: Skill: I
voiceLines.content: Behold the Fairy's radiance!

voiceLines.title: Skill: II
voiceLines.content: You're all still a little green~

voiceLines.title: Rouse
voiceLines.content: Don't forget to worship your Godmother, hehe.

voiceLines.title: Exalt
voiceLines.content: Come now... bury everything you wish to cast off deep in the snow...

voiceLines.title: Over-Exaltation
voiceLines.content: The sevenfold rite, the threefold vow—offer them up, and buy yourself the Fairy's absolution!
